items.author: The Straits Times
items.summary: The loss, up from US$13 billion a year earlier, was driven by US$72 billion in accounting charges.
items.body:
Anthropic logged net loss of over US$80 billion in first half of 2026: Report
Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox

Anthropic signalled it could spend as much as US$750 billion in the coming years to secure more computing capacity.
PHOTO: REUTERS

Published   Oct 21, 2026, 06:55 AM

Updated   Oct 21, 2026, 06:55 AM

Set as preferred source

Summarise

Anthropic reported a net loss of more than US$80 billion in the first half of 2026, driven by US$72 billion in accounting charges, Reuters and the Wall Street Journal said.
Revenue rose sharply to US$16.3 billion in six months, while AI infrastructure spending nearly quadrupled to almost US$9 billion, showing the high cost of the AI race.
Investors are rethinking Anthropic’s IPO value, with talks around US$1.5 trillion instead of US$2 trillion; a weak listing could hurt the wider AI market.

AI generated

Anthropic reported a net loss of more than US$80 billion (S$102 billion) in the first half of the year and signalled it could spend as much as US$750 billion in the coming years to secure more computing capacity, the Wall Street Journal reported on Oct 20.
The loss, up from US$13 billion a year earlier, was driven by US$72 billion in accounting charges tied to changes in the value of financial instruments Anthropic issued to raise money, the report said, citing a draft prospectus for its IPO.
The figures show the hefty costs of the AI race even as investors look harder at whether the money companies are pouring into chips and data centres will pay off.

Anthropic’s revenue jumped to US$16.3 billion in the six months ended June 30 from US$1.1 billion a year ago, while AI infrastructure spending nearly quadrupled to almost US$9 billion, the Journal said.
Anthropic did not respond to a request for comment and Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
Anthropic’s IPO valuation under scrutiny Reuters reported first in September that Anthropic posted a net loss of US$42 billion in 2025, as part of a series of exclusives from its IPO prospectus.

The company has benefited from the popularity of Claude Code, its coding assistant that developers use to write software and build apps.
But some current investors and prospective investors who attended Anthropic’s investor day last week are weighing a lower valuation for the AI company after its latest financial disclosures, four people familiar with the matter had told Reuters.
The investors who attended the event in San Francisco discussed a valuation of around US$1.5 trillion, three of the people had said, a significant step down from the roughly US$2 trillion valuation previously expected for the November share sale.

Anthropic told investors at the meeting that its third-quarter revenue jumped 45% to US$16.8 billion from the previous quarter, and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis during the quarter.
A cooler reception for Anthropic’s IPO could weigh on the wider AI market, whose near-term prospects investors see as hinging largely on the share sale’s success, ahead of rival OpenAI’s potential listing next year. REUTERS

items.title: AI data center projects boost US warehouse demand and rents, real estate company JLL says
items.author: Lisa Baertlein
items.creator: Lisa Baertlein
items.summary: AI data center construction projects, particularly near Dallas/Fort Worth and Washington, DC, are generating new demand for warehouse space and helped send rents higher in the third quarter, real estate services company JLL said on Tuesday.
items.body:
AI data center construction projects, particularly near Dallas/Fort Worth and Washington, DC, are generating new demand for warehouse space and helped send rents higher in the third quarter, real estate services company JLL (JLL.N) said on Tuesday.
Companies like Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Meta (META.O) and Amazon (AMZN.O) are spending billions of dollars in a race to dominate artificial intelligence, which requires significant electricity to run servers and computer chips that must be cooled to prevent overheating.
"Data center expansion is driving outsized industrial demand in major freight hubs such as Dallas/Fort Worth, where suppliers and infrastructure providers are clustering near hyperscale campuses," JLL said in its industrial real estate market report for the third quarter.
Average asking rents rose to $10.55 per square foot, up 3.2% from a year earlier, the fastest annual pace of growth since the second quarter of 2024, JLL said.
That growth is based on so-called triple-net leases, where tenants pay property taxes, insurance and upkeep of common areas separately from base rent.
The expansion of infrastructure-intensive industries is changing the mix of tenants and the location of demand, JLL said, noting that demand from construction, telecommunications and utilities-related tenants increased.

items.title: Grupo México reporta mayores ganancias trimestrales y recorta previsiones cupríferas
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El conglomerado minero y de transporte Grupo México reportó el martes un aumento del 56% en su ganancia neta durante el tercer trimestre en comparación con el mismo período del año anterior, impulsado principalmente por el alza de los precios de los metales, a pesar de una caída en la producción de cobre.
items.body:
El conglomerado minero y de transporte Grupo México reportó el martes un aumento del 56% en su ganancia neta durante el tercer trimestre en comparación con el mismo período del año anterior, impulsado principalmente por el alza de los precios de los metales, a pesar de una caída en la producción de cobre.
El grupo (GMEXICOB.MX)
, uno de los principales productores mundiales de cobre, redujo su proyección de producción para 2026 a 1,026 millones de toneladas métricas, desde la previsión anterior de 1,034 millones de toneladas.
La utilidad neta alcanzó los 2,000 millones de dólares, con ingresos que aumentaron un 38% hasta los 6,330 millones de dólares, según un informe presentado el martes.
La utilidad neta superó la estimación de 1,780 millones de dólares de los analistas consultados por LSEG, mientras que los ingresos también superaron la estimación de 5,810 millones de dólares.
Las ganancias antes de intereses, impuestos, depreciación y amortización (EBITDA) para el trimestre finalizado en septiembre aumentaron un 50.5% hasta los 3,770 millones de dólares.
Mientras tanto, la empresa produjo 260,322 toneladas de cobre en el tercer trimestre, un 1.9% menos que en el mismo periodo de 2025, debido a la disminución de la producción en Perú y en Asarco, su subsidiaria en Tucson, Arizona. Esta disminución se compensó parcialmente con un aumento de las operaciones en México.
Grupo México, controlado por el multimillonario Germán Larrea, es uno de los mayores productores de cobre del mundo a través de su división minera y también opera negocios ferroviarios y de infraestructura en México y otros países latinoamericanos.

items.title: Trump promises cash for fraud tips as he awards right-wing YouTuber
items.author: Trevor Hunnicutt
items.creator: Trevor Hunnicutt
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he would reward tipsters who uncover fraud in US government programs, launching the initiative by announcing a cash prize for a conservative online influencer.
items.body:
President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he would reward tipsters who uncover fraud in US government programs, launching the initiative by announcing a cash prize for a conservative online influencer.
Speaking from the White House Oval Office, Trump said a new Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program would award people an unlimited 1% commission on the fraud reported.
The Justice Department described the program differently, saying it would award $10,000 to $30,000 for tips that lead to criminal charges. It said the Treasury Department is committing $25 million toward the program and that the Justice Department would issue the awards in its "sole discretion."
The first recipient was [USN:L1N43N016 TEXT:"Nick Shirley"]. Senior administration officials have amplified and credited the 24-year-old pro-Trump YouTuber's viral video alleging some childcare centers in Minnesota were fraudulent as the basis for plans to cut some federal funding to the state.
The Minnesota Department of Children, Youth, and Families disputed some of those claims as misleading and exaggerated. But one Minneapolis woman whose childcare center Shirley profiled later pleaded guilty to fraud charges.
"There's never been an incentive for anyone to ever expose fraud," Shirley said at the White House. "When you expose fraud, you help save America."
Vice President JD Vance, who leads the president's anti-fraud task force, said Shirley had "done more than anybody that I've met recently as a citizen journalist to uncover the fraud" and that "Nick is going to get a financial reward for doing so."
A White House official told media outlets that Shirley would get $10,000.
It was not immediately clear how Shirley was selected for the prize. The White House, Justice Department and Treasury Department did not immediately respond to an emailed request for comment, and Shirley could not immediately be reached.
"I will be the arbitrator of all of these decisions," Trump said about who would be paid under the program. "I will be very generous, believe me. We're not looking to save on that."
The Republican US president has made allegations of fraud in Democratic-led states a focus of his term in office and has pledged to clean up corruption. He has focused especially on [USN:L1N45U12W TEXT:"Somali immigrants"] in Minnesota, whom he has called "garbage."

items.title: Ngumoha comes of age on breathless Anfield night
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Rio Ngumoha had already been billed as one of Liverpool's brightest young talents, but on a breathless Champions League night at Anfield on Tuesday the 18-year-old delivered the kind of performance that suggested his time had arrived.
items.body:
Rio Ngumoha had already been billed as one of Liverpool's brightest young talents, but on a breathless Champions League night at Anfield on Tuesday the 18-year-old delivered the kind of performance that suggested his time had arrived.
With Liverpool trailing by two goals against Villarreal and in desperate need of inspiration, Ngumoha provided it, creating two goals as his side roared back for a dramatic 4-3 victory.
"Individually I think I enjoyed myself tonight," Ngumoha said. "As I get older now, affecting games is really important. And today, to get two assists and help the team get the three points, there's nothing more I can ask for."
Ngumoha is the youngest Liverpool player to register an assist in the Champions League.
"It's the biggest club in the world, and for me to get that record is something special," he said. "So yeah, I'll take it. I'll take it all day."
Looking perfectly at home on one of the game's biggest stages, his first intervention saw him show his composure. With Liverpool having pulled one back through Alexis Mac Allister, Ngumoha produced a delightful dinked pass for Ronald Araujo to haul the hosts level on the brink of halftime.
If that offered a glimpse of his talent, what followed after the break felt like a coming-of-age moment.
Ngumoha took on Sergi Cardona, skipped past the defender and laid the ball on a plate for Mac Allister to tap Liverpool into the lead for the first time.
Supporters at Anfield had spent the opening half-hour watching a Liverpool side stumble from one mistake to another. Suddenly, they were watching an 18-year-old take charge.
"On the ball, this kid has so much quality," former Liverpool striker Daniel Sturridge said on the Amazon Prime broadcast. "It is stuff you can't teach. What he does with the ball at his feet, it is God-given ability."
Florian Wirtz added a fourth, his first club goal of the season, and although Tani Oluwaseyi's late strike ensured a nervous finish, Liverpool survived to make it three wins from three in Europe.
Ngumoha had already made history at Liverpool, becoming the club’s youngest Premier League scorer at Anfield in April, aged 17. He was already the team's youngest scorer thanks to his goal at Newcastle in August 2025 when he was 16.
For all the twists in a chaotic seven-goal contest, however, the enduring image was of Ngumoha, and when the final whistle blew supporters celebrated while Duran Duran's "Rio" blasted over the stadium speakers.

items.title: USDA plans to resume imports of Mexican cattle at more ports of entry
items.author: Tom Polansek
items.creator: Tom Polansek
items.summary: The US Department of Agriculture plans to resume cattle imports from Mexico at two additional US ports of entry, after halting shipments last year in an attempt to keep out the flesh-eating parasite New World screwworm, the agency said on Tuesday.
items.body:
The US Department of Agriculture plans to resume cattle imports from Mexico at two additional US ports of entry, after halting shipments last year in an attempt to keep out the flesh-eating parasite New World screwworm, the agency said on Tuesday.
The USDA plans to restart imports in Columbus, New Mexico, on October 26 and, if conditions for safe trade are in place, in Nogales, Arizona, on November 30, according to a post on X.
The block on imports of Mexican cattle helped push US ground beef prices to record highs this year, contributing to rising concerns about food affordability ahead of midterm elections in November.
USDA [USN:L1N45A0X4 TEXT:"resumed livestock trade"] in Douglas, Arizona, in August and at a large port in Santa Teresa, New Mexico, in September.
Horse imports are expected to resume in Santa Teresa on October 26, the USDA said on X.
The agency said it has confirmed 56 US screwworm cases since June, and 5 are active.

items.body:
A Netflix (NFLX.O) divulgou, nesta terça-feira, uma previsão de lucro para o quarto trimestre abaixo do esperado, dias depois de a pioneira do streaming ter demitido 6% de sua força de trabalho e substituído dois de seus principais executivos de programação.
As ações da Netflix caíram quase 6%, para US$64,66, no pós-mercado.
As ações haviam caído mais de 40% em um ano antes da divulgação dos resultados.
O co-presidente-executivo Ted Sarandos disse que a empresa pretende se concentrar em seu negócio principal de produzir séries e filmes de qualidade para tornar a Netflix um serviço indispensável, e que a recente reformulação da equipe executiva foi um passo nessa direção.
"Sei que podemos fazer melhor", disse Sarandos em uma videoconferência após a divulgação dos resultados. "Agora vimos uma oportunidade de levar nosso catálogo a um novo patamar."
A receita do terceiro trimestre cresceu 11,8%, para US$12,87 bilhões, em linha com as previsões de Wall Street, mas representou a menor taxa de crescimento em quase três anos. A empresa previu um lucro líquido de US$2,79 bilhões e lucro por ação (EPS) de US$0,67 para o quarto trimestre, abaixo da previsão média dos analistas, de US$3,07 bilhões e US$0,73.
A Netflix reduziu sua previsão de receita publicitária para 2026 para cerca de US$2,7 bilhões, ante os cerca de US$3 bilhões previstos anteriormente. Alguns recursos dos produtos publicitários foram lançados um pouco mais lentamente do que o esperado, afirmaram os executivos em sua carta trimestral aos acionistas.
A empresa que abalou Hollywood quando começou a transmitir séries de TV e filmes há duas décadas agora enfrenta a concorrência do aumento repentino de audiência no YouTube e no TikTok. A Netflix tem investido em videogames, podcasts e eventos ao vivo para atrair novos espectadores e aumentar o tempo que os assinantes passam na plataforma.
Analistas de Wall Street têm questionado como a empresa vai retomar o crescimento.
“A Netflix continua sendo uma máquina bem lubrificada e altamente lucrativa, mas está focada em muitas distrações indesejadas”, disse o analista Paolo Pescatore, da PP Foresight. “A empresa precisa voltar ao essencial e se concentrar em conteúdo atraente.”
Em seu relatório de resultados, a Netflix afirmou que continuará a expandir sua oferta por meio do licenciamento de mais conteúdo de terceiros. Além disso, ela se concentrará no serviço principal de streaming de TV, filmes e eventos ao vivo e investirá em programas originais que “estimulem conversas, atraiam mais assinantes e nos tornem um serviço ‘indispensável’”, afirmaram os executivos na carta.
No terceiro trimestre, o lucro por ação ficou em US$0,87, acima da previsão média de US$0,82 dos analistas consultados pela LSEG. A programação lançada durante o trimestre incluiu “Monstro: A História de Lizzie Borden”, a segunda temporada de “Magnatas do Crime”, a temporada final de “Outer Banks” e um reboot de “Uma Casa na Pradaria”.
Na semana passada, a Netflix demitiu 1.000 pessoas, o que representa cerca de 6% de seus funcionários. A empresa substituiu a diretora criativa Bela Bajaria e anunciou que o chefe de cinema, Dan Lin, estava deixando a empresa — sinais de que está redefinindo sua estratégia de programação.
A Netflix perdeu neste ano uma disputa pela Warner Bros Discovery e seu vasto acervo de personagens, que foi vendido para a Skydance, liderada por David Ellison . Alguns analistas acreditam que a Netflix poderia buscar outros alvos de aquisição, como a NBCUniversal, depois que a Comcast (CMCSA.O) a desmembrar.
A Netflix registrou perdas mensais de assinantes nos EUA ao longo de 2026, sem que fossem relatados ganhos líquidos em nenhum mês até setembro, segundo dados da empresa de análise Antenna.
A Antenna acompanha as aquisições de assinaturas nos EUA por meio de fontes como transações com cartão de crédito, mas exclui as assinaturas adquiridas por meio de pacotes de atacado. Um porta-voz da Netflix afirmou que os dados da Antenna “não são representativos do desempenho comercial da Netflix”.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ ２０日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は２０日放映のテレビインタビューで、サウジアラビアとイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の戦闘終結に向けた協議の仲介を申し出たものの、双方から回答を得ていないと明らかにした。

アラグチ氏は、フーシ派が今月に入りサウジへの攻撃を激化させる中、対話の促進を支援すると申し出ていた。

アラグチ氏は、イラクのアルエクバリヤ・テレビとのインタビューで、エジプトがサウジに加わり、フーシ派との戦闘に参加する可能性についても言及した。 

「いかなる外国の介入も事態を複雑にする」と述べ、エジプト政府は以前、イエメンの紛争には「直接」介入しないとイラン政府に伝えていたと説明した。

エジプトは、サウジの安全と安定を守るため、同国が要請すれば必要な支援を提供する用意があると表明しており、中東情勢の緊迫化につながる可能性がある。

エジプト議会では、同国軍によるフーシ派への軍事行動の可能性を巡る採決が、１０月２６日に延期された。

items.title: Man accused of ramming car into Australian lawmaker to face three charges in court
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The man who allegedly rammed his car into Australian lawmaker Helen Haines outside her electoral office will appear in court on Wednesday after being charged with three offences, in an attack authorities say was deliberate.
items.body:
The man who allegedly rammed his car into Australian lawmaker Helen Haines outside her electoral office will appear in court on Wednesday after being charged with three offences, in an attack authorities say was deliberate.
Doctors had to amputate one of Haines' legs after the alleged attacker [USN:L1N46510F TEXT:"struck"] her twice with his car in Wangaratta on Monday, Australian media and officials said.
[USN:L6N4650UX TEXT:"Haines"], an independent lawmaker who has championed causes including climate change and regional housing, remained in critical condition. She had worked in nursing, midwifery and academia before being elected to parliament in 2019 for the rural seat of Indi, which she retained in both 2022 and 2025.
Anti-terrorism police are among the agencies investigating the incident. While police allege the attack was "targeted," they have said they believe it was an isolated incident.
The alleged attacker, 43, was arrested at the scene and charged on Tuesday with dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally causing serious injury, and causing harm to a public official. He is set to appear at the Magistrates' Court in Wangaratta, about 240 kilometres (150 miles) northeast of Melbourne.
While the motive has yet to be revealed, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Wednesday described the attack as clearly a "violent incident," having earlier linked it to a domestic climate of ugly, polarised political debate.
"It's a reminder that the world is a more dangerous and divided place than it was a generation ago," Albanese told ABC Radio on Wednesday.
Violent attacks on politicians are rare in Australia, where federal lawmakers, state leaders and even prime ministers are often seen shopping, grabbing coffee or attending community events with relatively little security.
But [USN:L4N466030 TEXT:"concerns"] about politicians' safety have grown in recent years amid rising political polarisation, online abuse and threats against elected officials, prompting calls for greater protections while preserving the accessibility that has long characterised Australian politics.

items.title: Trump drops threats against Canadian jet maker Bombardier, citing U.S. jobs
items.author: Graham Richardson
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has dropped threats against Canadian jet maker Bombardier to ban it from the U.S. market and instead vowed to take “good care” of the company’s workers in Kansas.
items.body: OTTAWA – U.S. President Donald Trump appears to be backing away from his threat to shut Canadian aerospace giant Bombardier out of the U.S. market, after learning about the company’s significant operations in Kansas. In September, Trump threatened to block sales of Bombardier jets in the United States amid a growing trade dispute with Canada. “NO MORE SELLING BOMBARDIER IN THE UNITED STATES! Their products aren’t good enough!” Trump wrote on Truth Social on Sept. 7. “If they want our Market, they must build here, and stop treating America like a ‘piggybank.’” But while visiting Kansas on Monday, Trump struck a dramatically different tone after learning about Bombardier’s operations in Wichita, where the company employs about 1,500 people. “We’re going to take care of Bombardier,” Trump told 12 News in Kansas. He repeated the sentiment on stage at a rally later in the day. “I’m going to be helping a certain air company get themselves straightened away … I’ll be helping them because I always viewed them as a Canadian company,” Trump said. “But now I find out they have a presence here, and we’re not hurting them if they’re in Kansas. So, we’ll take care of those people and the jobs.” Dominic LeBlanc, the federal minister responsible for Canada-U.S. trade, has argued for months that Bombardier is deeply embedded in the American economy. “Bombardier has many hundreds and thousands of employees in the United States and has had for a long time. I had seen a number of legislators in the United States, including Republicans, express concerns this summer when President Trump had made those comments about Bombardier,” said Leblanc. Trump was in Kansas to campaign for Republican Sen. Roger Marshall, who is locked in an unusually competitive re-election fight against Democrat Adam Hamilton. Kansas has not elected a Democratic U.S. senator since 1932, but polls have shown a close race this year. Trump’s September threat against Bombardier had become a political issue in Kansas because of the company’s 1,500 jobs in Wichita. Marshall was among the Kansas lawmakers who contacted the White House after Trump threatened to block Bombardier from the U.S. market. Trump specifically cited Marshall’s involvement when he told local television Monday that his administration would “take care of Bombardier.” Bombardier employs about 3,500 people across the United States, with more than 40 per cent of those jobs in Wichita. The company last week announced a US$50-million investment in Wichita, home to its U.S. and defence headquarters. “We’re going to find a deal with the United States at some point that’s in the interest of the entire Canadian economy,” said Leblanc.

items.title: Australia's Woodside narrows annual production forecast, posts higher quarterly revenue
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's Woodside Energy on Wednesday narrowed its annual production forecast and posted a 27% rise in its third-quarter revenue on higher oil and gas prices.
items.body:
Australia's Woodside Energy (WDS.AX) on Wednesday narrowed its annual production forecast and posted a 27% rise in its third-quarter revenue on higher oil and gas prices.
The country's top independent oil and gas producer now expects annual production of 174 to 181 million barrels of oil equivalent (mmboe), down from its earlier forecast of 174-185 mmboe.
The company cited lower expected volumes from its Beaumont New Ammonia plant in Texas, a narrower window for first LNG from the Scarborough project and reduced production at the Okha floating production, storage and offloading vessel.
Woodside had lowered its expected Beaumont New Ammonia volumes after the facility was shut for about 30 days following a process safety event and due to feedstock constraints.
The country's top independent oil and gas producer reported revenue of $4.28 billion for the three months ended September 30, up from $3.36 billion reported a year ago .
That beat a Visible Alpha consensus of $4.11 billion.
Woodside's quarterly production volumes fell 9% from a year earlier to 46.2 mmboe, but rose 12% from the previous quarter following higher production from Pluto LNG after maintenance activities were completed in the second quarter.

items.title: Petrobras avalia como positivo adiamento de audiência sobre Gas Release
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Petrobras afirmou nesta terça-feira que avalia positivamente a decisão da Agência Nacional do Petróleo (ANP) de postergar para 19 de novembro a realização da audiência pública sobre o Programa de Redução da Concentração no Mercado de Gás Natural (Gas Release).
items.body:
A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) afirmou nesta terça-feira que avalia positivamente a decisão da Agência Nacional do Petróleo (ANP) de postergar para 19 de novembro a realização da audiência pública sobre o Programa de Redução da Concentração no Mercado de Gás Natural (Gas Release).
Segundo a companhia, o adiamento "beneficia o bom andamento do processo regulatório, permitindo que o debate público não seja realizado de forma açodada e que sejam melhor avaliados os impactos de curto, médio e longo prazo relacionados ao programa proposto".
"A alteração de data permitirá que a decisão final seja mais qualificada, sem comprometer os prazos subsequentes previstos pela agência", disse a estatal, em nota.
O Gas Release, afirmou a Petrobras, é um programa de venda compulsória de gás natural, por meio do qual a estatal seria obrigada a vender, por meio de leilões, parte dos volumes de que é titular, com preço mínimo inicial, quantidade e duração a serem definidos pela agência.
A Petrobras avalia que a "proposta apenas redistribui volumes já existentes no mercado, com efeitos potencialmente transitórios e sem demonstração suficiente de benefícios duradouros para a concorrência ou para os consumidores".

items.title: Australia central banker says policy working, inflation outlook worse
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A top Australian central banker on Wednesday said tighter monetary policy was working to slow the economy but the inflation outlook had still worsened, leaving him unsure on whether rates would need to rise further.
items.body:
A top Australian central banker on Wednesday said tighter monetary policy was working to slow the economy but the inflation outlook had still worsened, leaving him unsure on whether rates would need to rise further.
Speaking at a Citi conference, Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said the bank's economists were finalising their forecasts on the outlook and he did not know for sure what the RBA board would decide at its next meeting.
The central bank meets on November 3 to decide whether to raise its 4.60% cash rate for a fifth time this year as it struggles to bring inflation under control.

items.title: アンソロピック、上半期は800億ドル超の赤字に＝ＷＳＪ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２０日 ロイター] - 生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックが今年上半期に８００億ドル超の純損失を計上した。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２０日、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）目論見書の草案に基づいて伝えた。純損失には７２０億ドルの会計上の評価損が含まれている。

報道によると、前年同期の純損失は１３０億ドル。今年上半期の損失急拡大は、資金調達のために発行した転換社債などの金融商品の価値変動に伴う会計処理が主因とされる。アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に回答しなかった。

ＡＩ企業を巡っては高性能な生成ＡＩモデルの開発・運用に必要な半導体やデータセンター、計算資源への巨額投資が続いており、投資家の間で各社の財務状況への関心が高まっている。

ロイターが先週、ＩＰＯ準備会合に出席した投資家の話として報じたところによると、アンソロピックの第３・四半期（７─９月）売上高は前期比４５％増の１６８億ドルとなった。

またロイターは９月、アンソロピックが２０２５年に４２０億ドルの純損失を計上し、今後数年間でクラウドサービスや計算資源、インフラ関連で計５１８０億ドルの支出を計画していると伝えた。

同社の２５年の売上高は前年比で約１２倍の４６億ドル近くに拡大した一方、過去の資金調達に関連する負債評価損などを除いたベースでも、営業赤字は８０億ドルを超えたという。

米アンソロピックのロゴ。2024年5月に撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２０日 ロイター] - 生成人工知能（ＡＩ）開発の米アンソロピックが今年上半期に８００億ドル超の純損失を計上した。米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が２０日、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）目論見書の草案に基づいて伝えた。純損失には７２０億ドルの会計上の評価損が含まれている。

報道によると、前年同期の純損失は１３０億ドル。今年上半期の損失急拡大は、資金調達のために発行した転換社債などの金融商品の価値変動に伴う会計処理が主因とされる。アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に回答しなかった。

ＡＩ企業を巡っては高性能な生成ＡＩモデルの開発・運用に必要な半導体やデータセンター、計算資源への巨額投資が続いており、投資家の間で各社の財務状況への関心が高まっている。

ロイターが先週、ＩＰＯ準備会合に出席した投資家の話として報じたところによると、アンソロピックの第３・四半期（７─９月）売上高は前期比４５％増の１６８億ドルとなった。

またロイターは９月、アンソロピックが２０２５年に４２０億ドルの純損失を計上し、今後数年間でクラウドサービスや計算資源、インフラ関連で計５１８０億ドルの支出を計画していると伝えた。

同社の２５年の売上高は前年比で約１２倍の４６億ドル近くに拡大した一方、過去の資金調達に関連する負債評価損などを除いたベースでも、営業赤字は８０億ドルを超えたという。

items.title: BOJ to raise rates to 1.50% in December, sticking to quarterly pace: Reuters poll
items.author: Satoshi Sugiyama
items.creator: Satoshi Sugiyama
items.summary: The Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in December to 1.50%, following June and September increases, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, keeping up a quicker pace in a campaign that started with just one rate rise a year.
items.body:
The Bank of Japan will raise interest rates in December to 1.50%, following June and September increases, according to a majority of economists in a Reuters poll, keeping up a quicker pace in a campaign that started with just one rate rise a year.
Rising energy and import costs, worsened by a weak yen and the war in the Middle East, are adding to inflation pressure in Japan, and there are more forecasters expecting at least two more rate rises to 2.0% by the middle of next year.
A period of relative stability in the yen, which spent most of the year under crushing selling pressure, triggering interventions from the Japanese authorities as well as the US Treasury, also supports the case for a December increase.
[USN:L1N46101P TEXT:"Last week,"] board member Junko Koeda said the central bank should not become overly cautious about raising rates, at their highest in [USN:L1N459138 TEXT:"31 years"], given the significant upside risks to inflation.
Nearly 70% of economists, 54 of 78, in the October 13-19 survey expected the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5% this quarter, almost double the share in the [USN:L4N44Z0P0 TEXT:"previous poll"].
Of the 54 respondents who specified a month, about 80% chose December, while only 2% chose the BOJ's next two-day policy meeting, which concludes on October 30.
"With rate hikes in the United States and Europe looking likely before year-end, there is a risk that yen selling could accelerate if the BOJ postpones its move until the new year," said Kazutaka Maeda, senior economist at Meiji Yasuda Research Institute.
The BOJ is unlikely to raise rates this month, while the [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"US Federal Reserve"] and the [USN:L6N45U0QU TEXT:"European Central Bank"] are expected to raise borrowing costs in December, separate Reuters polls found.
"The economy is not overheating to the extent that would warrant consecutive rate hikes, and price developments are also within the BOJ's expected range," said Takeshi Minami, chief economist at Norinchukin Research Institute.
[USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"Sources"] have told Reuters many BOJ officials prefer to assess more data on how previous increases have affected financial conditions.
RATES TO REACH 2% OR HIGHER Looking into next year, 39 of 65 analysts, or 60%, expected the policy rate to reach 1.75% by end-June, a median unchanged from the September poll.
Almost half of 41 respondents who answered an additional question said 1.75% would be the terminal rate. But the share expecting it to reach 2.00% or more rose to 51%, from 40% in September and 36% in August.
In September, two board members nominated by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi who support looser fiscal policy opposed the decision to raise rates to 1.25%.
Traders saw the dissent as a sign the BOJ's rate-hike plans could continue to face opposition from Takaichi's administration, briefly pushing the yen lower.
Nearly three-quarters of respondents, or 23 of 32, said further dissenting votes when the Policy Board next raises rates could weigh on the yen, which is only about 4% stronger than its 2026 low of around 164 per dollar.
"If the dissenting vote were cast in particular by a board member appointed under the Takaichi administration, it could be interpreted as the administration's attempt to restrain rate hikes, potentially heightening concerns that future policy tightening could fall behind the curve," said Kei Fujimoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management.
BOND ISSUANCE SEEN BELOW 40 TRILLION YEN Japanese government bond (JGB) yields have risen recently alongside a global market rout, but also on expectations of further BOJ rate hikes and concerns Takaichi's big spending and tax-cut plans will worsen the country's already strained finances.
Takaichi has said the government aims to keep new bond issuance at around 40 trillion yen ($251 billion) for the fiscal 2027 budget. She reiterated on Monday Tokyo would "appropriately" control the size of its debt issuance.
Nearly two-thirds of economists surveyed, 15 of 23, said new issuance would be kept below 40 trillion yen.
"The government is likely keen to increase JGB issuance as a source of funding for growth investment," said Junya Takemoto, senior economist at Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation.
"However, as it becomes more conscious of rising interest rates in the market, it may seek to contain issuance by undertaking a full-scale review of budgets for existing subsidies and funds, ensuring that JGB issuance does not differ markedly from historical levels."
([USN:L6N45N0UX TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Reuters global economic poll)

"However, as it becomes more conscious of rising interest rates in the market, it may seek to contain issuance by undertaking a full-scale review of budgets for existing subsidies and funds, ensuring that JGB issuance does not differ markedly from historical levels."

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（20日）株はダウ主導で上昇、ドル下落　長期債利回り低下
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞
items.body:
＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 長期債利回りが低下した。ただ、安値拾いを背景とした人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の切り返しなどで米株式相場が上昇する中、不安定な動きとなり、この日の最低水準からは大きく戻した。

２０日はコアウィーブなどＡＩ関連株が切り返し、株式市場全体が上昇するにつれ、利回りはこの日の低下幅を縮小した。年限の短い国債の利回りは前日比で上昇した。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは１．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、５．１２１％となった。一時は５．０７３％まで低下した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが来週の金融政策会合で少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げを実施する確率は１７．２％。１週間前の２２．１％、１カ月前の５７．６％から低下した。

３０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ低下の５．４３１％。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 年内の追加利上げ観測が高まったことから、金相場は下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．４％安の１オンス＝４１４２．６０ドル。スポット金は午後２時５分（日本時間午前３時５分）時点で０．３％安の１オンス＝４１２５．９０ドルだった。

items.author: ロイター

items.body:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（20日）株はダウ主導で上昇、ドル下落　長期債利回り低下
7:06 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）前のウォール街の標識。2021年7月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 長期債利回りが低下した。ただ、安値拾いを背景とした人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の切り返しなどで米株式相場が上昇する中、不安定な動きとなり、この日の最低水準からは大きく戻した。

２０日はコアウィーブなどＡＩ関連株が切り返し、株式市場全体が上昇するにつれ、利回りはこの日の低下幅を縮小した。年限の短い国債の利回りは前日比で上昇した。

指標となる米１０年債利回りは１．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下し、５．１２１％となった。一時は５．０７３％まで低下した。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、ＦＲＢが来週の金融政策会合で少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げを実施する確率は１７．２％。１週間前の２２．１％、１カ月前の５７．６％から低下した。

３０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ低下の５．４３１％。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 年内の追加利上げ観測が高まったことから、金相場は下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．４％安の１オンス＝４１４２．６０ドル。スポット金は午後２時５分（日本時間午前３時５分）時点で０．３％安の１オンス＝４１２５．９０ドルだった。

items.title: Trump administration says it has revoked over 300,000 visas
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: President Donald Trump's administration has revoked over 300,000 US visas during his second term, the State Department said on Tuesday as the federal government continues its sweeping immigration crackdown.
items.body:
President Donald Trump's administration has revoked over 300,000 US visas during his second term, the State Department said on Tuesday as the federal government continues its sweeping immigration crackdown.
The number showed an acceleration in the pace of visa revocations in recent weeks.
In an update issued on August 10, the State Department [USN:L6N4470TW TEXT:"had put the number"] of visa revocations since Trump's current term began in January 2025 at over 175,000.
Trump says his immigration crackdown and [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"deportation drive"] aim to improve domestic security. Rights advocates say the crackdown has violated due process and free speech rights and has created an unsafe environment, particularly for ethnic minorities, who have raised concerns about [USN:L4N3ZU0AN TEXT:"racial profiling"].
In announcing the latest number on X, State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott said the Trump administration "has revoked more visas at a faster pace than any administration in history."
Pigott said the administration had "zero tolerance for foreigners here on visas who break the law, commit fraud, or undermine our national security."
Among visa revocations particularly condemned by rights advocates are those of pro-Palestinian foreign protesters demonstrating against US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's attacks on Gaza"] and of foreigners over their [USN:L2N3VV14E TEXT:"social media comments"] about conservative commentator Charlie Kirk's assassination.
In addition to attempts to deport foreign protesters, the Trump administration has enforced tightened [USN:L3N3QN23Z TEXT:"social media screening"] of immigrants and visa applicants.
Rights advocates say the government has deployed national security reasons to target critics and used isolated cases of fraud to broadly target immigrant communities such as the Somali American community in Minnesota.
While Trump campaigned in 2024 on stopping illegal immigration, his administration has also made legal immigration more difficult — for example by [USN:L6N3XM11V TEXT:"imposing expensive fees"] for certain work visas.

items.title: Woven costume in offbeat 'Wicker' movie is a 'masterpiece,' says actor Skarsgard
items.author: Hanna Rantala
items.creator: Hanna Rantala
items.summary: Actors Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgard have both played eccentric characters before but say their new film, in which Skarsgard transforms into an Adonis woven from wicker, is "in quirkiness levels, quite high".
items.body:
Actors Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgard have both played eccentric characters before but say their new film, in which Skarsgard transforms into an Adonis woven from wicker, is "in quirkiness levels, quite high".
In "Wicker", an absurdist romantic comedy set in a medieval village, Colman portrays an outcast known as the Fisherwoman who longs for a companion. She approaches a basket weaver, played by Peter Dinklage, who creates her a supernatural husband.
Initially jeered, the wicker man surprises both the Fisherwoman and the judgemental villagers with his sensitivity and skills, slowly turning life in the conservative community upside down.
"I'd just never seen anything like that before," said Colman, who won an Oscar for her performance in 2018's "The Favourite". "It was totally original."
It took artists at the Weta Workshop in New Zealand around 18 months to design Skarsgard's suit. The Stockholm-based actor witnessed the costume coming to life over emails and video calls before trying it on some two weeks before shooting began in Budapest.
"That was definitely a moment I'll never forget, when I got to step into him," Skarsgard said. "I really want the audience to know that it was practical and that it wasn't CGI... It was a masterpiece."
Skarsgard credited the team for shortening the costume and make-up application process from an initial "quite a few hours" to under two hours. Acting in it was a learning curve, he said, and required accentuated movements.
"It had different pieces, elements to it, glued to my face, and little added lips and eyelashes made out of flax and hair," he said. "It definitely didn't feel very organic because you had to really exaggerate everything."
The film is adapted from Ursula Wills-Jones' short story "The Wicker Husband". Elizabeth Debicki plays the Tailor's Wife, who takes the lead in a campaign against the Fisherwoman and her unconventional husband.
"There are some lessons in the film that are done very gently," said Colman. "The position of women, which is getting challenged in certain quarters, alarmingly so, and it's just a lovely comment on an equal relationship and kindness and the patriarchy and feminism. It's also enormous escapism, which is also really important at this time," she said.
"It's a commentary on our society and the world we live in," added Skarsgard, "but hopefully done in a very entertaining way."
"Wicker" begins its global cinematic roll-out on Wednesday.

items.title: Pistons use 23-0 burst to rally past Celtics in opener
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Duncan Robinson scored 15 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter as Detroit reeled off 23 unanswered points and downed the visiting Boston Celtics, 121-113, in the NBA's regular season opener on Tuesday afternoon.
items.body:
Duncan Robinson scored 15 of his 21 points in the fourth quarter as Detroit reeled off 23 unanswered points and downed the visiting Boston Celtics, 121-113, in the NBA's regular season opener on Tuesday afternoon.
Jalen Duren and Cade Cunningham scored 22 points apiece for the Pistons, who had an Eastern Conference-best 60 wins last season.
Javonte Green came off the bench to score 19 points in 18 minutes and Ausar Thompson supplied 11 points, 11 rebounds and five assists.
Paul George, making his Celtics debut, had a game-high 38 points. Payton Pritchard and Derrick White scored 17 points apiece but Jayson Tatum was held to 13 points on 6-for-23 shooting and contributed 11 assists.
The Celtics led by 13 at halftime, thanks a second-quarter run. Detroit held a 39-35 advantage early in the quarter before Boston erupted for 15 unanswered points.
George scored the Celtics' last eight points of the half as Boston carried a 58-45 advantage into the second half.
George didn't cool off coming out of the locker room. He fired in a trio of 3-pointers in a 52-second span to give Boston its biggest lead at 72-50.
Green entered the game shortly after to slow down George. He not only did that, he gave Detroit a spark on offense. Green scored 11 points in the quarter, including three 3-pointers of his own, as the Pistons pulled within three points by the closing seconds of the quarter.
George opened the fourth quarter with a layup to give Boston a 90-82 lead. The Celtics soon nudged the lead to 12 but Detroit began another comeback, started by a Thompson three-point play.
Robinson scored 11 straight points to pull the Pistons within one at 99-98. He then set up a 3-pointer for Green before Duren converted a three-point play. Robinson fired in a 3-pointer with 5:13 left to make it 107-99.
Green capped the 23-point run with another 3-pointer for a 112-99 lead with 3:33 to go.
Boston rallied to pull within four but Green hit two free throws with 6.7 seconds left to clinch Detroit's win.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Tata's owners deserve to prevail in power struggle
items.author: Una Galani
items.creator: Una Galani
items.summary: A clash between the salt-to-steel giant's major shareholder and chair has ramifications beyond the $260 bln group. If the owners triumph, Tata will need a new leader and strategic rethink. But a victory for Chair N. Chandrasekaran would set back shareholder rights across India.
items.body:
The chair of Tata Sons spent part of his most recent annual letter to stakeholders reflecting on the importance of building long-term institutions in India. Now N. Chandrasekaran, or Chandra as he is widely known, is locked in a power struggle that will test one of the country's most important institutions: the rights of shareholders to control a private company. The outcome has ramifications far beyond the 158-year-old conglomerate.
The crisis has its roots in a botched succession process at the business empire with sprawling interests from IT services and steel to cars, and annual revenue equivalent to 4% of Indian GDP. For decades Ratan Tata served as the group's patriarch and ultimate arbiter. After his death in 2024, his half-brother Noel Tata was appointed to the role as chair of Tata Trusts, the group of charities which owns 66% of Tata Sons, with Chandra continuing to serve as the holding company's chair, a position he has held since 2017.
Though Noel inherited Ratan's title, he did not retain the same power. After Tata Sons last month reappointed Chandra as chair, Noel publicly slammed the move as "illegal". The dispute leaves a group which has over a million employees and 26 listed group companies with a combined market capitalisation of $260 billion at a crossroads.
The feud hinges on a disagreement over Tata’s future. Chandra and his allies favour complying with a Reserve Bank of India determination that could require Tata Sons to list its shares on the stock market. Noel and the Tata Trusts disagree, arguing that there ways to avoid a listing. They argue that an initial public offering would weaken the group's ability to provide patient capital to strategic industries, rescue group companies in distress, and maintain the dividend stream that funds the charities' philanthropic work.
Complicating matters further, actions taken by the Charity Commissioner in Tata’s home state of Maharashtra following a complaint from one of Chandra's supporters who is a trustee and director of Tata Sons has delayed the holding company's annual general meeting. That matters because the shareholders would likely oust the chair if given the opportunity to vote.
Tata is vulnerable to a challenge from an emboldened board of directors because it is not a conventional family business. Its majority owner is a group of charitable trusts. So while Noel chairs the trusts he does not own the shares. Even so, the Tata Trusts have quorum rights and veto powers embedded into Tata Sons’ Articles of Association. As Mumbai-based corporate governance research firm IiAS points out , “the board has violated the basic governance principle of shareholder supremacy”.
The twin regulatory disputes have fuelled speculation in Indian financial circles about outside influence. Some observers see the unusual public silence from the government in New Delhi as evidence of creeping official involvement in one of India's most important business groups. Others point the finger at [USN:L6N45G069 TEXT:"minority investors"] in Tata Sons or rival factions in corporate India. Whatever the explanation, though, the power struggle has two possible outcomes.
The first is that Noel and the Tata Trusts emerge victorious. This would come at a considerable cost for the group. Chandra's exit would not only leave Tata Sons searching for a new chair but also force a leadership reshuffle affecting 14 of its group companies.
The biggest risk may be at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) . Chandra joined the information technology outsourcer in 1987 and served as its CEO for eight years before moving up to the holding company. As the $94 billion giant grapples with slowing revenue from AI disruption, Chandra has become more involved in setting its strategy. His hands-on approach is understandable: the IT company generates most of its parent's dividend income and is one of India’s important contributors of foreign exchange through the services it provides to major multinationals.
The leadership dispute comes as Tata is making some of the largest capital commitments in its history. It has pledged to pour investment into semiconductors, the energy transition and defence manufacturing, as well as turnaround loss-making Air India, all of which New Delhi considers strategically important.
According to one person close to Chandra, he agreed to stay on as chair despite Noel’s opposition to avoid leaving the group in limbo, with action by the Charity Commissioner also preventing Tata Sons from forming a search committee for a successor.
There's some logic there. Tata Sons and its partners have committed over $27 billion of capital to five new industrial ventures since 2017, according to another person familiar with the group's finances, an amount similar to total dividends and buyback proceeds received over the past decade.
The second possible outcome is that Chandra prevails over the wishes of the company's controlling shareholder. That would raise far-reaching questions about the rights of owners across Indian business. If Tata Trusts cannot pick who leads Tata Sons, other business owners will fret about their authority too. Some might then think twice about handing day-to-day control to professional managers, potentially recreating the same succession planning problems now afflicting Tata. That’s significant because the country is undergoing a vast intergenerational transfer of wealth; some $1.5 trillion is expected by Hurun Research Institute to change hands over the next decade.
Chandra's position looks untenable without the support of the company's majority shareholders. And while he would be difficult to replace, he is replaceable. Other possible leaders include Indian executives with global experience like Piyush Gupta, the former CEO of DBS (DBSM.SI) , Singapore’s largest bank and now non-executive India chair at sovereign investor Temasek. Splitting the roles of chair and CEO at Tata Sons could also allow for the elevation of a veteran insider like T. V. Narendran, the CEO of Tata Steel (TISC.NS) .
Tata’s subsidiaries each have their own boards of directors and can withstand a few months of uncertainty about who is in charge. Beyond that, the leadership feud will start to impact decisions about hiring and capital allocation.
The issue will be tested whenever shareholders eventually get to vote on Chandra’s reappointment. Several group companies own shares in Tata Sons, including Tata Steel, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles (TAMO.NS) , Tata Chemicals (TTCH.NS) , Tata Power (TTPW.NS) and Indian Hotels (IHTL.NS) . Those units' executives will be under pressure to take sides. The battle will also test the unity of the Tata Trusts. Their boards include not only Noel and his son, Neville, but also trustees who have supported Chandra. In time, more Tata Trusts board members may switch sides.
Chandra wrote in his annual letter that Tata is "building for the India of 2047" so that, when the country looks back after 100 years of independence from British rule, it finds "that the foundations were laid well". It is vital for the company and for India that Tata's owners should decide who lays them.
Follow Una Galani on LinkedIn and X .
items.raw_description: A clash between the salt-to-steel giant's major shareholder and chair has ramifications beyond the $260 bln group. If the owners triumph, Tata will need a new leader and strategic rethink. But a victory for Chair N. Chandrasekaran would set back shareholder rights across India.

items.title: Kennedy says Trump administration aims for regulated market for peptides
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said on Tuesday the Trump administration aims to expand access to peptides by creating a regulated marketplace for the drugs promoted by social media influencers and by the health secretary.
items.body:
US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said on Tuesday the Trump administration aims to expand access to peptides by creating a regulated marketplace for the drugs promoted by social media influencers and by the health secretary.
They have attracted consumers in a gray market, bolstered by social media claims for a host of unproven uses, and with scant safety and efficacy evidence from human studies.
"Americans are going to be buying these anyway. Our objective was to make sure that there is a regulated marketplace, so that what they're getting is what they claim to be, that is safe, that the factories are inspected," Kennedy said in an interview on Fox News' "The Will Cain Show."
Kennedy's comments were in response to a question about a proposed policy change that the FDA submitted on Thursday to the White House for review. The proposal could make it easier for pharmacies to compound certain peptides.
Outside advisers to the FDA had [USN:L6N43Q0TI TEXT:"recommended in July"] that the agency loosen restrictions on six of seven peptides under review, [USN:L1N4570VF TEXT:"including the popular BPC-157"], against the guidance of Food and Drug Administration staff.
Peptides, which are being used for everything from pain to muscle growth and injury recovery and as a beauty aid despite the lack of scientific evidence of their efficacy, have been promoted widely on social media, and by Kennedy himself.
They are built from short chains of amino acids, the same building blocks the body uses to make proteins.
The ones under consideration have not been approved by the FDA as safe or effective. Compounding pharmacies are allowed to mix ingredients of approved medicines in specialized doses and under other circumstances, such as drug shortages.

items.title: Netflix Sales Growth to Decline for Fourth Quarter in a Row
items.summary: Netflix reported earnings for the third quarter that exceeded Wall Street expectations, but forecast a fourth consecutive quarter of slowing sales growth, a projection that may amplify concerns about the performance of the world’s leading online TV network. Netflix delivered sales of $12.9 billion in the third quarter, in line with Wall Street’s expectations, and forecast sales of $13.4 billion in the year’s final three months, falling short of what analysts have predicted. The pace of growth has fallen from 17.6% in the final quarter of last year to a projection of 11.5% for this year’s fourth quarter. The company blamed its sales shortfall on the advertising business, which is on pace to deliver $300 million less than the company expected. Bloomberg Tech Host Ed Ludlow joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss. He speaks with Alexis Christoforous and Norah Mulinda. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: SpaceX y Tesla comienzan a explorar una posible fusión para impulsar la “superinteligencia”: Musk
items.author: Rick Clough, Ed Ludlow
items.summary: El acuerdo uniría empresas valoradas en cerca de US$2 billones y US$1,5 billones, respectivamente, pero necesitaría la aprobación de los accionistas de Tesla.
items.body: Bloomberg — Elon Musk afirmó que SpaceX ( SPCX ) y Tesla Inc. ( TSLA ) han formado comités especiales para explorar una posible fusión, un paso preliminar hacia lo que se convertiría en la mayor unión corporativa de todos los tiempos. “Creo que la fusión de ambas compañías tiene mucho mérito”, declaró Musk, CEO de ambas, el martes durante la presentación de resultados del fabricante de cohetes. “Estamos prácticamente en la singularidad de la superinteligencia, y hay mucho que ganar cooperando en el desarrollo de software de superinteligencia”. Un acuerdo multimillonario uniría los negocios de vehículos eléctricos, energía y robótica de Tesla con las operaciones de lanzamiento de cohetes e internet satelital de SpaceX. Todo ello se sustenta en las ambiciones compartidas de ambas compañías en inteligencia artificial —o lo que algunos en la industria denominan ahora superinteligencia—, impulsando inversiones en áreas como centros de datos y vehículos autónomos. Ver más: SpaceX supera las previsiones de ganancias impulsada por la IA y el internet por satélite Las acciones de SpaceX subieron un 4,5% en las operaciones posteriores al cierre del mercado tras la publicación de sus resultados trimestrales, mientras que las de Tesla aumentaron un 1%. El alcance de una posible fusión es asombroso, ya que tanto SpaceX como Tesla se encuentran entre las empresas más grandes del mundo y ocupan posiciones dominantes en sus respectivas industrias. SpaceX, anteriormente conocida como Space Exploration Technologies Corp., tiene un valor de mercado de aproximadamente US$2 billones, mientras que Tesla vale casi US$1,5 billones. SpaceX y Tesla ya tienen numerosos vínculos comerciales, bases de inversores superpuestas e incluso personal compartido. El fabricante de cohetes ha comprado Cybertrucks de Tesla por valor de más de US$100 millones, mientras que xAI es un cliente importante de las baterías a gran escala de Tesla. Ver más: Tesla y SpaceX anunciarían una fusión antes de diciembre e integrarían sus tecnologías de IA: Barclays Esta fusión era ampliamente esperada desde que SpaceX, impulsada por el entusiasmo de los inversores, lograra una oferta pública inicial récord este año, lo que le proporcionó liquidez y una aprobación implícita de los accionistas para intentar adquirir Tesla. Bloomberg News informó en enero que SpaceX había sopesado una fusión con Tesla antes de decidirse finalmente por adquirir xAI, la startup de inteligencia artificial de Musk. Musk advirtió que la fusión no es segura y requeriría el apoyo de los accionistas. Explicó que Tesla necesitaría la aprobación del 50% de todos los accionistas, en lugar de simplemente la mayoría de los votantes. “Hay quienes dan por sentado que la fusión entre SpaceX y Tesla es un hecho”, dijo Musk. “Creo que eso sería exagerar”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Greenpeace afirma que desechos fecales contaminan sumideros y pozos de agua en estado mexicano Yucatán
items.author: Iñigo Alexander
items.creator: Iñigo Alexander
items.summary: El agua de pozos y sumideros que los residentes del estado mexicano Yucatán utilizan para beber está contaminada con bacterias fecales, mostró un reporte de Greenpeace publicado el martes, que señaló que las granjas porcinas cercanas y las aguas residuales municipales eran las fuentes probables.
items.body:
El agua de pozos y sumideros que los residentes del estado mexicano Yucatán utilizan para beber está contaminada con bacterias fecales, mostró un reporte de Greenpeace publicado el martes, que señaló que las granjas porcinas cercanas y las aguas residuales municipales eran las fuentes probables.
Greenpeace pidió una moratoria inmediata sobre las nuevas explotaciones ganaderas industriales y las expansiones de granjas en el estado, cuna de la antigua civilización maya.
"Una serie de indicadores químicos y microbiológicos revelan un complejo mosaico de contaminación orgánica grave y localizada", señala el informe.
En agosto, Greenpeace encargó a un laboratorio independiente que analizara el agua en 17 puntos cercanos a Mérida, la capital del estado. Entre los puntos analizados se encontraban pozos domésticos y agrícolas, puntos de agua comunitarios y cenotes, los pozos naturales que salpican la península de Yucatán, uno de los destinos turísticos más populares de México.
Según el informe, todas las muestras presentaban cierto grado de contaminación probablemente relacionada con desechos fecales, y varios sitios parecían estar muy contaminados. Las bacterias coliformes totales alcanzaron el límite máximo de la prueba en 16 de las 17 muestras, y las coliformes fecales lo hicieron en 13.
Sin embargo, las pruebas no permiten determinar si los desechos provienen de personas o animales, y las fugas de fosas sépticas y aguas residuales municipales también pueden contribuir a la contaminación. Greenpeace afirmó que los resultados plantean "cuestiones críticas sobre la responsabilidad" de las granjas porcinas cercanas.
El Gobierno de Yucatán no estuvo disponible para hacer comentarios, mientras que la Comisión Nacional del Agua de México (CONAGUA) no respondió de inmediato a la solicitud de comentarios. La Asociación de Criadores de Cerdos de Mérida tampoco respondió a la solicitud de comentarios de Reuters.
Al no existir ríos superficiales, el agua subterránea es la única fuente de agua dulce de Yucatán, y el lecho rocoso calcáreo poroso de la zona permite que los contaminantes se filtren rápidamente al acuífero. El informe señala que aproximadamente el 30% de los residentes locales beben agua extraída directamente de pozos y sumideros.
Greenpeace, citando un reporte de 2020, dijo que solo 22 de las 257 granjas porcinas de Yucatán contaban con un estudio de impacto ambiental. Además, encontró que 43 de estas granjas operaban dentro de áreas naturales protegidas.
Un informe de la ONU publicado en julio reveló que existen más de 500 granjas porcinas industriales en todo el estado, con más de 50.000 animales, muchas de ellas ubicadas cerca de las tierras y territorios de los pueblos indígenas.
Marcos Orellana, ex relator especial de la ONU y autor del informe, afirmó que los desechos y productos químicos de las granjas industriales "llegan muy rápidamente" al agua que las comunidades utilizan para bañarse, cocinar y beber.
Añadió que la mayoría de las granjas carecen de los permisos necesarios y que las iniciativas de los gobiernos regionales "siguen siendo insuficientes".
"La contaminación de las aguas que han sustentado la cultura maya durante milenios proviene principalmente de las operaciones industriales de cría de animales", dijo Orellana.
Pero Antonio Zumarraga, vicepresidente del Observatorio Científico Ciudadano del Agua de Yucatán, defendió a la industria porcina local, afirmando que el sector ha invertido en el tratamiento del agua y apoya programas de conservación.
Culpó a las autoridades locales por su inacción. "Es un tema que mientras no le pese al gobierno en la parte política, no lo va hacer", señaló Zumarraga.

items.title: Manifestantes pelo direito à moradia em Portugal voltam às praças e prometem continuar pressão
items.author: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
items.creator: Sergio Goncalves, Miguel Pereira
items.summary: Milhares de manifestantes voltaram a duas praças centrais em Lisboa e no Porto nesta terça-feira e prometeram continuar com as manifestações contra a crise imobiliária cada vez mais grave em Portugal, poucas horas depois de a polícia ter desmontado os acampamentos antes do amanhecer e efetuado 55 prisões.
items.body:
Milhares de manifestantes voltaram a duas praças centrais em Lisboa e no Porto nesta terça-feira e prometeram continuar com as manifestações contra a crise imobiliária cada vez mais grave em Portugal, poucas horas depois de a polícia ter desmontado os acampamentos antes do amanhecer e efetuado 55 prisões.
Uma assembleia popular em Lisboa votou na noite desta terça-feira pelo retorno à Praça do Rossio e pela montagem de barracas novamente na quarta-feira.
A cantora Ana Moura se juntou aos manifestantes no local e se apresentou em apoio ao movimento.
Os organizadores afirmaram que mais de 1.000 pessoas se reuniram em cada praça. A polícia não divulgou estimativas sobre o número de participantes.
Debora Miranda, 41 anos, consultora de comunicação, disse à Reuters que se juntou ao protesto na Praça do Rossio para representar as gerações que lutam contra os custos cada vez mais altos. “Se as pessoas não se sentem em casa, em todos os sentidos da palavra, não conseguem seguir em frente com suas vidas... já basta.”
Ativistas ocupavam a Praça do Rossio, em Lisboa, desde sábado, montando cerca de 200 barracas, e a Praça Dom João 1º, no Porto, há cerca de 10 dias.
Os acampamentos espelhavam os protestos por moradia na vizinha Espanha e coincidiram com agitação em países como França, Bélgica e Itália devido ao aumento do custo de vida.
Pouco antes das 6h da manhã, após alertar os manifestantes de que os acampamentos eram ilegais, a polícia lançou operações coordenadas nas duas cidades. Os manifestantes desmontaram suas próprias barracas no Porto, enquanto os policiais esvaziavam a Praça do Rossio.
Carla Valadão, porta-voz do acampamento de Lisboa, descreveu a operação policial como “muito agressiva”.
O superintendente da Polícia de Segurança Pública, Sérgio Soares, disse aos repórteres que o despejo havia sido “calmo, proporcional e adequado, sem nenhuma investida policial”.
Os 55 detidos foram posteriormente liberados, aguardando uma audiência no tribunal de Lisboa na quarta-feira.
Portugal enfrenta uma das piores crises de acessibilidade à moradia da Europa. Os preços de compra mais que dobraram desde 2017 e os aluguéis para novos contratos quase dobraram.
A pressão é mais aguda nas grandes cidades, onde também tem havido oposição ao turismo excessivo e ao influxo dos chamados “nômades digitais”.
Os manifestantes exigem que o governo de centro-direita retire um projeto de lei que facilita os despejos e acaba com os limites máximos de aluguel para novos contratos, o qual foi aprovado em primeira votação no Parlamento com a abstenção do partido de extrema-direita Chega.
Jorge Paixão, de 19 anos, estudante de história, chamou isso de “uma crise social”, afirmando que sua geração precisa da “capacidade de viver com dignidade, constituir família e rejuvenescer Portugal”.

items.title: SpaceX tem salto na receita do trimestre e supera estimativas impulsionada por IA
items.author: Akash Sriram
items.creator: Akash Sriram
items.summary: A SpaceX , de Elon Musk, divulgou nesta terça-feira lucro de terceiro trimestre que superou amplamente as estimativas do mercado, impulsionado por uma receita mais que duas vezes maior graças ao forte crescimento de seus negócios com inteligência artificial. Mas os investimentos da companhia quase triplicaram.
items.body:
A SpaceX (SPCX.O) , de Elon Musk, divulgou nesta terça-feira lucro de terceiro trimestre que superou amplamente as estimativas do mercado, impulsionado por uma receita mais que duas vezes maior graças ao forte crescimento de seus negócios com inteligência artificial. Mas os investimentos da companhia quase triplicaram.
“Estamos em um momento decisivo para a SpaceX nas áreas de lançamentos, conectividade e superinteligência”, disse Musk em conferência com investidores.
A receita no terceiro trimestre disparou 161%, para US$14,58 bilhões nos três meses encerrados em 30 de setembro, em comparação com a estimativa dos analistas de US$12,72 bilhões, de acordo com dados compilados pela LSEG.
A empresa teve lucro líquido de US$4,4 bilhões, contra prejuízo líquido de US$1,1 bilhão no ano anterior e a expectativa dos analistas de lucro de US$1,57 bilhão. Por ação, o lucro foi de 0,45 dólar, de acordo com cálculos do IBES, superando a estimativa média dos analistas de 0,13 dólar.
A receita com IA aumentou mais de nove vezes, chegando a US$7,6 bilhões, principalmente com o aluguel de capacidade computacional; no entanto, a IA consumiu US$16,4 bilhões dos US$19,6 bilhões investidos pela empresa, valor que a SpaceX espera que se mantenha próximo desse nível no futuro próximo.
A SpaceX está gerando receita com IA principalmente por meio do aluguel de capacidade de data center para desenvolvedores como Anthropic, Google e Reflection AI, e não a partir de seus próprios modelos, uma característica mais próxima de um provedor de computação em nuvem do que de uma empresa de IA.
“Com a receita de IA agora sendo a maior linha de negócios, a empresa está rapidamente proporcionando força operacional e alavancagem que se refletirão nos avanços de seus negócios de satélites e lançamentos. Cada vez mais, a força e a diversificação da SpaceX fazem com que uma fusão com a Tesla pareça iminente”, disse Daniel Newman, presidente-executivo do grupo de pesquisa em tecnologia Futurum Group.
O Barclays sugeriu na semana passada que um acordo poderia ser anunciado antes da assembleia anual da Tesla, sendo a SpaceX a provável adquirente, embora nem a empresa, nem Musk tenham se comprometido oficialmente a buscarem um negócio assim.
Os prejuízos operacionais da unidade de IA têm sido elevados, e a SpaceX alertou que serão necessários investimentos contínuos antes que ela possa gerar lucros de forma consistente.
A unidade de internet via satélite, Starlink, continuou a expandir sua base de assinantes, impulsionada por lançamentos adicionais de satélites e por uma gama crescente de serviços para consumidores, empresas, aviação, transporte marítimo e governo.
ASSINANTES DO STARLINK A Starlink atingiu 13,6 milhões de assinantes no terceiro trimestre, acima dos 12,19 milhões esperados pelos analistas, mas o crescimento teve um custo: a receita média mensal por assinante caiu de US$99 em 2023 para US$69 no terceiro trimestre, à medida que a empresa se expande no exterior com planos mais baratos.
A companhia afirmou que a expansão geográfica para além dos países mais ricos poderia reduzir a receita média por usuário ao longo do tempo. Os investidores estão ansiosos para saber se essa pressão sobre os preços já começou a se manifestar, à medida que a SpaceX entra em mais mercados internacionais e lança planos com preços mais baixos.
Os investidores também estão observando se a SpaceX conseguirá continuar crescendo ao mesmo tempo em que melhora a rentabilidade de sua rede. A empresa está realizando grandes investimentos em cobertura, capacidade e serviços de comunicação móvel direto para dispositivos.
O Starship, o sistema de foguetes reutilizáveis de última geração da SpaceX, ainda não entrou em operação comercial. O mercado espera que ele permita a implantação de satélites Starlink com maior largura de banda e de uma infraestrutura orbital de computação com IA. A capacidade da empresa de transformar o Starship em um veículo reutilizável confiável é fundamental para sua estratégia de longo prazo.
CUSTOS DO STARSHIP AUMENTAM A SpaceX lançou com sucesso vários satélites Starlink no mês passado, no primeiro voo de teste orbital do Starship, que terminou horas antes do previsto devido a um problema no motor.
O segmento espacial inclui lançamentos comerciais, missões governamentais e o desenvolvimento do Starship, e continua sendo uma fonte significativa de custos e incertezas.
A atividade de lançamento do foguete Falcon permaneceu robusta, mas a receita pode variar de acordo com a combinação de lançamentos internos do Starlink, missões de clientes comerciais e contratos governamentais.
A SpaceX tem priorizado cada vez mais os lançamentos para sua própria rede de satélites em detrimento de cargas úteis de terceiros, ao mesmo tempo em que absorve custos significativos ligados ao desenvolvimento da Starship.
Os investidores também estarão ansiosos para ouvir os comentários de Musk sobre uma possível fusão muito comentada entre a SpaceX e a Tesla (TSLA.O) , que divulgará seus resultados na quarta-feira.
items.raw_description: A SpaceX , de Elon Musk, divulgou nesta terça-feira lucro de terceiro trimestre que superou amplamente as estimativas do mercado, impulsionado por uma receita mais que duas vezes maior graças ao forte crescimento de seus negócios com inteligência artificial. Mas os investimentos da companhia quase triplicaram.

items.title: UN experts urge Indian authorities to cease 'use of excessive force' to curb protests
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: UN experts called on Tuesday for an independent investigation into Indian authorities' conduct in a recent crackdown on protests, where they said demonstrators had sustained injuries and some reported being subjected to ill-treatment.
items.body:
UN experts called on Tuesday for an independent investigation into Indian authorities' conduct in a recent crackdown on protests , where they said demonstrators had sustained injuries and some reported being subjected to ill-treatment.
Opposition political parties and student organizations have [USN:L4N45Z0IJ TEXT:"held protests"] this month in India demanding Chief Election Commissioner [USN:P8N44T0DC TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar's"] resignation over a revision of voter lists that they say favors Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party.
"Despite the non-violent nature of the assemblies, law enforcement agencies have reportedly deployed force against unarmed students, including lathi charges, and have prevented thousands from joining the protests," the two dozen experts said in a statement , referring to batons used to break up crowds.
"We call on the authorities to immediately cease the use of excessive force, rescind blanket assembly bans, and refrain from the misuse of digital surveillance, including through biometrics, and internet disruptions," they said.
The Indian embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the statement.
India has repeatedly dismissed such criticism and cast it as interference in the country's internal affairs, including when the UN human rights office earlier this month expressed concerns over mass detentions in relation to the latest protests.
Protesting groups say the removal of 130 million names from voter lists led to eligible voters being [USN:L4N46301B TEXT:"disenfranchised"], which disproportionately affected poor and homeless people as well as ethnic minorities including Muslims, who are unlikely to vote for the Hindu nationalist BJP. The BJP and India's Election Commission deny this.
The Election Commission says it was removing duplicate, deceased, shifted and otherwise ineligible voters and that anyone excluded in error can pursue appeals.
The protest crackdown has been condemned by human rights groups like Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch.
UN experts are appointed by the UN Human Rights Council to monitor and document specific human rights crises but are independent of the organization itself.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Pittsburgh Penguins forward Ben Kindel was in stable condition after a medical episode prompted the team's plane to return to Salt Lake City shortly after takeoff on Tuesday, the NHL team said.
items.body:
Pittsburgh Penguins forward Ben Kindel was in stable condition after a medical episode prompted the team's plane to return to Salt Lake City shortly after takeoff on Tuesday, the NHL team said.
Kindel, 19, was attended to by team physician Dharmesh Vyas and other medical staff on board before being taken by ambulance to the University of Utah Hospital for further evaluation, the Penguins said in a statement.
The team said Kindel was conscious and alert and that it would provide further updates when appropriate.
The Penguins were returning to Pittsburgh after a 5-4 loss to the Utah Mammoth on Monday, their fourth consecutive defeat, before hosting the Florida Panthers on Thursday.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El gigante mexicano de las telecomunicaciones América Móvil anunció el martes que sus beneficios del tercer trimestre aumentaron un 7% con respecto al año anterior, aunque no alcanzaron las previsiones de los analistas.
items.body:
El gigante mexicano de las telecomunicaciones América Móvil (AMXB.MX) anunció el martes que sus beneficios del tercer trimestre aumentaron un 7% con respecto al año anterior, aunque no alcanzaron las previsiones de los analistas.
América Móvil, controlada por la familia del multimillonario mexicano Carlos Slim, registró un beneficio neto de 24,280 millones de pesos (1,340 millones de dólares) a partir de unos ingresos que aumentaron con respecto al año anterior hasta alcanzar los 250,630 millones de pesos (13,860 millones de dólares).
Los analistas encuestados por LSEG habían pronosticado que América Móvil registraría un beneficio neto en dólares de 1,510 millones a partir de unos ingresos de 14,050 millones de dólares.
(1 dólar = 18.0808 pesos mexicanos a finales de septiembre)
