items.title: LATAM dice aumento de capacidad se perfila hacia límite inferior previsto por elevado precio combustible
items.author: Kylie Madry
items.creator: Kylie Madry
items.summary: LATAM Airlines prevé que el aumento de su capacidad este año se sitúe en la parte inferior del rango previsto tras reducir parte de la oferta en respuesta al alto precio del combustible para aviones, dijo el martes a Reuters su CEO, Roberto Alvo, lo que indica una senda de expansión más cautelosa para el mayor grupo aéreo regional.
items.body:
LATAM Airlines prevé que el aumento de su capacidad este año se sitúe en la parte inferior del rango previsto tras reducir parte de la oferta en respuesta al alto precio del combustible para aviones, dijo el martes a Reuters su CEO, Roberto Alvo, lo que indica una senda de expansión más cautelosa para el mayor grupo aéreo regional.
La aerolínea anunció en agosto que preveía un alza de capacidad del 9-10% interanual en 2026 y un EBITDA ajustado de entre 4.100 y 4.400 millones de dólares.
"Hemos cancelado algo más de capacidad debido a los altos precios del combustible", dijo Alvo en una entrevista al margen de la conferencia de la Asociación Latinoamericana y Caribeña de Transporte Aéreo.
Según explicó, el modelo de LATAM se mantiene sólido gracias al estricto control de costos y a los mayores ingresos por primas, aunque el grupo, al igual que otras aerolíneas, no ha podido trasladar a los pasajeros la totalidad del avance del costo de combustible.
Alvo afirmó que la firma consume entre 36 y 38 millones de barriles anuales de combustible para aviones, lo que significa que una variación de 10 dólares por barril se traduce en un impacto económico anual de aproximadamente 370 millones de dólares.
Según explicó, los cálculos en los que se basaban las previsiones anteriores de la compañía ya implicaban unos 1.700 millones de dólares en costos adicionales de combustible para el año, y que el impacto había aumentado ligeramente desde entonces, ya que los precios del cuarto trimestre se mantuvieron por encima de esas estimaciones.
Alvo afirmó que el impulso de LATAM hacia el tráfico premium de mayor rentabilidad era una estrategia a largo plazo, más que una respuesta a corto plazo a la crisis del combustible, basada en inversiones en cabinas, salones, servicio a bordo, conectividad y una experiencia del cliente más amplia.
También dijo que la firma estaba interesada en estudiar ofrecer servicios a otras ciudades mexicanas, como los centros de negocios de Guadalajara y Monterrey, aunque dichas rutas dependerían en parte de la disponibilidad de aeronaves.
Alvo dijo que esas oportunidades podrían volverse más viables a medida que LATAM comience a recibir aviones Airbus A321XLR (AIR.PA) a partir del próximo año.

items.title: Paris game to go forward with heightened security amid unrest
items.author: Amy Tennery
items.creator: Amy Tennery
items.summary: A game between the Pittsburgh Steelers and the New Orleans Saints in Paris on Sunday will go ahead as planned with ramped up security, the NFL said on Tuesday, after a weekend of violence that engulfed the French capital.
items.body:
A game between the Pittsburgh Steelers and the New Orleans Saints in Paris on Sunday will go ahead as planned with ramped up security, the NFL said on Tuesday, after a weekend of violence that engulfed the French capital.
French officials will mount a "massive" security operation for protests planned on Saturday, with troops reinforcing police, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said [USN:S8N42Q0F9 TEXT:"on Tuesday"], after rioting and looting swept through Paris and other French cities on October 17.
"We always have a very strong security presence," said Peter O'Reilly, the NFL's executive vice president of club business, international and league events.
"That presence will be heightened with local authorities (as we are) making sure that there's nothing more important from our standpoint than team security, fan security (and) everybody involved with this game."
The Steelers-Saints game will take place at the Stade de France. It is the first regular season game that the league has ever held in the French capital, part of a [USN:L6N44U08L TEXT:"record nine-game slate"] of international matches this season, as the NFL eyes lucrative [USN:L6N41R14V TEXT:"global markets"].
O'Reilly said that the NFL is considering adding a 10th international game to the season beginning in 2027.
The violence over the weekend, some of the [USN:L8N46401O TEXT:"worst unrest"] France has suffered in years, followed weeks of largely peaceful [USN:L8N45U0FD TEXT:"student demonstrations"] over school conditions and the cost of living. French authorities instituted curfews in several cities [USN:FWN4630KA TEXT:"on Monday"].
NFL officials have been on the ground in Paris for 10 days, O'Reilly told reporters.
"We feel confident that we would not have any impact on the broader resources needed," he said. "That's always top of mind for us and we feel confident that we wouldn't be depleting resources in a negative way around this game."

items.title: Lobbyist sues over ban from consumer product agency, cites law firms' wins in Trump cases
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: A Washington lobbyist sued the US Consumer Product Safety Commission and its acting chairman on Tuesday, alleging the agency unlawfully barred him from its facilities and retaliated against him over his work for clients.
items.body:
A Washington lobbyist sued the US Consumer Product Safety Commission and its acting chairman on Tuesday, alleging the agency unlawfully barred him from its facilities and retaliated against him over his work for clients.
Lobbyist Edward Krenik said in his lawsuit in Washington federal court that the consumer product agency accused him of “disruptive” behavior and declared him a threat without justification.
Krenik, represented by the conservative-leaning New Civil Liberties Alliance, said a series of rulings against President Donald Trump’s administration bolstered his retaliation claims.
He pointed to [USN:L2N3S00O8 TEXT:"court rulings issued last year"] that blocked White House executive orders targeting four law firms and restricted their ability to interact with federal agencies. Krenik also cited another DC federal [USN:L1N46002Z TEXT:"judge’s order"] commanding the White House to restore access to CNN and several other media outlets.
The consumer product agency had no immediate comment.
Kara Rollins, a lawyer for Krenik, said in a statement, "the right to petition keeps government answerable to the governed, and it means nothing if officials can banish those with whom they disagree.”
Krenik, who owns and operates the government affairs firm NorthStar EK LLC, has been a registered lobbyist for more than 23 years. He previously worked as an aide to lawmakers on Capitol Hill.
His lawsuit said most of his current work involves advocacy for manufacturers and trade associations before the consumer product agency. He said that on an unnamed client's behalf he had urged Peter Feldman, the agency’s acting chairman, to take certain actions, and had told Feldman he was authorized to take the client's concerns to the White House.
The lawsuit said the White House later contacted Feldman and “admonished” him, and that he was told in August that he was prohibited from entering any Consumer Product Safety Commission building.
Krenik said a consumer product agency official had accused him in August without evidence of “repeated abusive and disruptive behavior,” including "attempts to contact staff using improper and unauthorized communication channels.”
The lawsuit said Krenik as a private lobbyist has no legal obligation to use any specific communication method when contacting a government official.
The case is Edward Krenik v. Peter A. Feldman et al, US District Court for the District of Columbia, No.
For plaintiff: Kara Rollins and Christian Clase of New Civil Liberties Alliance
For defendants: No appearances yet
Read more:
[USN:L1N46002Z TEXT:"Judge extends White House access for CNN, MS NOW, Politico amid legal fight"]
[USN:L6N44F0U5 TEXT:"Trump invokes presidential privilege in lawsuit over law firm orders"]
[USN:S0N3SG00I TEXT:"US Supreme Court lets Trump remove consumer product safety commissioners"]
[USN:L2N3S00O8 TEXT:"What Republican, Democratic judges said about Trump’s law firm orders"]

items.title: Hedge fund Sachem Head sees room for Ionic shares to surge
items.author: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.summary: Hedge fund Sachem Head Capital Management said on Tuesday it believes Ionic Digital's stock price can more than double as the former bitcoin miner shifts into digital infrastructure leasing, amid exploding demand for data center power.
items.body:
Hedge fund Sachem Head Capital Management said on Tuesday it believes Ionic Digital's (IOND.O) stock price can more than double as the former bitcoin miner shifts into digital infrastructure leasing, amid exploding demand for data center power.
Ionic was formed out of the bankruptcy restructuring of crypto lender Celsius Network and started trading in July on the Nasdaq stock exchange, where shares are worth around $63.
But there is room for the share price to surge to $151 a share, gaining nearly 140%, Sachem Head founder Scott Ferguson said at the 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York.
Sachem Head, along with Oaktree Capital Management and Attestor Capital, participated in a $400 million private placement in June and owns nearly 10% of the company.
Sachem Head owns roughly 9.9% of Ionic and Ferguson said the firm will make a regulatory filing to detail its ownership with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday.
Ionic already holds a 10-year triple-net lease in Texas' Ward County with a possible 10 year extension with Nscale, a London-based, vertically integrated AI infrastructure and neocloud company that operates high-density GPU (Graphics Processing Unit) data centers and cloud platforms.
Microsoft is the end customer for this site, Ferguson said.
An expansion in Ward County and sites in Midland, Texas would help the stock price gain further, he said.
"We think management is pretty good," Ferguson said, adding however that his firm, which from time to time pushes target companies to make changes, may become more involved at the company.

items.title: スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収　ＡＩ事業拡大で黒字転換
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸが２０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、ＡＩ（人工知能）事業の急拡大で売上高が２倍超となり、利益が市場予想を大幅に上回った。株価は引け後の時間外取引で２．５％上昇した。

計算処理インフラへの投資に伴い、設備投資額は約３倍に膨らんだ。

マスク氏は投資家向け電話会議で「スペースＸは打ち上げ、通信、超知能の各分野で転換点を迎えている」と述べた。

衛星インターネット事業「スターリンク」をはじめとする通信事業は同社の主な収益源で、マスク氏のＡＩ構想を支えてきた。ただ、ｘＡＩの「Ｇｒｏｋ（グロック）」を含むスペースＸ独自のＡＩソフトウエアはこれまで、競合のオープンＡＩ、アンソロピック、アルファベット傘下のグーグルの後塵を拝している。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比１６１％増の１４５億８０００万ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の１２７億２０００万ドルを上回った。純損益は４４億ドルの黒字となり、前年同期の１１億ドルの赤字から黒字に転換。市場予想の１５億７０００万ドルの黒字も上回った。ＩＢＥＳの計算による１株利益は０．４５ドルで、予想平均の０．１３ドルを上回った。

ＡＩ事業の売上高は９倍超の７６億ドルに拡大し、大半を計算処理能力の貸し出しで稼いだ。一方、同事業への設備投資は全社の１９６億ドルのうち１６４億ドルを占めた。同社は当面、設備投資がこの水準近辺で推移すると見込んでいる。

テクノロジー調査会社フューチャラム・グループのダニエル・ニューマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「ＡＩが売上高で同社最大の事業となる中、ハイパースケール事業が急速に営業面での強さとレバレッジを提供しており、衛星・打ち上げ事業の進展にもつながるだろう。スペースＸの事業基盤の強化と多角化が進むにつれ、テスラとの合併が間近に迫っているように感じられる」と述べた。

スペースＸのＡＩ事業はグロック、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）のＸ、急成長するデータセンター事業で構成される。アンソロピック、グーグル、リフレクションＡＩとの計算処理能力の提供契約から収益を得ている。  

ＡＩ部門は多額の営業赤字を計上しており、スペースＸは安定的に利益を生み出せるようになるまで継続的な投資が必要になると注意を促している。

スターリンクの第３・四半期の加入者数は１３６０万人と、アナリスト予想の１２１９万人を上回った。ただ、成長には代償も伴っている。海外で低価格プランを展開する中、加入者１人当たりの月間平均売上高は２０２３年の９９ドルから第３・四半期には６９ドルに低下した。

items.body:
スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収　ＡＩ事業拡大で黒字転換
5:23 配信

６月１１日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸが２０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、ＡＩ（人工知能）事業の急拡大で売上高が２倍超となり、利益が市場予想を大幅に上回った。株価は引け後の時間外取引で２．５％上昇した。

計算処理インフラへの投資に伴い、設備投資額は約３倍に膨らんだ。

マスク氏は投資家向け電話会議で「スペースＸは打ち上げ、通信、超知能の各分野で転換点を迎えている」と述べた。

衛星インターネット事業「スターリンク」をはじめとする通信事業は同社の主な収益源で、マスク氏のＡＩ構想を支えてきた。ただ、ｘＡＩの「Ｇｒｏｋ（グロック）」を含むスペースＸ独自のＡＩソフトウエアはこれまで、競合のオープンＡＩ、アンソロピック、アルファベット傘下のグーグルの後塵を拝している。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比１６１％増の１４５億８０００万ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の１２７億２０００万ドルを上回った。純損益は４４億ドルの黒字となり、前年同期の１１億ドルの赤字から黒字に転換。市場予想の１５億７０００万ドルの黒字も上回った。ＩＢＥＳの計算による１株利益は０．４５ドルで、予想平均の０．１３ドルを上回った。

ＡＩ事業の売上高は９倍超の７６億ドルに拡大し、大半を計算処理能力の貸し出しで稼いだ。一方、同事業への設備投資は全社の１９６億ドルのうち１６４億ドルを占めた。同社は当面、設備投資がこの水準近辺で推移すると見込んでいる。

テクノロジー調査会社フューチャラム・グループのダニエル・ニューマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「ＡＩが売上高で同社最大の事業となる中、ハイパースケール事業が急速に営業面での強さとレバレッジを提供しており、衛星・打ち上げ事業の進展にもつながるだろう。スペースＸの事業基盤の強化と多角化が進むにつれ、テスラとの合併が間近に迫っているように感じられる」と述べた。

スペースＸのＡＩ事業はグロック、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）のＸ、急成長するデータセンター事業で構成される。アンソロピック、グーグル、リフレクションＡＩとの計算処理能力の提供契約から収益を得ている。  

ＡＩ部門は多額の営業赤字を計上しており、スペースＸは安定的に利益を生み出せるようになるまで継続的な投資が必要になると注意を促している。

スターリンクの第３・四半期の加入者数は１３６０万人と、アナリスト予想の１２１９万人を上回った。ただ、成長には代償も伴っている。海外で低価格プランを展開する中、加入者１人当たりの月間平均売上高は２０２３年の９９ドルから第３・四半期には６９ドルに低下した。

items.title: Fecal waste contaminates sinkholes, drinking wells in Mexico's Yucatan, Greenpeace says
items.author: Iñigo Alexander
items.creator: Iñigo Alexander
items.summary: Water from wells and sinkholes in Mexico's Yucatan state that residents use for drinking is contaminated with fecal bacteria, according to a Greenpeace report published on Tuesday, which said nearby pig farms and municipal wastewater were likely sources.
items.body:
Water from wells and sinkholes in Mexico's Yucatan state that residents use for drinking is contaminated with fecal bacteria, according to a Greenpeace report published on Tuesday, which said nearby pig farms and municipal wastewater were likely sources.
Greenpeace called for an immediate moratorium on new industrial livestock operations and farm expansions in the state, home to the ancient Maya civilization.
"A range of chemical and microbiological indicators reveal a complex mosaic of severe, localized organic pollution," it said.
Greenpeace commissioned an independent laboratory to test water at 17 sites near the state capital Merida in August. The sites included household and farm wells, community water points and cenotes, the natural sinkholes that dot the Yucatan peninsula, one of Mexico's most popular tourist destinations.
According to the report, every sample showed some degree of contamination likely linked to fecal waste, and several sites appeared heavily polluted. Total coliform bacteria reached the test's upper limit in 16 of 17 samples, and fecal coliforms did so in 13.
However, the tests cannot show whether the waste came from people or animals, and leaking septic tanks and municipal sewage may also contribute to contamination. Greenpeace said the results raise "critical accountability questions" about nearby pig farms.
The Yucatan state government was not available for comment, while Mexico's national water commission, CONAGUA, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Merida's Association of Pig Farmers also did not respond to Reuters' request for comment.
With no above-ground rivers, groundwater is the Yucatan's only freshwater source, and the area's porous limestone bedrock allows pollutants to quickly seep down into the aquifer. The report said about 30% of local residents drink water drawn directly from wells and sinkholes.
Greenpeace, citing its 2020 survey, said only 22 of 257 pig farms in Yucatan had an environmental impact study in place. It also found 43 such farms operating inside protected natural areas.
A UN report published in July found that there are over 500 industrial pig farms across Yucatan state with over 50,000 animals, many located near the lands and territories of Indigenous Peoples.
Marcos Orellana, the former UN Special Rapporteur who authored the report, said waste and chemicals from industrial farms "find their way very quickly" to water that communities use for bathing, cooking and drinking. He said most farms lack required permits and that regional government initiatives "remain insufficient."
"The contamination of the waters that have sustained Mayan culture for millennia is predominantly coming from the industrial operations of the growth of animals," Orellana said.
But Antonio Zumarraga, vice president of the Yucatan Citizen Scientific Water Observatory, defended the local pork industry, saying the sector has invested in water treatment and supports conservation programs. He blamed local authorities for lack of action.
"It's an issue that, as long as it doesn't carry political weight for the government, they won't do anything about it," Zumarraga said.

items.title: SpaceX Q3 revenue soars 161% YoY on AI business growth, beating estimates
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX on Tuesday reported a 161% rise in revenue for the third quarter, beating estimates, buoyed by a surge in its AI business and steady growth at its Starlink
items.body: Elon Musk’s SpaceX registered a 161% year-on-year surge in third-quarter revenue, beating analyst estimates, driven by a surge in its artificial intelligence business and steady growth in its Starlink satellite-internet unit, Reuters reported.Revenue rose to $14.6 billion in the quarter, well above analysts’ estimate of $12.72 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.Starlink and SpaceX’s broader connectivity operations remain the company’s primary revenue drivers, helping fund CEO Musk’s AI ambitions. However, SpaceX’s AI software offerings, including xAI’s Grok, have yet to match the traction of rivals such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.For live updates on US Markets, click hereSpaceX generates most of its AI revenue by leasing data-centre computing capacity to developers, including Anthropic, Google and Reflection AI, rather than relying on its own AI models. This makes the business more akin to a cloud-computing provider than a traditional AI developer.Its AI operations span Grok, the social-media platform X and an expanding data-centre business, which has also become the company's largest investment area. Revenue comes from computing contracts with Anthropic, Google, owned by Alphabet, and Reflection AI.However, the AI division continues to incur substantial operating losses. SpaceX has warned that significant, sustained spending will be necessary before the business can achieve consistent profitability.Meanwhile, Starlink continues to add subscribers, supported by further satellite launches and an expanding portfolio of services for consumers, businesses, airlines, maritime operators and government agencies.SpaceX has warned that expanding into markets beyond wealthier countries could bring down its average revenue per user over time. Investors are monitoring whether this pressure is beginning to emerge as the company enters more international markets and introduces cheaper subscription plans.Another key concern is whether SpaceX can sustain its growth while improving network profitability. The company continues to invest heavily in expanding coverage, increasing capacity and developing direct-to-device mobile connectivity services.Meanwhile, Starship, SpaceX’s next-generation reusable rocket system, has yet to begin commercial operations. The vehicle is expected to help deploy more advanced, higher-bandwidth Starlink satellites and support AI-computing infrastructure in orbit. Achieving reliable, repeated reuse of Starship remains a crucial part of SpaceX’s long-term strategy.SpaceX deployed several Starlink satellites last month during Starship’s first orbital test flight, which ended earlier than planned following an engine problem.The company’s space operations cover commercial launches, government missions and the development of Starship, making the segment a major source of expenditure and uncertainty. While Falcon rocket launches have remained strong, revenue fluctuates depending on the balance between internal Starlink deployments, commercial launches and government contracts.SpaceX has increasingly prioritised launches for its own satellite network over missions carrying third-party payloads, while continuing to shoulder substantial costs associated with Starship’s development.Investors will also be watching for comments from CEO Elon Musk on a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla, a widely discussed possibility. Tesla is scheduled to report its results on Wednesday.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: 米ネトフリ、第4四半期利益見通しが市場予想下回る　時間外で株価5％超安
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lisa Richwine

[ロサンゼルス　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Lisa Richwine

[ロサンゼルス　２０日　ロイター] - 米動画配信サービス大手ネットフリックスが２０日公表した第４・四半期（１０─１２月）の利益見通しは市場予想を下回った。同社は数日前、全従業員の６％に当たる人員削減と、番組編成部門の幹部２人の交代を発表し、成長の再加速に向けた動きを強めていた。

株価は時間外取引で５％超下落し、６８．６９ドルとなった。

第４・四半期の純利益見通しは２７億９０００万ドル、１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しは０．６７ドルと、アナリスト予想平均の３０億７０００万ドル、０．７３ドルをそれぞれ下回った。

併せて発表した第３・四半期の売上高は１１．８％増の１２８億７０００万ドルと市場予想と一致したものの、伸び率は約３年ぶりの低水準となった。一方、１株利益は０．８７ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の０．８２ドルを上回った。

２０２６年の広告収入見通しは約３０億ドルから約２７億ドルに引き下げた。経営陣は四半期の株主向け書簡で、広告商品の一部機能の導入が想定よりやや遅れたと説明した。

約２０年前にテレビ番組や映画の配信を始め、ハリウッドに変革をもたらした同社は現在、視聴が急増するユーチューブやＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）との競争に直面。こうした中、新たな視聴者を獲得し、会員の利用時間を伸ばすため、ビデオゲームやポッドキャスト、ライブイベントに投資してきた。

ウォール街のアナリストからは、同社がどのように成長を再加速させるのか疑問の声が上がっている。

ＰＰフォーサイトのアナリスト、パオロ・ペスカトーレ氏は「ネットフリックスは引き続き効率的に運営され、高い収益力を持つ企業だが、本来不要な取り組みに手を広げすぎている」と指摘。「基本に立ち返り、魅力的なコンテンツに注力する必要がある」と述べた。

ネットフリックスは決算発表で、外部コンテンツのライセンス取得を増やし、配信作品を引き続き拡充する方針を示した。その上で、経営陣は株主向け書簡で、テレビ番組、映画、ライブイベントの配信という中核サービスに注力し、「話題を呼び、会員を増やし、われわれを『欠かせない』サービスにする」オリジナル番組に投資すると説明した。

同社は先週、全従業員の６％に相当する約１０００人を削減すると発表した。また、チーフクリエーティブオフィサー（ＣＣＯ）のベラ・バジャリア氏を交代させ、映画部門責任者のダン・リン氏も退任すると明らかにし、番組編成戦略を立て直す姿勢を示した。

items.title: LATAM says capacity growth tracking to lower end of guidance as fuel stays high
items.author: Kylie Madry
items.creator: Kylie Madry
items.summary: LATAM Airlines expects capacity growth this year to come in at the lower end of its forecast range after trimming some supply in response to high jet fuel prices, Chief Executive Roberto Alvo told Reuters on Tuesday, signaling a more cautious expansion path for Latin America's largest airline group.
items.body:
LATAM Airlines expects capacity growth this year to come in at the lower end of its forecast range after trimming some supply in response to [USN:L6N45U0HS TEXT:"high jet fuel prices"], Chief Executive Roberto Alvo told Reuters on Tuesday, signaling a more cautious expansion path for Latin America's largest airline group.
LATAM said in August it expected [USN:S0N42V03A TEXT:"2026 capacity growth"] of 9% to 10% year over year, and adjusted core earnings of $4.1 billion to $4.4 billion. Alvo said the airline was still tracking within that range, but closer to the bottom end as elevated fuel prices forced some adjustments to planned flying.
"We have canceled a little more capacity because of high fuel prices," Alvo said in an interview on the sidelines of the Latin American & Caribbean Air Transport Association conference.
He said LATAM's model remained resilient because of strict cost controls and stronger premium revenue, even if the group, [USN:L1N46603J TEXT:"like other airlines"], has been unable to pass through all of the jump in fuel costs to passengers.
Alvo said LATAM consumes about 36 million to 38 million barrels of jet fuel a year, meaning a $10-per-barrel move in prices translates into roughly a $370 million annual cost impact.
He said the assumptions behind the company's previous guidance already implied about $1.7 billion in additional fuel costs for the year, and that the hit had since grown somewhat as fourth-quarter prices remained above those assumptions.
Alvo said LATAM's push toward higher-yield premium traffic was a long-term strategy rather than a short-term response to the fuel shock, built on investments in cabins, lounges, onboard service, connectivity and broader customer experience.
He also said LATAM was interested in [USN:L1N46503M TEXT:"studying service"] to additional Mexican cities such as business hubs Guadalajara and Monterrey, although such routes would depend in part on aircraft availability.
Alvo said those opportunities could become more viable as LATAM starts receiving Airbus (AIR.PA) A321XLR jets from next year.

O Dow subiu 1% nesta terça-feira, superando o índice de referência S&P 500, enquanto o setor de saúde foi o que mais impulsionou Wall Street e o de tecnologia foi o que mais prejudicou o mercado.
O setor de saúde (.SPXHC) liderou os ganhos entre os 11 principais índices setoriais do S&P 500, atingindo uma máxima recorde. A Eli Lilly (LLY.N) foi a empresa que mais contribuiu para o índice S&P 500, enquanto a UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , a MSD & Co (MRK.N) , a Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) e a Amgen (AMGN.O) ajudaram a impulsionar o índice Dow Jones de blue chips.
As quedas nas ações de megacapitalização puxaram para baixo o setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) , enquanto as ações do setor de energia (.SPNY) tiveram desempenho inferior, já que os preços do petróleo caíram após atingirem o maior nível em cinco meses. Os operadores do mercado de petróleo avaliavam uma reunião entre o presidente iraniano e o chefe do Exército do Paquistão — um importante mediador entre os EUA e o Irã —, em contraste com os ataques houthis à infraestrutura saudita e relatos de ataques a embarcações no Golfo.
AÇÕES DO SETOR DE TECNOLOGIA DÃO UMA PAUSA Embora o setor de tecnologia de grande peso (.SPLRCT) tenha recuado 0,3%, esse foi o maior fator de queda em pontos do índice S&P 500 e manteve o Nasdaq praticamente estável. As ações de tecnologia haviam se recuperado na segunda-feira após uma onda de vendas na semana passada, quando os investidores se preocuparam com os altos custos de gastos e financiamento para desenvolvimentos em IA.
“Os investidores em ações ainda estão um pouco céticos em relação ao setor de IA e à capacidade de algumas dessas empresas de monetizar seus investimentos, então estamos vendo uma certa rotação para outras áreas do mercado”, disse Jim Baird, diretor de investimentos da Plante Moran Financial Advisors, apontando para os avanços registrados nesta terça-feira nas empresas de pequena capitalização e do setor de saúde.
“Os investidores estão buscando outras oportunidades fora do setor de tecnologia, e o setor de saúde é um dos beneficiários disso”, disse ele.
O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 1,02%, para 52.495,88 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançou 0,28%, para 7.712,57 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) teve variação negativa de 0,02%, para 26.424,82 pontos.
O índice de valor do S&P 500 (.IVX) subiu 0,9%, em comparação com uma queda de 0,2% em seu equivalente de crescimento (.IGX) . O índice Russell 2000 de pequenas capitalizações (.RUT) fechou com alta de 1,7%.
Com um ganho de 1%, o setor de serviços financeiros (.SPSY) foi o segundo maior impulsionador do índice S&P 500. Os setores defensivos também tiveram desempenho superior, com o setor imobiliário (.SPLRCR) subindo 1,7% e o de serviços públicos (.SPLRCU) registrando alta de 1,2%.
Uma queda de 1,7% na Netflix, um recuo de 1,6% na Meta (META.O) e uma perda de 1% na Alphabet, controladora do Google (GOOGL.O) , fizeram com que o índice de serviços de comunicação caísse 0,9%.
A SpaceX (SPCX.O) divulgou, após o fechamento do mercado, um lucro no terceiro trimestre que superou as estimativas, impulsionando suas ações em 4% no pós-mercado.
A Netflix (NFLX.O) divulgou, após o fechamento do mercado, uma previsão de lucro para o quarto trimestre abaixo do esperado, e suas ações caíam 6%.
A Meta e a Tesla (TSLA.O) devem divulgar seus resultados na quarta-feira.
As ações da General Motors (GM.N) tombaram 6,8% depois que a montadora sinalizou pressão nos próximos meses devido ao aumento dos custos das matérias-primas e à queda nas vendas de caminhões.
A 3M (MMM.N) ssubiu 5,8% depois que a empresa anunciou que estava ampliando sua parceria de data centers com a Amazon (AMZN.O) e emitiu um warrant a uma subsidiária da Amazon para a compra de ações ordinárias da 3M no valor de mais de US$521 milhões. O conglomerado industrial também elevou sua previsão de lucro para o ano inteiro.
A empresa de relatórios de crédito Equifax (EFX.N) disparou 11,3% após divulgar lucro no terceiro trimestre acima das estimativas dos analistas. As ações da Hasbro (HAS.O) saltaram 11,2% depois que a fabricante de brinquedos elevou sua previsão para o ano inteiro tanto para a receita geral quanto para seu negócio de jogos digitais.

items.title: 米国株式市場＝ダウ主導で上昇、ヘルスケア株に買い　ナスダック横ばい
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

超大型株の下落で通信サービス指数は値下がりした。原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後に下落したことを受け、エネルギー指数もさえない値動きとなった。原油市場では、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。

情報技術指数の下落率は０．３％にとどまったが、構成比率が大きいため、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種への最大の圧迫要因となり、ナスダック総合もほぼ横ばいに抑えられた。ハイテク株は先週、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発を巡る巨額の支出や資金調達コストへの懸念から売られたが、１９日には反発していた。

プラント・モラン・ファイナンシャル・アドバイザーズのジム・ベアード最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は、この日の小型株やヘルスケアなどの上昇に言及し、「株式投資家はＡＩ関連投資や、一部企業が投資を収益化できるかどうかについて、依然としてやや懐疑的だ。そのため、市場の他の分野に資金が移る動きが見られる」と指摘。「投資家はハイテク以外の投資機会を探しており、ヘルスケアはその恩恵を受ける分野の一つだ」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００バリュー指数は０．９％上昇した一方、グロース指数は０．２％下落した。小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は１．７％高で取引を終えた。

金融指数は１％上昇。ディフェンシブ業種も堅調で、不動産は１．７％、公益事業は１．２％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは１．７％、メタ・プラットフォームズは１．６％、グーグルの親会社アルファベットは１％それぞれ下落し、通信サービス指数は０．９％安となった。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

複合企業のスリーエム（３Ｍ）は５．８％上昇した。アマゾン・ドット・コムとのデータセンター事業での提携拡大を発表し、アマゾン子会社に対し、５億２１００万ドル超相当の３Ｍ普通株を購入できる新株予約権を発行した。通期利益見通しも引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数の比率が２．０４対１だった。ナスダックでも２．０２対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５９億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億５０００万株。

items.title: Lyon omission in the spotlight as Australia seamers endure tough day
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia quick Mitchell Starc claimed his 450th test wicket on Tuesday but South Africa's lower order exposed the tourists' decision to omit spinner Nathan Lyon on day three of the second test.
items.body:
Australia quick Mitchell Starc claimed his 450th test wicket on Tuesday but South Africa's lower order exposed the tourists' decision to omit spinner Nathan Lyon on day three of the second test.
Starc became only the 10th bowler to reach the milestone when Wiaan Mulder gloved a rising delivery from the 36-year-old to Matt Renshaw as South Africa slipped to 110-6.
The home side then turned the tables, seeing off the all-seam attack and the back-up part-timers and making the absence of Lyon more pronounced as they went on to score 425-9 before declaring.
It did not help that Josh Hazlewood, who took a career-best 6-49 in helping Australia to an emphatic 214-run victory in last week’s first test, could only bowl after lunch.
He was sick on Monday, which meant he had to serve his time in the field on Tuesday before being allowed to bowl.
He made little impact in nine overs, however, while captain Pat Cummins went wicketless and Starc finished with 3-89.
Scott Boland, who replaced Lyon in the team, took his first five-wicket haul outside of Australia, but the tourists had to use Beau Webster to hold up an end and also turned to three other part-time spinners as South Africa piled on the runs.
Lyon would have arguably done a better job of stemming South Africa's free scoring on a day when captain Temba Bavuma notched a career-best 179 to give the hosts the upper hand.
"If you know you're going to be a man down from the start, you’re probably going with a different make-up, aren’t you?” Starc said.
"But unfortunately Josh had a dodgy prawn or something. He'll have fresh legs for the second innings."
Lyon was left to play a supporting role from the sidelines.
"He's been around long enough to put his shoes back on and be the team man that he is. He was that man for most of the day today, whether it's down at fine leg running us drinks or tapping us on the back.
"I’ve been left out plenty of times and naturally you're disappointed that you don't get to play. He'll get another opportunity," added Starc.

Oct 20 : Australia quick Mitchell Starc claimed his 450th test wicket on Tuesday but South Africa's lower order exposed the tourists' decision to omit spinner Nathan Lyon on day three of the second test.
Starc became only the 10th bowler to reach the milestone when Wiaan Mulder gloved a rising delivery from the 36-year-old to Matt Renshaw as South Africa slipped to 110-6.
The home side then turned the tables, seeing off the all-seam attack and the back-up part-timers and making the absence of Lyon more pronounced as they went on to score 425-9 before declaring.
It did not help that Josh Hazlewood, who took a career-best 6-49 in helping Australia to an emphatic 214-run victory in last week’s first test, could only bowl after lunch.

Oct 20 : Elon Musk said on Tuesday that a merger of his two companies SpaceX and Tesla would be "a good idea" and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union, sending shares of the space and technology company up 4.9 per cent in extended trading.
The company earlier posted its first profit as a public company and Musk said it was tracking an annual revenue run rate of up to $1 trillion.
Musk has in the past tantalized shareholders with the idea, citing growing overlap between the companies. Speculation about SpaceX buying the EV maker has gained traction recently, with Barclays suggesting last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting in December.
"I think it would be a good idea, but it's really up to the special committees of both companies," Musk said in the first official confirmation that the companies were formally talking. "Because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussion of the special committees," he told investors on a conference call. Shareholders ultimately would need to approve a deal, he added.

SpaceX's revenue climbed 161 per cent to $14.58 billion for the three months ended September 30 from a year earlier. AI revenue surged by almost 10 times to $7.56 billion, mostly from renting out data-center capacity to developers such as Anthropic, Alphabet's Google and Reflection AI rather than from its own models.
"We are in an inflection moment for SpaceX across launch, connectivity and superintelligence," Musk said on the call. He ended his portion of prepared remarks with a seemingly off-script remark: "In a nutshell, what this implies for SpaceX annual recurring revenue by the end of '27 is somewhere between $500 billion and a trillion."
The third quarter offered the clearest evidence yet that SpaceX’s heavy investment in AI is translating into revenue, even as spending on compute infrastructure remains enormous — capital expenses nearly tripled.
The shift is reshaping a company whose financial engine has long been its Starlink internet services business and whose longer-term ambitions still hinge on getting Starship rockets into regular service. For now, though, its main business looks closer to a cloud provider's than an AI lab's.
AI REVENUE DRIVES SPACEX TRANSFORMATION
SpaceX's chief financial officer, Bret Johnsen, reiterated that SpaceX expects annual recurring revenue of about $100 billion by the end of 2026.
He said the company expects $35 billion to $40 billion in capital expenditures in the fourth quarter. AI took $16.4 billion of the company's $19.6 billion in capital spending in the third quarter.
"SpaceX delivered the quarter the bulls wanted, at least on the top line," said Will Rhind, CEO of asset manager GraniteShares. "The story now is all about AI. The compute contracts signed earlier this year are turning into revenue faster than a lot of people thought."
The company's AI business spans Grok, social media platform X and a fast-growing data-center operation.
Operating losses at the AI unit have been large and SpaceX has cautioned it will need sustained investment before it can consistently generate profits. But it turned a profit in the third quarter, compared with a year-ago loss.
"With AI revenue now the company's biggest business line, the company's hyperscale business is quickly providing operating strength and leverage which will carry into the advancements of its satellite and launch business," said Daniel Newman, CEO of tech research group the Futurum Group. "Increasingly, the strength and diversification of SpaceX makes a merger with Tesla feel imminent."
SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion versus a net loss of $1.1 billion a year earlier and analysts' expectation for a profit of $1.57 billion. On a per-share, adjusted basis, it earned 45 cents according to IBES calculations, outstripping a 13-cent average estimate.
STARLINK SUBSCRIBERS TOP FORECASTS
The satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its subscriber base, aided by additional satellite launches and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services.
Starlink reached 13.6 million subscribers in the third quarter, above the 12.19 million analysts expected, but growth is coming at a price: average monthly revenue per subscriber has fallen from $99 in 2023 to $69 in the third quarter as it expands abroad with cheaper plans.
The company has said geographic expansion beyond the wealthiest countries could push average revenue per user lower over time.
Starship, SpaceX's next-generation reusable rocket system, has yet to enter commercial service. It is expected to enable deployment of higher-bandwidth Starlink satellites and orbital AI-computing infrastructure. The company's ability to turn Starship into a reliably reusable vehicle is central to its longer-term strategy.
SpaceX successfully deployed several Starlink satellites last month, in Starship's first orbital test flight that ended hours earlier than expected after an engine issue.
The space segment includes commercial launches, government missions and Starship development and remains a significant source of costs and uncertainty.
Falcon launch activity has stayed robust, but revenue can vary with the mix of internal Starlink deployments, commercial customer missions and government contracts.
SpaceX has increasingly prioritized launches for its own satellite network over third-party payloads, while absorbing significant costs tied to Starship's development.

Source: Reuters

items.title: United Airlines profit outlook well below estimates, hit by fuel costs
items.author: Rajesh Singh
items.creator: Rajesh Singh
items.summary: United Airlines on Tuesday forecast fourth-quarter profit well below Wall Street estimates despite expectations for record revenue, as soaring fuel costs were expected to persist, eating into gains from strong travel demand and higher ticket prices.
items.body:
United Airlines (UAL.O) on Tuesday forecast fourth-quarter profit well below Wall Street estimates despite expectations for record revenue, as soaring fuel costs were expected to persist, eating into gains from strong travel demand and higher ticket prices.
Airline fares are rising sharply, but fuel costs are climbing even faster, squeezing profits industry wide. With the Iran war threatening to keep fuel prices elevated into 2027, analysts say carriers may have to raise fares further and risk losing customers, or limit flight growth to support ticket prices and protect profits.
Earlier this month, United's [USN:L4N45U1TW TEXT:"rival Delta Air Lines"] (DAL.N) cut its annual earnings forecast by nearly a quarter after projecting a $6 billion increase in its fuel bill from last year.
Delta CEO Ed Bastian warned that airlines may need to further restrain flight growth next year to sustain higher fares and protect profitability.
United expects to pay $4.80 a gallon for jet fuel in the fourth quarter, about 45 cents more than the market consensus assumption. The difference translates into roughly $1 per share in earnings, the company said.
The Chicago-based carrier expects adjusted earnings of 50 cents to $1.50 per share for the December quarter. LSEG data shows an average analyst estimate of $1.76. The $1 midpoint of the carrier's outlook is 43% below expectations.
Alaska Air Group (ALK.N) added to the industry's warnings on Tuesday, forecasting a fourth-quarter adjusted loss of $2 to $2.50 per share, compared with analyst expectations for a $1.04 loss. The carrier expects its fuel bill for the year to run $1.8 billion above its original plan.
Alaska's third-quarter revenue rose 14%, yet its adjusted pretax margin narrowed to 1.1% from 4.6% a year earlier. It expects revenue per unit of capacity to grow by a low-double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter, despite projecting a substantial loss.
HIGHER FARES, THINNER MARGINS United's third-quarter results show how soaring fuel costs are eating into gains from higher fares.
Its additional fuel spending was equivalent to nearly 70% of the increase in quarterly revenue. Despite record sales, adjusted pretax profit fell and its margin narrowed to 6.2% from 8% a year earlier.
Demand, however, remains strong. United carried a record number of passengers, with revenue from business travelers, premium cabins and basic economy all growing at double-digit rates. The airline generated significantly more revenue without substantially increasing flying capacity.
The squeeze extends across the industry. US air fares rose an average of nearly 23% year-on-year in the seven months through September, according to Labor Department data.
The industry's fuel bill, however, has been climbing even faster. US airlines spent $42.9 billion on fuel in the first eight months of 2026, up $13.2 billion from a year earlier despite slightly lower consumption, government data showed.
Analysts at Deutsche Bank have warned that further fare increases could weaken demand, forcing airlines to slow flight growth to support ticket prices.
The pressure is spreading beyond the United States. Ryanair (RYA.I) CEO Michael O'Leary [USN:L6N4660EL TEXT:"warned"] on Tuesday that European airfares could rise as much as 20% next year as higher fuel costs and reduced airline capacity squeeze the industry.
United and Alaska Air will discuss their financial results in separate calls with analysts and investors on Wednesday morning.

items.title: FIA boss happy for F1 to race in Middle East, less sure about Dakar Rally
items.author: Alan Baldwin
items.creator: Alan Baldwin
items.summary: Formula One's governing body is happy for the last two races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi to proceed as planned, despite the Iran war and conflict in the Gulf region, International Automobile Federation (FIA) president Mohammed Ben Sulayem said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Formula One's governing body is happy for the last two races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi to proceed as planned, despite the Iran war and conflict in the Gulf region, International Automobile Federation (FIA) president Mohammed Ben Sulayem said on Tuesday.
Speaking to reporters after opening a new FIA Remote Operations Centre at Biggin Hill, within Formula One's television headquarters, the Emirati acknowledged concern about January's Dakar Rally in Saudi Arabia but expressed confidence in F1.
F1 chief executive Stefano Domenicali, who also attended the opening but did not speak to reporters, has stated the calendar is confirmed.
Qatar's Lusail circuit and Abu Dhabi's Yas Marina are due to host grands prix on November 29 and December 6 respectively. Italy's Imola circuit has been mentioned as a backstop for the latter race should both Gulf rounds have to be cancelled.
Asked if he felt the situation in the two countries was 'fine' at the moment, Ben Sulayem replied: 'Yeah, fine.
"Does this say (mean) that there is nothing going to happen? I cannot predict this. I can only tell you today that there is nothing and the two races are going to happen."
Ben Sulayem said his children remained in the Emirates and he would be happy for FIA staff to attend, adding that there were also backup plans in case some were unable to travel.

BIGGIN HILL, England, Oct 20 : Formula One's governing body is happy for the last two races of the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi to proceed as planned, despite the Iran war and conflict in the Gulf region, International Automobile Federation (FIA) president Mohammed Ben Sulayem said on Tuesday.
Speaking to reporters after opening a new FIA Remote Operations Centre at Biggin Hill, within Formula One's television headquarters, the Emirati acknowledged concern about January's Dakar Rally in Saudi Arabia but expressed confidence in F1.
F1 chief executive Stefano Domenicali, who also attended the opening but did not speak to reporters, has stated the calendar is confirmed.
Qatar's Lusail circuit and Abu Dhabi's Yas Marina are due to host grands prix on November 29 and December 6 respectively. Italy's Imola circuit has been mentioned as a backstop for the latter race should both Gulf rounds have to be cancelled.

items.title: US FDA approves GSK's hepatitis B drug, offering patients chance to stop long-term treatment
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US FDA said on Tuesday it had approved British drugmaker GSK's hepatitis B drug Hibsago, allowing patients with the liver infection a way to keep the virus under control after stopping treatment.
items.body:
The US FDA said on Tuesday it had approved British drugmaker GSK's (GSK.L) hepatitis B drug Hibsago, allowing patients with the liver infection a way to keep the virus under control after stopping treatment.
The drug, chemically known as bepirovirsen, is the first FDA-approved antisense oligonucleotide for chronic hepatitis B, according to the agency.
Under new CEO Luke Miels, GSK is aiming to speed up the develop and launch of new medicines ahead of looming patent expirations on its blockbuster HIV drugs. The company expects [USN:L4N4241LO TEXT:"peak annual sales"] of more than £2 billion ($2.68 billion) for the drug and is central to its plans to reach more than £40 billion in annual revenue by 2031.
Hibsago has already secured approval in Japan and is under regulatory review in China and Europe. The drug was licensed from rare disease drugmaker Ionis Pharmaceuticals (IONS.O) , which is eligible to receive milestone payments upon approval and other regulatory benchmarks.
In clinical trials, bepirovirsen helped nearly one-in-five patients achieve undetectable levels of the hepatitis B virus and remain off antiviral treatment for at least six months.
Hepatitis B is a serious liver infection that can lead to liver damage and cirrhosis, or scarring of the liver. The virus spreads through infected bodily fluids such as blood, saliva and semen.
More than 250 million people globally live with chronic hepatitis B, and current standard-of-care treatments help only 1% to 4% of patients clear the virus for a sustained period, or achieve what doctors call a functional cure.
Nucleotide analogues, a widely used class of hepatitis B treatments, are often taken for life and suppress the virus but rarely eliminate it.
US biotech Aligos Therapeutics (ALGS.O) is developing a rival hepatitis B therapy, pevifoscorvir sodium, which is being evaluated in a mid-stage trial.
GSK did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on US pricing and commercial availability.
($1 = 0.7474 pounds)

items.title: Anec eleva previsão de exportação de milho do Brasil em outubro; reduz a de soja
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A exportação de milho do Brasil em outubro foi estimada nesta terça-feira em 6,87 milhões de toneladas, cerca de 400 mil toneladas a mais no comparativo com a previsão divulgada na semana passada, de acordo com números da Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Cereais (Anec).
items.body:
A exportação de milho do Brasil em outubro foi estimada nesta terça-feira em 6,87 milhões de toneladas, cerca de 400 mil toneladas a mais no comparativo com a previsão divulgada na semana passada, de acordo com números da Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Cereais (Anec).
O volume representa um crescimento de 1,2 milhão de toneladas em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado, apontou a Anec.
Já a projeção da exportação de soja foi reduzida para 6,40 milhões de toneladas em outubro, versus 6,55 milhões anteriormente. No comparativo anual, haveria uma estabilidade.
Os embarques de farelo de soja do Brasil foram previstos em 2,52 milhões de toneladas até o final do mês, praticamente estáveis ante a semana anterior, representando um crescimento de quase 800 mil toneladas no comparativo anual.

items.title: Frete rodoviário sobe em setembro por pressão do diesel, aponta Edenred Mobilidade
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O custo do transporte rodoviário de cargas no Brasil subiu em setembro, pressionado pela alta do diesel e pela atualização da tabela dos pisos mínimos de frete pela Agência Nacional de Transportes Terrestres (ANTT), segundo dados divulgados nesta terça-feira pela Edenred Mobilidade.
items.body:
O custo do transporte rodoviário de cargas no Brasil subiu em setembro, pressionado pela alta do diesel e pela atualização da tabela dos pisos mínimos de frete pela Agência Nacional de Transportes Terrestres (ANTT), segundo dados divulgados nesta terça-feira pela Edenred Mobilidade.
O preço médio do frete por quilômetro rodado avançou 0,57% na comparação com agosto, para R$8,77, de acordo com o Índice de Frete Rodoviário (IFR), calculado com base nas transações de frete e vale-pedágio administradas pela companhia.
A alta ocorreu em um contexto de combustíveis mais caros e maior demanda por transporte ligada ao agronegócio. Segundo a Edenred, o diesel S-10 subiu 2,7% em setembro, para uma média nacional de R$7,24 por litro, enquanto o diesel comum avançou 1,33%, para R$6,84.
No fim do mês, a ANTT atualizou os valores de referência usados no cálculo dos pisos mínimos de frete após a alta acumulada do diesel superar o limite previsto em lei para revisão extraordinária da tabela.
"Com a fiscalização mais rigorosa do cumprimento dos pisos e da emissão do CIOT, o mercado de fretes incorporou esses ajustes", afirmou o diretor de Unidades de Negócios da Edenred Mobilidade, Vinicios Fernandes, em nota.
Para outubro, a empresa vê possibilidade de pressão adicional sobre os fretes, refletindo os efeitos da atualização da tabela e o avanço do escoamento da safra agrícola.

items.title: Ibovespa fecha em alta com apoio de estrangeiros a poucos dias de eleição
items.author: Paula Arend Laier
items.creator: Paula Arend Laier
items.summary: O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta terça-feira, rondando os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, com bancos e B3 entre os principais suportes.
items.body:
O Ibovespa fechou em alta nesta terça-feira, rondando os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, com bancos e B3 entre os principais suportes.
A bolsa paulista continua em clima de expectativa para o desfecho da eleição presidencial no país, com o segundo turno no domingo, enquanto investidores estrangeiros continuam fornecendo apoio para as ações brasileiras.
Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) avançou 1,57%, a 208.295,98 pontos, chegando a 208.941,57 na máxima e marcando 205.082,26 na mínima do dia.
O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$42,5 bilhões.
"Trade eleitoral", resumiu o sócio e advisor da Blue3 Investimentos, Willian Queiroz, sobre o desempenho do Ibovespa.
Ele destacou que, embora as pesquisas ainda mostrem um cenário acirrado na disputa entre o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) e o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) pelo Palácio do Planalto, o candidato do PL continua à frente.
Ações na B3 têm reagido positivamente a uma potencial troca em Brasília em razão de expectativas principalmente de melhora no cenário fiscal do país.
Apenas em outubro, impulsionado principalmente pelo resultado do primeiro turno da eleição, com Flávio à frente, a B3 registra um saldo de capital externo positivo de R$20,99 bilhões até o dia 16.
O exterior corroborou o avanço do Ibovespa, com o norte-americano S&P 500 (.SPX) fechando em alta de 0,28%, enquanto o rendimento dos títulos de 10 anos do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos marcava 5,1126% no final do dia, de 5,136% na véspera.
DESTAQUES BTG PACTUAL UNIT subiu 4,36%, melhor desempenho entre os bancos do Ibovespa, que têm se mostrado sensíveis às expectativas eleitorais. BRADESCO PN , que reporta balanço no final da quinta-feira, avançou 2,89%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN valorizou-se 1,88%, BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) fechou com elevação de 1,04% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT apurou acréscimo de 1,26%. No radar do setor, fontes afirmaram à Reuters que o Banco Central prepara [USN:L1N4650WU TEXT:"medidas"] para conter o crescente endividamento das famílias, incluindo ações para ampliar responsabilidades e exigir transparência por parte dos bancos, e analisa um modelo regulatório que limita o crédito autorizado por pessoa a depender do nível de renda.
B3 ON (B3SA3.SA) valorizou-se 5,38%, também refletindo o potencial efeito no mercado em razão das expectativas envolvendo o desfecho eleitoral. Dados recentes já têm mostrado melhora no volume negociado em renda variável, além de fluxo positivo de estrangeiros.
PETROBRAS PN avançou 0,36% e PETROBRAS ON (PETR3.SA) subiu 0,48%. O Brasil ultrapassou a Arábia Saudita como o segundo maior [USN:L6N4660QF TEXT:"fornecedor"] de petróleo bruto para a China nos primeiros nove meses de 2026, segundo dados alfandegários divulgados pelo país asiático nesta terça-feira. No exterior, o barril de petróleo sob o contrato Brent fechou a US$108,79, queda de 0,69%.
VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 1,39%, em linha com a fraqueza dos futuros do [USN:L6N4660RV TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China. A mineradora informou nesta terça-feira que apresentou um pedido à Associação Nacional de Investidores Institucionais do Mercado Financeiro da China (NAFMII) para o registro de um programa de títulos de dívida "[USN:S0N44L00Q TEXT:"Panda Bonds"]" na China. O programa envolve títulos denominados em renminbi para o período de 2026 a 2028, com montante principal agregado de até RMB 10 bilhões. Os títulos emitidos no âmbito desse programa serão integral e incondicionalmente garantidos pela companhia.
MAGAZINE LUIZA ON (MGLU3.SA) disparou 14,79%, com o setor sensível a juros entre os destaques positivos em pregão com [USN:L1N4660X3 TEXT:"alívio"] na curva de juros brasileira. O amplo índice de consumo (.ICON) da B3 subiu 3,3%.
ÂNIMA EDUCAÇÃO ON (ANIM3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, caiu 9,19%, após [USN:L1N465104 TEXT:"acordo"] da sua subsidiária de ensino de medicina Inspirali com o grupo de educação médica do Einstein para usar a marca do hospital em seus cursos a partir do próximo ano. O acordo de 20 anos envolve um pagamento fixo ao Einstein de R$150 milhões e pagamentos de 6% da receita líquida de novos alunos de medicina, entre outros detalhes.
JSL ON (JSLG3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, subiu 6,83%, tendo ainda no radar prévia de resultados mostrando [USN:S0N45000S TEXT:"receita bruta"] de R$3,09 bilhões no terceiro trimestre, alta de 5,9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano passado.
AMERICANAS ON (AMER3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, disparou 15,58%, após a Justiça do Rio de Janeiro decretar o [USN:L1N465112 TEXT:"encerramento"] do processo de recuperação judicial da companhia.

items.title: Netflix co-CEO Sarandos says 'we could do better' after weak forecast
items.author: Lisa Richwine, Jaspreet Singh
items.creator: Lisa Richwine, Jaspreet Singh
items.summary: Netflix issued weaker-than-expected guidance for fourth-quarter profit and cut its full-year advertising forecast on Tuesday, days after the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
items.body:
Netflix (NFLX.O) issued weaker-than-expected guidance for fourth-quarter profit and cut its full-year advertising forecast on Tuesday, days after the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
Shares of Netflix fell nearly 6% to $64.66 in after-hours trading. The stock had fallen more than 40% in a year before the earnings report.
Co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the company plans to focus on its core business of producing quality TV shows and movies to make Netflix a must-have service, and the recent executive shakeup was a step toward that goal.
"I know that we could do better," Sarandos said in a post-earnings video call. "Now we've seen an opportunity to take our slate to the next level."
Third-quarter revenue rose 11.8% to $12.87 billion, in line with Wall Street forecasts, but the lowest rate of increase in nearly three years. The company forecast fourth-quarter net income of $2.79 billion and EPS of 67 cents, below the average analyst forecast of $3.07 billion and 73 cents.
Netflix reduced its advertising forecast for 2026 to roughly $2.7 billion, down from about $3 billion. Some ad product capabilities rolled out slightly slower than expected, executives said in their quarterly letter to shareholders.
The company that shook up Hollywood when it started streaming TV shows and movies two decades ago is now competing with a surge in viewership on YouTube and TikTok. Netflix has invested in video games, podcasts and live events to draw new viewers and increase the time members spend on the platform.
Wall Street analysts have questioned how the company will kick-start growth.
"Netflix remains a well-oiled, highly profitable machine, but focused on too many unwanted distractions," PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore said. "The company needs to get back to basics and focus on compelling content."
In its earnings report, Netflix said it would continue to expand its offerings through licensing more third-party content.
For the third quarter, earnings per share came in at 87 cents, ahead of the 82-cent average forecast of analysts surveyed by LSEG. New programming during the quarter included "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story," the second season of "The Gentlemen," the final installment of "Outer Banks" and a reboot of "Little House on the Prairie."
Last week, Netflix [USN:L6N4600X7 TEXT:"laid off 1,000 people"], or about 6% of its employees. The company replaced Chief Creative Officer Bela [USN:L4N46128P TEXT:"Bajaria"] and said film chief [USN:L4N4651E5 TEXT:"Dan Lin was departing"], signs that it is resetting its programming strategy.
The company named former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice to replace Bajaria. He also will oversee the film division until a replacement for Lin is chosen.
"Peter Rice understands talent relations, and in a competitive market, creative talent have choices of where they want to work," Sarandos said on Tuesday. "We want Netflix to always be the place that they love to do the best work of their life."
Earlier this year, Netflix lost a bidding war for Warner Bros Discovery and its rich library of characters, which was sold to David Ellison-led Skydance . Some analysts believe Netflix could go after other acquisition targets such as NBCUniversal after Comcast (CMCSA.O) spins it off.
Netflix has posted monthly subscriber losses in the US throughout 2026, with no net additions reported for any month up to September, data from analytics firm Antenna showed.
Antenna tracks US subscription purchases via sources like credit card transactions, but excludes subscriptions acquired through wholesale bundles. A Netflix spokesperson said the Antenna data were "not representative of Netflix's business performance."
Sarandos said there was no need for a "fundamental shift" in strategy but added: "We do need better execution in the US."

Antenna tracks US subscription purchases via sources like credit card transactions, but excludes subscriptions acquired through wholesale bundles. A Netflix spokesperson said the Antenna data were "not representative of Netflix's business performance."

LOS ANGELES, Oct 20 : Netflix issued weaker-than-expected guidance for fourth-quarter profit and cut its full-year advertising forecast on Tuesday, days after the streaming pioneer laid off 6 per cent of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
Shares of Netflix fell nearly 6 per cent to $64.66 in after-hours trading. The stock had fallen more than 40 per cent in a year before the earnings report.
Co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the company plans to focus on its core business of producing quality TV shows and movies to make Netflix a must-have service, and the recent executive shakeup was a step toward that goal.
"I know that we could do better," Sarandos said in a post-earnings video call. "Now we've seen an opportunity to take our slate to the next level."

Third-quarter revenue rose 11.8 per cent to $12.87 billion, in line with Wall Street forecasts, but the lowest rate of increase in nearly three years. The company forecast fourth-quarter net income of $2.79 billion and EPS of 67 cents, below the average analyst forecast of $3.07 billion and 73 cents.
Netflix reduced its advertising forecast for 2026 to roughly $2.7 billion, down from about $3 billion. Some ad product capabilities rolled out slightly slower than expected, executives said in their quarterly letter to shareholders.
The company that shook up Hollywood when it started streaming TV shows and movies two decades ago is now competing with a surge in viewership on YouTube and TikTok. Netflix has invested in video games, podcasts and live events to draw new viewers and increase the time members spend on the platform.
Wall Street analysts have questioned how the company will kick-start growth.
"Netflix remains a well-oiled, highly profitable machine, but focused on too many unwanted distractions," PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore said. "The company needs to get back to basics and focus on compelling content."
In its earnings report, Netflix said it would continue to expand its offerings through licensing more third-party content.
For the third quarter, earnings per share came in at 87 cents, ahead of the 82-cent average forecast of analysts surveyed by LSEG. New programming during the quarter included "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story," the second season of "The Gentlemen," the final installment of "Outer Banks" and a reboot of "Little House on the Prairie."
Last week, Netflix laid off 1,000 people, or about 6 per cent of its employees. The company replaced Chief Creative Officer Bela Bajaria and said film chief Dan Lin was departing, signs that it is resetting its programming strategy.
The company named former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice to replace Bajaria. He also will oversee the film division until a replacement for Lin is chosen.
"Peter Rice understands talent relations, and in a competitive market, creative talent have choices of where they want to work," Sarandos said on Tuesday. "We want Netflix to always be the place that they love to do the best work of their life."
Earlier this year, Netflix lost a bidding war for Warner Bros Discovery and its rich library of characters, which was sold to David Ellison-led Skydance. Some analysts believe Netflix could go after other acquisition targets such as NBCUniversal after Comcast spins it off.
Netflix has posted monthly subscriber losses in the US throughout 2026, with no net additions reported for any month up to September, data from analytics firm Antenna showed.
Antenna tracks US subscription purchases via sources like credit card transactions, but excludes subscriptions acquired through wholesale bundles. A Netflix spokesperson said the Antenna data were "not representative of Netflix's business performance."
Sarandos said there was no need for a "fundamental shift" in strategy but added: "We do need better execution in the US."

Source: Reuters

items.title: トランプ氏 、加ボンバルディア排除の脅し撤回　カンザス州の雇用「守る」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Shepardson　Allison Lampert

[ワシントン／モントリオール ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Shepardson　Allison Lampert

[ワシントン／モントリオール ２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、カナダの航空機メーカーであるボンバルディアを米市場から締め出すとの脅しを撤回し、代わりにカンザス州の同社従業員を「しっかり守る」と約束した。

トランプ氏が９月にボンバルディアの米市場での販売禁止を示唆したことは、ウィチタで１５００人を雇用するカンザス州で政治問題化していた。販売禁止の脅しを受け、共和党のロジャー・マーシャル上院議員らカンザス州選出の議員は、ホワイトハウスに働きかけを行った。

トランプ氏はカンザス州の「１２ニュース」に対し、マーシャル氏の関与に言及しつつ、「ボンバルディアを守る」と述べた。その上で「ある航空会社の立て直しを手伝うつもりだ。私はずっと彼らをカナダ企業と見なしてきた」と説明。「しかし今、同社が米国内に拠点を置いていることが分かった。カンザス州にいるのなら彼らを傷つけるつもりはない。従業員と雇用を守るつもりだ」と述べた。 

トランプ氏の発言を受け、ボンバルディアの株価は一時、４％上昇した。

ホワイトハウスはコメントを控え、質問についてはトランプ氏のテレビインタビューを参照するよう求めた。

items.title: League says Eagles handled Hurts medical condition appropriately
items.author: Amy Tennery
items.creator: Amy Tennery
items.summary: The Philadelphia Eagles handled Jalen Hurts' medical condition appropriately, an NFL spokesperson told Reuters on Tuesday, after the quarterback was sidelined indefinitely due to blood clots in his lungs.
items.body:
The Philadelphia Eagles handled Jalen Hurts' medical condition appropriately, an NFL spokesperson told Reuters on Tuesday, after the quarterback was sidelined indefinitely due to blood clots in his lungs.
Hurts was diagnosed with a left calf superficial vein thrombosis prior to playing in an October 11 contest against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London. After further testing and monitoring, he was diagnosed with deep vein thrombosis and a bilateral pulmonary embolism, [USN:L6N4650YZ TEXT:"the team said"] on Monday.
The NFL had stayed in close contact with the team, the spokesperson said, and found that the Eagles had handled the matter appropriately, after a day of outcry from many pundits and fans, who questioned why Hurts was allowed to play at all in the London game.
The 2025 Super Bowl MVP is clinically stable as he undergoes treatment with blood thinners, but he is expected to be out for the season. A bilateral pulmonary embolism is a dangerous condition in which a blood clot blocks an artery in both lungs.
The NFL was in contact with Eagles medical personnel and the Cleveland Clinic in London, where Hurts was tested. The league's chief medical officer arranges medical resources in every international market with approval from the players' union, the spokesperson added.
NFL owners gathered in New York on Tuesday for their fall meeting amid an ambitious international slate of games this season, with a record nine contests abroad.
League officials were critical of early media reports and speculation surrounding Hurts' condition, telling reporters at a press conference on Tuesday that doctors caring for players are not ever influenced by coaches, general managers or team owners.
"If you're not sitting in that room with that patient and you don't have all the data, if you are speculating as a physician on what should have been done, you are unprofessional and unethical in doing that," said NFL Chief Medical Officer Allen Sills.
Sills said there was no set league protocol for blood clots, as there is with concussions.
"I have complete confidence in the Eagles staff and their handling of this situation," he added. "I would characterize their work as very conservative, very patient, focused and appropriately guarded at every step."

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ懸念が重し　円は20年債入札好調で上昇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ステート・ストリート・インベストメント・マネジメントのシニア債券ストラテジスト、マサヒコ・ルー氏は「２０年債入札に対する記録的な需要は、待機資金がついに市場に戻り始めたことを示す強いシグナルになる」と指摘。「フランスの政治・財政面での不透明感を背景に、資金の安全な逃避先として日本国債の魅力が相対的に高まりつつある」と述べた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％安１０１．７１。ユーロは対ドルで０．２２％高の１．１２３５ドル。

この日は原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、下落。ただ、市場ではＡＩを巡る懸念がより大きく意識されている。野村証券のＧ１０通貨戦略責任者、ドミニク・バニング氏は、「エネルギー価格の上昇はドル相場にとって追い風になるが、金利がＡＩ関連取引を崩壊させるほど高い水準に達すれば、ドル相場にとってマイナスの影響を及ぼすことになる」と指摘。「現在はまさにその境目となる水準が試されているところだ」としている。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．３４％高の１．４０６カナダドルと、約１カ月ぶりの高水準を付けた。 カナダ西部アルバータ州で１９日に実施された分離独立を問う住民投票でカナダへの残留が支持され、国内の結束を図るカーニー首相にとって待望の勝利となった。

Oct 20 : Real Madrid are seeking contributions towards the setup costs of the failed European Super League project from the six Premier League clubs that withdrew shortly after its launch, the Spanish side confirmed to Reuters on Tuesday.
The Athletic reported that the total costs could reach €80 million ($89.9 million). Real are seeking payments from Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur.
The six were among nine of the competition's 12 founding clubs that withdrew within three days of its launch in 2021 amid widespread opposition.
Real did not immediately confirm whether they were also seeking payments from the other three early leavers, AC Milan, Inter Milan and Atletico Madrid.

Tottenham declined to comment while the other five Premier League clubs did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
The Athletic reported that the clubs signed a shareholders' agreement for the European Super League Company, the holding company behind the competition, although it is unclear whether the contract explicitly set out their liability for setup costs.
The Super League collapsed shortly after its launch following the withdrawal of the nine clubs.
Juventus subsequently pulled out of the project and Barcelona formally withdrew in February, leaving Real Madrid as its sole remaining founding club.
Real, UEFA and European Football Clubs announced an agreement of principles on February 11 aimed at resolving their Super League-related legal disputes.

Oct 20 : Anthropic reported a net loss of more than $80 billion in the first half of the year and signaled it could spend as much as $750 billion in the coming years to secure more computing capacity, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.
The loss, up from $13 billion a year earlier, was driven by $72 billion in accounting charges tied to changes in the value of financial instruments Anthropic issued to raise money, the report said, citing a draft prospectus for its IPO.
The figures show the hefty costs of the AI race even as investors look harder at whether the money companies are pouring into chips and data centers will pay off.
Anthropic's revenue jumped to $16.3 billion in the six months ended June 30 from $1.1 billion a year ago, while AI infrastructure spending nearly quadrupled to almost $9 billion, the Journal said.

ANTHROPIC'S IPO VALUATION UNDER SCRUTINY
Reuters reported first in September that Anthropic posted a net loss of $42 billion in 2025, as part of a series of exclusives from its IPO prospectus.
The company has benefited from the popularity of Claude Code, its coding assistant that developers use to write software and build apps.
But some current investors and prospective investors who attended Anthropic's investor day last week are weighing a lower valuation for the AI company after its latest financial disclosures, four people familiar with the matter had told Reuters.
The investors who attended the event in San Francisco discussed a valuation of around $1.5 trillion, three of the people had said, a significant step down from the roughly $2 trillion valuation previously expected for the November share sale.
Anthropic told investors at the meeting that its third-quarter revenue jumped 45 per cent to $16.8 billion from the previous quarter, and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis during the quarter.
A cooler reception for Anthropic's IPO could weigh on the wider AI market, whose near-term prospects investors see as hinging largely on the share sale's success, ahead of rival OpenAI's potential listing next year.

items.title: FAA certifies Boeing's 737 MAX 10, clearing way for deliveries
items.author: Dan Catchpole, David Shepardson
items.creator: Dan Catchpole, David Shepardson
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration on Tuesday granted final approval to the long-delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10, clearing the way for the US planemaker to begin delivering the largest version of its best-selling airplane.
items.body:
The Federal Aviation Administration on Tuesday granted final approval to the long-delayed Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX 10, clearing the way for the US planemaker to begin delivering the largest version of its best-selling airplane.
Boeing has said the MAX 10 will be a major driver of cash flow in its ongoing financial recovery following years of crises and controversies that slowed the company's timeline for the MAX 10. So far, airlines have ordered more than 1,550 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for 31% of Boeing's outstanding 737 backlog, according to IBA, an aviation analytics consultancy.
The plane is critical to Boeing's fight with Airbus (AIR.PA) for orders in the lucrative single-aisle jetliner market, with China's COMAC C919 in a distant third place.
"We want to beat the Europeans, we want to beat the Chinese," Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Tuesday at Boeing's plant in Everett, Washington, to tout the FAA certification.
"But if we want to continue to do that, I have to allow you all to certify aircraft faster," Duffy said, a nod to his promise to streamline airplane certification.
Boeing has been trying to certify the 737 MAX 10 since the early 2020s.
In July, the company opened a new production line at the Everett plant to increase 737 output, which it also assembles in nearby Renton.
Stephanie Pope, president and CEO of Boeing Commercial Airplanes, said deliveries will begin in the coming months, adding that the MAX 10 "offers greater capacity, longer range and the best seat economics in its class."
The largest MAX 10 can hold up to 230 passengers, compared with up to 195 for the MAX 9 and 160 for the MAX 7.
However, the delays have helped European rival Airbus' (AIR.PA) A321neo secure a greater share of the large single-aisle market.
The bigger, higher-capacity plane is crucial to several airlines' growth plans. Major customers for the MAX 10 include United Airlines (UAL.O) , Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) , Ryanair (RYA.I) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and American Airlines (AAL.O) .
The planemaker has already built a handful of MAX 10s awaiting delivery.
Boeing has faced a more stringent certification process since two fatal MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019 killed 346 people. Scrutiny of the company's production and quality systems also increased after a January 2024 mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines MAX 9.
The FAA in August approved the smaller 737 MAX 7 after a review that lasted more than eight years.
The regulator required the MAX 10 to include significant improvements, including updates to the flight control system with an enhanced angle-of-attack sensor. Those will be applied to the existing fleet in the coming years.
A problem with the anti-ice system on 737 MAX engines that arose in 2023 further delayed certification of the MAX 7 and 10.
Boeing disclosed another glitch in late September with the latest update of the 737 MAX's navigation software, which threatened to further delay certification. However, the FAA determined it did not pose a safety concern and did not require Boeing to fix the problem as a condition of certifying the plane.
Boeing is still working on certifying the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production, which is six years behind schedule. The company has said it expects to complete certification and begin deliveries in 2027.

FAST

GQEBERHA, South Africa, Oct 20 : South Africa captain Temba Bavuma said he enjoyed battling against adversity as he scored 179 on Tuesday to turn around his side’s fortunes in the second test against Australia and also quell some of his own mental demons.
The captain produced a defiant display and showcased his batting skills as South Africa recovered from a precarious 110-6 in the morning session on the third day to declare on 425-9 before taking an Australian wicket prior to stumps, an emphatic response to their heavy defeat in last week’s first test.
The 36-year-old Bavuma had been forced to the crease with the hosts on 12-2 on Sunday’s rain-restricted opening day, when only an hour's play was possible, and had to resume his innings on Monday as the ball moved around after the wet weather finally relented. South Africa slumped to 97-5 by the close of the second day.
“I walked into a tricky situation,” he told reporters. “I think everything was in the bowlers’ favour, the conditions overhead, the wicket itself, we’d just lost two early wickets, but ordinarily I’ve found myself in those situations quite a number of times and I guess it seems to bring out the best in me."

The sun appeared on Tuesday after two rain-affected days and the pitch flattened out, offering the batters considerably more assistance, although Bavuma insisted conditions were not as easy as they might have seemed.
DEALING WITH AUSTRALIA’S QUALITY ATTACK
“With the quality of the bowling attack, they're still able to put you under pressure, even when the ball is slightly softer and older.
“I think from a mindset point of view, for me, nothing really changed. I was always just trying to be as tight as I could and try to hit the ball as straight as I could.
“The one thing was being able to get the team out of a tough situation. But then from a personal point of view, to go on to getting a big 100, that's obviously something that's been a thorn in my side throughout my career. So it was nice to get over that mental hurdle,” he added.
Bavuma, who has overcome a long-standing elbow injury, not only surpassed his previous highest test score but featured in two record partnerships.
He added 132 with Marco Jansen, who scored 85, to set a South African seventh-wicket record at St George’s Park, before putting on a national-record 183 for the eighth wicket with number nine Simon Harmer, who made a test career-best 82.
“They put a heavy price on their wickets and part of our plan was to keep Australia in the field for as long as we could. It all went according to plan,” Bavuma added as Australia will resume at 3–1 at the start of day four.
