英労働市場統計によると、賃金上昇ペースはわずかに加速し、雇用に回復の兆しが見られた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場ではイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めることがほぼ確実視されている。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は０．８４％安。金融大手ＨＳＢＣ、ナットウエスト、ロイズは０．９─１．１％下落した。

資源株指数は１．５９％下落。石油大手のＢＰは１．７％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

一方、公益事業株指数は１．５２％高。電力・ガス供給のナショナル・グリッドは１．８％上昇した。住宅建設株指数は３．２９％高。

ＪＰモルガンが目標株価を引き上げたオンラインスーパー大手オカドは１０．０％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念などから、工業株の売り注文が優勢だった。フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．３８％安と続落。経済の停滞や財政悪化といった課題を抱えるフランスで、激しい抗議デモが発生。約半年後に大統領選を控えることもあり、投資家の警戒感が強まっている。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種工業株指数は１．４３％安。データセンター関連を顧客とするスイス重電大手ＡＢＢは５．０％安。機関投資家から資金調達を実施した配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは３．３％下落。

一方、フランスのクラウド事業者のＯＶＨクラウドは１８．０％高。財務指標が改善し、買われた。直近の四半期決算が増収だった電子機器メーカーのコメット・ホールディングは４．７％上昇した。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が今月の理事会で金利を据え置いた後、１２月会合で利上げを決めることが有力視されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが２４年ぶりの高水準近辺で推移した。抗議デモの拡大懸念を背景に前日は約1カ月ぶりの大幅上昇を記録し、この日も荒い値動きが続いた。終盤には小幅低下した。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは終盤に３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８８％。一時４．９８７７％まで上昇し、２００２年７月以来の高水準となった１０月初旬の４．９９３７％に迫った。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約２．５ｂｐ拡大し、１５０ｂｐとなった。この利回り格差は１０月初旬に１５８．６７ｂｐと、２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大していた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのストラテジストらは「直接的な経済への影響は当面限定的にとどまるとみているが、混乱がさらに広がる可能性は、金融環境の引き締まり、政治的不確実性の高まり、緊縮財政によって既に弱まっている経済に、新たな逆風をもたらす」と指摘した。

一方、ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ国債の利回りは低下したものの、最近のレンジ内にとどまった。エネルギー価格の上昇圧力が根強く、投資家は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の追加利上げ観測を後退させていない。

ドイツ１０年国債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３８５％。

政策金利見通しに敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ低下し、３．０４５％となった。

独伊１０年債利回り格差は１．５７ｂｐ縮小し、１０９．５ｂｐとなった。

items.title: トランプ氏、ウクライナに和平合意促す　ロシア拘束の米国人巡る進展示唆
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Steve Holland　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Steve Holland　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、ロシアとの戦争終結に向け、ウクライナに和平合意に応じるよう求めた。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスの大統領執務室で記者団に対し、「ウクライナはこの戦争を終わらせたいと望まなければならない」と述べた。また、「ウクライナがこの戦争を終わらせるときが来た」とし、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が合意に応じることを望んでいると語った。

その上で、ロシアは戦場で優位に立っているとの認識を表明。「ロシアは巨大な機械のようなもので、ただ前進し続けており、実際にそうしてきた」とし、「ロシアは非常に広い領土を占領した」と述べた。

トランプ氏はまた、ロシアで拘束されている米国人の元教師、スティーブン・ハバード氏の問題について、ロシアのプーチン大統領と協議したと明らかにし、この件について近く進展がある可能性を示唆した。

トランプ氏は、ハバード氏に関する記者団の質問に対し「プーチン氏とこの件について話をしている」とし、「何が起きるか見ていてほしい。われわれはハバード氏の問題に集中して取り組んできた」と述べた。

ハバード氏は７４歳で、傭兵活動に関する罪で有罪判決を受けロシアの刑務所で約７年の刑に服している。米国務省はハバード氏の件を不当拘束と認定している。

ゼレンスキー大統領はこの日、ノルウェーの首都オスロで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談。会談後の記者会見で、ロシアによる弾道ミサイル攻撃に関する情報共有や早期警戒の提供を米国が再開したことに謝意を示した。

ノルウェーのストーレ首相によると、ウィットコフ氏は２１日にロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクを訪問し、ロシア首脳部と会談する。

items.title: At least 17 data center campuses proposed on US public lands, group says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: At least 35 data center-related applications covering more than 24,000 acres of US federal land are pending or active across six Western states, according to an analysis by conservation group Center for Western Priorities.
items.body:
At least 35 data center-related applications covering more than 24,000 acres of US federal land are pending or active across six Western states, according to an analysis by conservation group Center for Western Priorities.
US Bureau of Land Management records show at least 17 proposed data center campuses and 13 related infrastructure projects, including transmission lines, pipelines, telecommunications facilities and access roads across Arizona, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah and Wyoming, according to the study.
A map of the planned projects includes several applications for infrastructure tied to a Prometheus Hyperscale facility in Wyoming and a range of projects by developer Copia Power in Arizona, Nevada and Idaho, among others.
The figures underscore industry interest in developing AI infrastructure on federal land as the Trump administration seeks to open public lands to a wider range of industrial uses, including energy, mining and technology projects.
US President Donald Trump's administration has strongly [USN:L8N3ZL04J TEXT:"backed"] data center expansion as a national priority, but the public is increasingly [USN:L1N3WX0S4 TEXT:"opposed"] to such projects, citing concerns about electricity demand, water consumption, wildlife impacts and public access to federal lands.
BLM officials were not immediately available for comment.

items.title: Three issues defining the 2026 US midterm elections
items.author: Nolan Mccaskill
items.creator: Nolan Mccaskill
items.summary: President Donald Trump’s record-low popularity, voter frustration over the cost of living and a fierce immigration fight are shaping the November 3 midterm elections, which will determine whether Republicans keep control of Congress or Democrats gain the power to challenge his administration.
items.body:
President Donald Trump’s record-low popularity, voter frustration over the cost of living and a fierce immigration fight are shaping the November 3 midterm elections , which will determine whether Republicans keep control of Congress or Democrats gain the power to challenge his administration.
Republicans hold narrow majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate. Democrats need a net gain of four seats to take control of each chamber.
The outcome will hinge on a relatively small number of competitive races, but the campaigns are being shaped nationally by Trump himself and voter concerns over affordability and immigration.
Here is a look at the three issues defining the election:
DONALD TRUMP The president has put himself front and center in the closing stretch of the campaign cycle despite his record-low popularity, with upcoming rallies in Florida, Iowa, Michigan and Texas. Trump's approval rating has fallen to an all-time low 31%, according to a [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"]. Yet he has repeatedly urged voters to pretend he's on the ballot, an effort that could motivate Democrats and independents to rally against his party despite the message being aimed at increasing turnout among Trump's base.
Democrats have said Trump has broken his campaign promises to lower costs and end wars. They have vowed to tackle an affordability agenda to reduce Americans' cost of living and hold the administration accountable for alleged corruption if voters give them control of either chamber.
AFFORDABILITY Voters have consistently ranked the cost of living as the top issue this election cycle. Half of registered voters surveyed in a recent Reuters/Ipsos poll cited the cost of living as the most important factor in how they will vote. In the same poll, voters highlighted healthcare, gasoline, food and housing as the top household bills lawmakers should focus on.
Republicans' top legislative achievement was a tax cut extension that slashed roughly $1 trillion in spending for Medicaid, the government health insurance program for low-income Americans, and other health programs. Democrats last year forced a government shutdown over a failed effort to extend expiring health subsidies that benefited 24 million Americans.
Gas prices have spiked since the US and Israel launched military strikes on Iran in February. The national average price of gas is $4.28 — $1.20 higher than it was a year ago, according to AAA. The average cost of diesel is $6.32 — a $2.70 increase from a year earlier.
Grocery costs are up 1.8% over the past year, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics data on consumer prices. Federal Housing Finance Agency data show home prices rose 2.1% over the past year. Congress passed a bipartisan housing bill earlier this year. It became law without Trump's signature.
IMMIGRATION Preliminary data from the Department of Homeland Security showed a 95% drop in migrants apprehended at the southwest border compared to former President Joe Biden's administration. The agency said there have been no Border Patrol releases the entire fiscal year for the first time ever.
But fatal encounters with federal immigration agents have occurred in Maine, Minnesota and Texas. The backlash to the death of two US citizens in Minnesota pulled many Democrats in competitive primaries to the left this year, with some candidates calling for the impeachment of then-Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and others saying Immigration and Customs Enforcement should be abolished.
Democrats and Republicans sparred over immigration funding this year in a stalemate that forced Republicans to unilaterally pass a $70 billion bill to fund ICE and the Border Patrol for the remainder of Trump's presidency. Republicans counter Democrats' criticism by saying Democrats support open borders.
Federal immigration officials also [USN:L1N45Y0CB TEXT:"raided the Washington home"] of Democratic US Representative Ilhan Omar of Minnesota this month, drawing widespread condemnation from Democrats. A person familiar with the case against Omar told Reuters one potential aim of the investigation could be to [USN:L6N46118Z TEXT:"strip her of US citizenship and deport her"].
OTHER ISSUES Artificial intelligence and data centers, cryptocurrency, abortion and Israel could also influence voters in individual races. In Ohio's Senate race, for example, Democratic nominee Sherrod Brown has labeled Republican Senator Jon Husted the face of data centers, and the crypto super PAC Defend American Jobs has spent more than $46 million to reelect Husted over Brown, a former US senator who chaired the chamber's Banking Committee.
In Maine's Senate race, Democratic nominee Troy Jackson is hoping voters don't forget that Republican Senator Susan Collins helped confirm Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court, which later overturned the federal right to abortion. Collins is on the election ballot for the first time since the high court made abortion a state issue rather than a federal right.
In Michigan, Republican nominee Mike Rogers has indicated he would accept help from a pro-Israel super PAC that spent more than $30 million backing Democratic US Representative Haley Stevens in her unsuccessful primary against Abdul El-Sayed, who now faces Rogers in the general election. The group has already spent more than $280,000 on mailers against El-Sayed.
Earlier this week, Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection.

items.title: EQT in advanced talks to buy testing firm Qiagen, Bloomberg News reports
items.author: Sahil Pandey
items.creator: Sahil Pandey
items.summary: European molecular testing company Qiagen is in advanced talks to be acquired by Swedish buyout firm EQT , Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
items.body:
European molecular testing company Qiagen (QIA.DE) is in advanced talks to be acquired by Swedish buyout firm EQT (EQTAB.ST) , Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
US-listed shares of Qiagen were up over 6% in afternoon trading. The company has a market capitalization of €8.57 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Qiagen's board is meeting this week to decide on the potential deal, the report said, citing people familiar with the talks. There is no certainty the discussions will lead to a sale to EQT or another buyer, the report added.
EQT has submitted a binding offer of more than $50 per share for Qiagen, while US private equity firm KKR has also made a bid, Bloomberg News reported.
The reported talks come after Qiagen said [USN:L4N3YL1R1 TEXT:"in January"] it was evaluating strategic options amid renewed takeover interest.
Interest in the diagnostics company continued through the year, with buyout firms including EQT, Advent and KKR linked to a potential acquisition in July.
Barclays analyst Luke Sergott said the latest Bloomberg report suggests a deal appears "more likely" and that he continues to see "a good possibility that a deal goes through." Sergott reiterated his $55 price target on Qiagen.
Qiagen develops molecular testing and sample-preparation technologies used by research and clinical laboratories.
KKR declined to comment, while EQT did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. Qiagen said it does not comment on "market rumors or speculation."
($1 = 0.9259 euros)

items.title: iFood compra empresa de benefícios Caju e dobra presença no setor de vales-alimentação
items.author: Luciana Novaes Magalhaes
items.creator: Luciana Novaes Magalhaes
items.summary: O iFood, aplicativo de entrega de comida controlado pela investidora holandesa Prosus , anunciou nesta terça-feira a compra da Caju, empresa de benefícios corporativos e atuante no mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação.
items.body:
O iFood, aplicativo de entrega de comida controlado pela investidora holandesa Prosus (PRX.AS) , anunciou nesta terça-feira a compra da Caju, empresa de benefícios corporativos e atuante no mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação.
Com a compra da Caju o iFood busca crescer além do seu serviço principal de entregas, mirando também segmento de benefícios a funcionários. O iFood domina o setor de delivery no Brasil, que hoje vive um acirramento da concorrência , após a chegada da Keeta, unidade do gigante chinês de tecnologia Meituan (3690.HK) .
Se aprovada pelos órgãos reguladores locais, a aquisição dobrará a presença do iFood no setor de benefícios corporativos, disseram as empresas em um comunicado conjunto.
Os termos financeiros do negócio, realizado por meio do iFood Benefícios, braço de benefícios corporativos do iFood, não foram divulgados. No entanto, a aquisição faz parte do plano mais amplo do iFood de investir R$24 bilhões até março de 2027, informou o comunicado.
O crescente mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação do Brasil movimenta cerca de R$150 bilhões por ano entre mais de 20 milhões de consumidores, de acordo com Arthur Freitas, CEO do iFood Benefícios.
O iFood Benefícios e a Caju processam, cada um, cerca de R$1,3 bilhão em transações mensais, disse Freitas à Reuters em entrevista. Juntas, as duas empresas atenderão aproximadamente 135 mil clientes corporativos e 3 milhões de usuários ativos, acrescentou.
O negócio ainda depende da aprovação do Banco Central e do Cade, com conclusão prevista para o próximo ano, segundo Eduardo Del Giglio, cofundador e CEO da Caju.

items.title: Anthropic's public benefit fund and how it compares with other big philanthropic efforts
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Anthropic said it would commit 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund, as debate intensifies over how the growing wealth generated by artificial intelligence should be distributed.
items.body:
Anthropic said it would commit 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund, as debate intensifies over how the growing wealth generated by artificial intelligence should be distributed.
The pledge comes amid a broader political debate over who should benefit from AI's gains, months after US Senator Bernie Sanders introduced a bill that would give the public a 50% stake in the largest US AI companies.
Here is what is known about Anthropic's fund and how it compares with some other large philanthropic efforts set up by major corporations, their current or former leaders, or their families:
ANTHROPIC PUBLIC BENEFIT FUND Anthropic [USN:L4N46403A TEXT:"said"] in a blog post on Sunday its Public Benefit Fund could support initiatives including nonprofit donations, direct distributions to specific populations and efforts to address AI's impact on the labor market.
The Claude maker said its proposed fund would be established as a wholly owned limited liability company and would receive an additional 2% of Anthropic's shares, at the board's discretion, for every 50% increase in the company's value above a baseline that has yet to be disclosed.
OPENAI FOUNDATION OpenAI completed a [USN:L4N3W91HS TEXT:"restructuring"] in October 2025 that left its nonprofit, renamed the OpenAI Foundation, with a 26% stake in the for-profit, worth about $130 billion at the time.
The foundation also holds a warrant to receive additional equity if OpenAI Group's share price rises more than tenfold over 15 years.
OpenAI said in a blog post at that time that the company's success will raise the value of the nonprofit's stake, which the nonprofit will use to fund its philanthropic work.
The foundation said it will initially focus on a $25 billion commitment across two areas: health and curing diseases, and technical solutions to AI resilience. This builds on its $50 million commitment to support nonprofits and mission-focused organizations that OpenAI announced in July 2025.
GATES FOUNDATION Founded in 2000 by Microsoft (MSFT.O) co-founder Bill Gates and his then-wife, Melinda French Gates, the Gates Foundation invested more than $102.3 billion during its first 25 years in global health and development, US education and economic mobility.
In May 2025, Gates said the foundation would spend an additional $200 billion over the next two decades before winding down in December 2045.
The foundation's work through 2045 will focus on three goals: ensuring that no mother or baby dies from a preventable cause, enabling the next generation to grow up without deadly infectious diseases, and helping hundreds of millions of people escape poverty.
It plans a record $9 billion payout in 2026, with about 70% of its budget allocated to advancing those first two goals, which encompass its global health work.
WARREN BUFFETT'S PLEDGE In 2006, the legendary investor Warren Buffett pledged to donate nearly all of his Berkshire stock to philanthropic foundations.
Since then, he has donated over half of his shares, including more than $47 billion to the Gates Foundation and over $17 billion to four family charities.
However, he [USN:L6N43G0T3 TEXT:"stopped"] donating to the Gates Foundation following revelations about interactions between Bill Gates and the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, ending a two-decade philanthropic partnership.
Buffett said [USN:L2N3MW0D5 TEXT:"that he plans to donate"] 99.5% of his remaining wealth to a charitable trust overseen by his daughter and two sons when he dies.
After his death, his children will have about 10 years to give away his remaining wealth and must decide unanimously which philanthropic purposes it should serve.
ELON MUSK'S PLEDGE After Anthropic announced its public fund on Sunday, Elon Musk pledged to give one SpaceX share to "every kid in America."
"Yes, giving shares, which are stakes in the future economy, directly to the people is the way," the SpaceX and Tesla CEO wrote in an X post.
Earlier this year, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell and her husband also pledged a share of their SpaceX stock to each of more than 2 million children under the [USN:L6N43429H TEXT:"Trump Accounts investment initiative"].
MACKENZIE SCOTT'S PLEDGE MacKenzie Scott received about 4% of Amazon's stock in her 2019 divorce from the company's founder Jeff Bezos, a stake then worth about $36 billion.
She signed the Giving Pledge shortly after committing to giving away at least half of her Amazon fortune during her lifetime. The Giving Pledge was founded by Buffett and Bill and Melinda Gates to encourage the world's wealthiest people to donate the majority of their fortunes.
Since then, she has [USN:L2N2VQ1JR TEXT:"donated"] $275 million to Planned Parenthood (in 2022), more than $4 billion to food banks and emergency relief funds [USN:L3N2NX410 TEXT:"during"] the coronavirus pandemic, and billions of dollars in grants to causes such as racial equality, LGBTQ rights and climate change.
Scott gave away $7.1 billion in 2025, according to a Yield Giving letter published last year.
FORD FOUNDATION Established by Henry Ford's son Edsel in 1936 with an initial gift of $25,000, the Ford Foundation grew from a family-backed Michigan philanthropy into one of the world's largest foundations. Its current endowment is valued at about $18 billion.
The 90-year-old foundation awarded $768 million through 2,288 grants in 2024. Its work is aimed at reducing poverty and injustice, strengthening democratic values and promoting international cooperation.
In 2015, it launched BUILD, a five-year, $1 billion investment in the long-term capacity and sustainability of 350 social justice organizations addressing inequality around the world. The foundation renewed BUILD in 2021 with an additional $1 billion.
LILLY ENDOWMENT Established in 1937 by J.K. Lilly and his sons through gifts of stock in the family drugmaker, the Lilly Endowment began with a donation of 17,500 shares valued at $262,500.
Over its first 88 years, the endowment disbursed nearly $21.3 billion in grants to 11,651 charitable organizations. It paid out $3.85 billion in grants in 2025 while its assets rose to nearly $106 billion.
The Indianapolis-based foundation focuses on education, community development and religion, with a particular commitment to Indiana.
NOVO NORDISK FOUNDATION Established in Denmark, the Novo Nordisk Foundation traces its origins to August Krogh, H.C. Hagedorn and August Kongsted, who used profits from insulin production to support scientific and humanitarian work.
The present foundation took shape in 1989, when the foundations associated with Nordisk and Novo were combined following the merger that created Novo Nordisk.
It awarded a record DKK 11.8 billion ($1.77 billion), or about €1.6 billion, across 2,206 grants and philanthropic investments in 2025, up from DKK 10.1 billion in 2024.
Its funding primarily supports research and initiatives spanning human health, infectious and cardiometabolic diseases, the green transition and sustainable agriculture.
($1 = 6.6526 Danish crowns)

items.title: Bank of England's Greene says inflation risks are bigger than thought
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the risks of a pickup in broader inflation as a result of the energy price shock from the Iran war were greater than the BoE expected and she reiterated her view that interest rates should go up.
items.body:
Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the risks of a pickup in broader inflation as a result of the energy price shock from the Iran war were greater than the BoE expected and she reiterated her view that interest rates should go up.
Greene – part of a minority on the BoE's Monetary Policy Committee that has voted for higher rates – said it was better to act as if the so-called second-round effects from the energy shock were stronger and then adjust policy later if needed.
"I therefore continue to believe we should proactively lean against the risk of second-round effects," she said in a speech at the London School of Economics on Tuesday.
So far the BoE has not followed the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank in increasing borrowing costs in response to the Iran war.
But Governor Andrew Bailey, who has backed keeping rates on hold, has [USN:L1N46202H TEXT:"said"] that the longer the conflict goes on, the harder it will be for the BoE not to respond, although he thought inflation pressures remained "quite subdued".
Investors expect the BoE will raise its benchmark Bank Rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 4% next month.
In her speech, Greene said she believed wage growth was running higher than official data has suggested and pay settlements due in early 2027 might come in higher than thought given inflation was likely to be running around 4% then.
She said signs of resilience in Britain's economy this year, despite the energy price jump, added to the case for higher borrowing costs.
"It is not obvious to me from this data that our monetary policy stance is meaningfully restrictive," Greene said.

items.title: WWE, McMahons must face sex abuse claims by former 'ring boys'
items.author: Daniel Wiessner
items.creator: Daniel Wiessner
items.summary: A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s.
items.body:
A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s.
US District Judge James Bredar in Baltimore on Monday rejected claims that a 2023 Maryland law allowing the plaintiffs to sue over decades-old allegations violated the US Constitution and the defendants' right to due process.
The eight anonymous plaintiffs say in the 2024 lawsuit that they were recruited by ringside announcer Melvin Phillips to work as part-time crew members and were abused by him and two other officials at WWE, then known as WWF. Phillips and the other alleged abusers died years before the plaintiffs filed the lawsuit.
WWE and lawyers for Vince McMahon and Linda McMahon, the current US Secretary of Education, did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday.
Greg Gutzler, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, said Maryland's law recognizes that "trauma does not follow a legal deadline."
“This ruling is a significant victory for our clients and for other survivors of childhood sexual abuse who have waited years for the opportunity to seek justice,” Gutzler, of plaintiffs' firm DiCello Levitt, said in a statement.
The Maryland law eliminated a seven-year statute of limitations for sex abuse claims involving minors, which had been extended from three years in 2003. It was part of a wave of state laws adopted after the #MeToo movement allowing sex abuse claims previously blocked by statutes of limitations to proceed, in some cases temporarily.
The plaintiffs in their lawsuit accused WWE and the McMahons of negligence and negligent hiring and retention, and are seeking unspecified damages.
Vince McMahon, who built WWF into a cultural force in the 1980s after purchasing its predecessor from his father, [USN:L1N3EH03B TEXT:"resigned from the organization"] in 2024 amid separate claims of sex trafficking and assault, which [USN:FWN3O60QP TEXT:"he has denied"].
Linda McMahon, his estranged wife, was [USN:L1N3P316M TEXT:"appointed US Secretary of Education"] by President Donald Trump last year after heading the US Small Business Administration during Trump's first term. She and Vince McMahon have previously denied having knowledge of alleged abuse of ring boys.
The defendants argued that Maryland's law violated the US Constitution's ban on retroactive, or ex post facto, laws, and that it violated the Constitution's guarantee of due process as applied to them. They said it could be difficult or impossible to mount a defense as witnesses become unavailable, memories fade and other evidence is lost.
But Bredar on Monday said the law served a legitimate purpose of addressing the barriers that child sex abuse victims face in court, and that the concerns raised by WWE were overblown.
"Plaintiffs can make a case by producing at least some material facts to contest, documents to dispute, and witnesses to cross-examine," the judge wrote.
The Maryland Supreme Court last year rejected arguments that the law violated the state's constitution, which Bredar on Monday said had raised distinct issues from the former ring boys' case.
But the top courts in several other states including Maine, Utah and Kentucky have said in recent years that similar laws were invalid because expired statutes of limitations are not reversible.
The case is Doe v. World Wrestling Entertainment, US District Court for the District of Maryland, No. 1:24-cv-03487.
For the plaintiffs: William Murphy of Murphy Falcon & Murphy; Adam Prom and others from DiCello Levitt
For WWE: Daniel Toal and others from Paul Weiss Rifkind Wharton & Garrison; Linda Woolf of Goodell DeVries Leech & Dann
For Vince McMahon: Christopher Jeffries of Kramon & Graham
For Linda McMahon: William Murphy and Samantha Kavanagh of Zuckerman Spaeder

Oct 20 : SpaceX shareholders want to know when the rocket maker will merge with Tesla, bringing together two of Elon Musk's biggest companies in a union that investors have long speculated about.
"When will SpaceX merge with Tesla?" was the second-most upvoted question — drawing 26 upvotes — submitted by investors to SpaceX management ahead of its third-quarter earnings webcast on Tuesday. The same question received 128 upvotes on the Tesla investor relations site. 
Barclays suggested last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting, with SpaceX the likelier acquirer, though neither company nor Musk has officially committed to favoring a deal.

The top-voted question, with 38 upvotes, was on the progress of Starship's lunar lander hardware, in a list that showed retail investors were focused on Starship while analysts and institutional shareholders pressed for detail on AI revenue and spending. 
SpaceX has made progress testing Starship, but key technologies needed to turn the giant rocket into a lunar lander, including refueling it in orbit, have yet to be fully demonstrated. The company's profitable satellite internet service, Starlink, is helping bankroll heavy spending on chips, terrestrial data centers and Grok, but losses at the AI businesses have ballooned.
While the investor questions list ahead of its second-quarter earnings in August was topped by lighthearted, meme-driven submissions, this quarter's top questions leaned more toward corporate plans, with novelty entries mostly near the bottom.
It was not clear which questions executives would take when the webcast starts at 4:30 p.m. EDT (2030 GMT).
"What share of AI revenue is now under multi-year commitments, and what gives management confidence AI can grow at or above the company's overall rate for several years?" a prospective investor asked, earning no upvotes. SpaceX's AI revenue comes from a handful of customers, including Alphabet's Google and AI lab Anthropic, and the compute contracts can be terminated on about 90 days' notice.
One institutional investor asked how much contracted Google capacity would stay available if a court halted gas turbines at the Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, Tennessee. Another asked whether Google had accepted the full capacity under its cloud agreement and whether SpaceX expected to earn the full contractual monthly rate.
An analyst's six-part question on Starlink satellite capacity, launch priorities and capital spending drew no upvotes.
Lighter submissions were scattered through the list. One user asked whether SpaceX would land a Tesla Roadster — a sports car with rocket thrusters for short jumps in the air — on the moon, adding, "(it) would be awesome."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Activist Jana takes stake in Casella Waste, urges changes
items.author: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.summary: Activist investment firm Jana Partners has built a new position in Casella Waste Systems and wants the regional waste services company to improve its profit margins and returns on invested capital, the firm's managing partner and portfolio manager said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Activist investment firm Jana Partners has built a new position in Casella Waste Systems (CWST.O) and wants the regional waste services company to improve its profit margins and returns on invested capital, the firm's managing partner and portfolio manager said on Tuesday.
The Rutland, Vermont-headquartered company, which has a market value of roughly $5.6 billion, has had its shares fall around 11% this year and has traded roughly flat over the past five years while competitors have performed better.
"Improving margins and operational execution can drive returns on capital, reignite its attractive growth flywheel and unlock Casella’s discounted valuation," Jana managing partner and portfolio manager Scott Ostfeld said at the 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York.
Shares shot up after the news, ending the day at $93.07, up nearly 8%.
Casella's depressed valuation and strong position in the northeastern United States could make it an attractive target for buyers, Ostfeld said.
Casella is one of the last remaining regional solid waste companies in the public market. Buying up waste businesses has been a popular investment theme for private equity and infrastructure funds including Blackstone, EQT, Ares and TPG, and for larger industry buyers including Waste Management (WM.N) and GFL Environmental.
The sector is also inoculated from artificial intelligence risk, Ostfeld said, adding "they have zero AI risk."
Casella did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The company, which was founded five decades ago with a single garbage truck, has struggled to improve its margins and integrate its largest-ever acquisition. In 2023, it bought mid-Atlantic waste assets from GFL Environmental (GFL.TO) for $525 million.
Jana, one of the busiest activist investors in the industry, wants Casella to better align its compensation with shareholder value and to publicly commit to achieving 27% earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) margins by 2029, Ostfeld said. The company reported a margin of 22.7% for its quarter ended June 30, 2026.
To improve performance and better keep pace with its public rivals, Ostfeld said Casella should hire a performance improvement consulting firm, something Jana also pushed for at French fry maker Lamb Weston (LW.N) . Lamb Weston has committed publicly to cutting hundreds of millions of dollars in costs.
Jana is one of the industry's most prolific activist investors and recently [USN:L6N45K00O TEXT:"called on payments company Fiserv"] to work with software provider Palantir to speed up its own technology transformation program.

items.body:
[キーウ／モスクワ　２０日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２０日、ノルウェーの首都オスロで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談した。会談後の記者会見で、ロシアによる弾道ミサイル攻撃に関する情報共有や早期警戒の提供を米国が再開したことに謝意を示した。

ゼレンスキー氏はウィットコフ氏との会談後にノルウェーのストーレ首相、フィンランドのストゥブ大統領と共に行った記者会見で、ウクライナはロシアとの戦争に敗れつつあるわけではないものの、多くの国民の命が失われていると述べ、和平への道を探ることに引き続き取り組む考えを示した。

ストーレ首相は、ウクライナ情勢を巡りゼレンスキー氏、ウィットコフ氏、ストゥブ氏と行った会談について「良好かつ建設的だった」と述べた。また、ウィットコフ氏が２１日にロシアのサンクトペテルブルクを訪問し、ロシア首脳部と会談すると明らかにした。

ロシア国営タス通信は関係筋の話として、ウィットコフ氏が２１日にロシアを訪問すると報じている。

items.title: Instacart settles US probe over foreign worker recruiting for $5 million
items.author: Daniel Wiessner
items.creator: Daniel Wiessner
items.summary: Instacart parent Maplebear will pay $5 million to settle a federal investigation into claims that the grocery delivery company discriminated against American workers through its recruiting and hiring practices, two US agencies said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Instacart parent Maplebear (CART.O) will pay $5 million to settle a federal investigation into claims that the grocery delivery company discriminated against American workers through its recruiting and hiring practices, two US agencies said on Tuesday.
The US Department of Justice and Equal Employment Opportunity Commission said they had uncovered evidence that Instacart preferred to hire foreign workers through an employment-based green card program rather than Americans for unspecified jobs.
Maplebear will pay $1 million in penalties and up to $4 million to affected people who applied for jobs between December 2023 and February 2026, the agencies said. The company also agreed to post job openings available to foreign workers on its public website and accept electronic applications from Americans.
Instacart, in a statement provided by a spokesperson, said the company encourages qualified US job seekers to apply for jobs and seeks to attract broad pools of candidates for open positions.
"While we maintain that our practices complied with all applicable laws and regulations, we’re pleased to have resolved this matter so we can keep our full focus on delivering on our mission for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brands," the company said.
President Donald Trump , a Republican, has [USN:S0N43501J TEXT:"sought to crack down"] on what he says are widespread abuses of foreign worker visa programs. The Justice Department has since last year compiled more than a dozen settlements with companies accused of discriminating against Americans, including [USN:L1N4410V6 TEXT:"a $3.2 million deal"] with OpenAI announced in August. OpenAI denied claims that it discouraged Americans from applying for jobs.
The EEOC, which enforces federal laws banning workplace discrimination, has separately announced a handful of settlements and lawsuits against companies accused of bias against American workers.

items.title: Copper stays range bound as US tariff uncertainty, oil inflation risks weigh
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Copper prices remained range bound as uncertainty over potential US tariffs and inflation risks from higher oil prices kept traders cautious. China’s copper scrap shortage supported refined copper demand, while record high US inventories and cautious buying limited gains. Goldman Sachs expects copper prices to average $15,400 a ton in 2027.
items.body: Copper prices remained stuck in a narrow range on Tuesday, with uncertainty over potential US import tariffs and concerns that higher oil prices could fuel inflation keeping traders cautious, Reuters reported.Three month copper on the London Metal Exchange was up 0.1% at $14,353 a metric ton by 0955 GMT, marking a third straight session of tight trading.The metal has gained 55% since Donald Trump returned to the US presidency in January 2025, even as global demand fell 0.5% to 27 million metric tons, Panmure Liberum analyst Tom Price said in a note.China demand offers supportA shortage of copper scrap in China was providing another source of support. Goldman Sachs said the shortfall was increasing China's need for refined copper through domestic inventory drawdowns, while the US continued importing metal and building stocks ahead of possible tariffs.The Yangshan copper premium, a key gauge of China's demand for imported copper, climbed 0.7% to $138 a ton, its highest level in almost four years.Tariff uncertainty keeps traders cautiousThe White House is yet to decide on tariffs on refined copper, with the administration increasingly focused on affordability ahead of November's midterm elections, Reuters reported in September, citing people familiar with the matter.Chinese broker Everbright Futures said cautious purchasing at high prices and uncertainty over US tariffs could keep copper prices range bound in the near term.Meanwhile, copper inventories on the Comex stood at a record 718,199 metric tons, up sharply from 87,241 in January 2025, highlighting the build up of metal in the US.Goldman Sachs expects copper prices to average $15,400 in 2027, compared with $14,700 at the end of 2026.Supply disruptions also remained in focus. BHP Group and Anglo American reported copper production declines of 19% and 5%, respectively, due to disruptions in Chile, although both maintained their full year output guidance.Among other LME metals, aluminium fell 0.8% to $2,993, zinc lost 0.7% to $3,688, while nickel rose 0.5% to $15,600. Tin gained 0.1% and lead was steady. (Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

Oct 20 : German financial regulator Bafin said on Tuesday it had fined Japanese investment firm Nomura Holdings €320,000 ($359,000) for failing to disclose voting rights in Commerzbank as UniCredit built its stake in the German lender.
• The regulator said Nomura did not submit voting rights notifications relating to Commerzbank in May and June
• Under German law, shareholders must notify the issuer and the regulator within four trading days if their voting rights reach certain thresholds
• If a shareholder does not comply, Bafin can impose a fine of up to €10 million or 5 per cent of total revenue

items.title: Nigéria confirma caso de Ebola em paciente que chegou de Uganda
items.author: Elisha Bala-Gbogbo, Camillus Eboh
items.creator: Elisha Bala-Gbogbo, Camillus Eboh
items.summary: O governo da Nigéria informou nesta terça-feira que registrou um caso de Ebola na capital, Abuja, após exames laboratoriais confirmarem a infecção viral.
items.body:
O governo da Nigéria informou nesta terça-feira que registrou um caso de Ebola na capital, Abuja, após exames laboratoriais confirmarem a infecção viral.
O ministro da Saúde, Muhammad Ali Pate, informou à emissora pública que a paciente havia viajado a Uganda, na África Oriental.
“Ela está em isolamento e recebendo atendimento médico de qualidade. O rastreamento de contatos já foi iniciado e continua em andamento neste momento, com 44 contatos já identificados”, disse Pate à emissora pública NTA.
Questionado sobre o assunto, o porta-voz do governo de Uganda, Alan Kasujja, afirmou: “Não há Ebola em Uganda.”
Pate afirmou em um comunicado que a paciente havia sido internada em um hospital privado em Abuja, onde recebeu atendimento por vários dias antes da confirmação do diagnóstico.
“A Nigéria conteve com sucesso o Ebola em 2014, e temos a experiência e os sistemas de saúde pública necessários para responder a este caso”, afirmou o ministro no comunicado.
A República Democrática do Congo declarou um surto de Ebola em meados de maio e, desde então, tornou-se o segundo maior surto já registrado no mundo, causado pela rara cepa Bundibugyo.
Uganda registrou 20 casos em maio e junho, a maioria importada do Congo, mas foi declarada livre do vírus pela Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) em agosto.
O Quênia registrou nove casos de Ebola neste mês, todos ligados a uma pessoa que havia viajado ao Congo.
A principal agência de saúde pública da África começou a mobilizar apoio para a Nigéria, disse seu diretor, Jean Kaseya.
“Este surto de Ebola da cepa Bundibugyo já se tornou o mais extenso geograficamente da história, afetando... países espalhados por três regiões da África”, disse Kaseya em uma postagem no X.

BRASILIA, Oct 20 : Meta Platforms, owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, told Brazil's Superior Electoral Court on Tuesday that it has adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential campaigns on its platforms.
The filing came after an Electoral Court justice gave the company 24 hours to prove it had implemented measures ensuring equal content distribution ahead of Sunday's election runoff.
• Lula's campaign had initially complained to the court, questioning Meta's actions and alleging the company favored Bolsonaro's candidacy, which Meta denies.
• In a nine-page filing seen by Reuters, Meta listed 17 initiatives it took to comply with the court order.

items.title: イラン、要求履行まで対米協議応じず　仲介役のパキスタンに伝達
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２０日　ロイター] - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２０日、首都テヘランを訪問したパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥と会談し、イランの要求が満たされるまで米国との協議に応じない方針を伝えた。イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長とガリバフ国会議長もムニール氏に同様の見解を伝えており、パキスタンが仲介努力を続ける中、イランは改めて強硬姿勢を示した。

イランのヌールニュースによると、ペゼシュキアン大統領はムニール氏と仲介の取り組みや地域情勢について協議した。

イラン側の発表によると、ムニール氏はガリバフ国会議長とも会談。ガリバフ氏は、イランが先月ホルムズ海峡の通航再開に向けて提示した７項目の条件を米国が履行するまで、米国はイランの信頼を回復することはできないと伝えた。再開の条件にはイランの港湾に対する米国の封鎖の解除、イラン産原油輸出に対する制裁解除、地域全体での敵対行為の停止などが含まれている。

イランのメディアによると、レザイＳＮＳＣ事務局長も別途ムニール氏と会談し、イランの要求が満たされるまでは米国との協議は行わない考えを伝えた。レザイ氏はこのほか、濃縮ウランを含む全ての核物質を全てイラン国内に留めると表明。最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師の見解に沿って、兵器級に近い高濃縮ウランを国外に搬出すべきではないとの考えを改めて強調した。

パキスタンは米国とイランの重要な仲介役を担っており、これまでの仲介努力により６月に暫定和平合意が成立したが、その後数週間で米国とイランの戦闘が再開したため、短期間で事実上破綻した。

items.title: Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York
items.author: Marina Meireles
items.creator: Marina Meireles
items.summary: The facility will produce over 4,400 tons of annual rare earths oxides by 2028 and will create at least 90 new jobs in the region.
items.body:
Phoenix Tailings to build $375M rare earth plant in New York 

Marina Meireles | October 20, 2026 | 9:56 am
Critical Minerals   Intelligence   China   USA   Rare Earth   Rare Earths  

( Image: Phoenix Tailings. )

Phoenix Tailings announced Tuesday it will build a $375-million commercial-scale rare earths processing facility in Rochester, New York, as the US looks to loosen China’s grip on minerals. 

The plant, called Freedom Separation, will process more than 18,000 tons of both mined and recycled rare earth feedstock annually, producing over 4,400 tons per year of separated rare earth oxides at its full capacity. Production is expected to ramp up in 2027 before reaching full capacity in 2028. 

“Technology can give America control over its critical supply chains, but it takes skilled, determined people to turn that promise into production,” Phoenix Tailings CEO and co-founder Nick Myers said in a statement . “Rochester has those people. They know how to build, how to innovate, and how to run world-class industrial operations.”  

Phoenix Tailings selected Eastman Business Park in the city of Rochester for the 500,000-square-foot facility, citing its existing industrial infrastructure and local expertise in engineering, manufacturing, chemical processing and operations.  

New York governor Kathy Hochul said the state will provide $3 million in performance-based tax credits for the project, Reuters reported.  

“I am committed to supporting innovative projects and companies that are ready to invest in New York and bring good-paying jobs,” Hochul said. “Phoenix Tailings will not only create at least 90 new jobs at Eastman Business Park, further supporting our state’s innovation economy, but they will also play a critical role in bolstering our national security by building a supply chain for rare earth elements in New York.” 

Federal backing   

The Rochester facility forms part of Phoenix Tailings’ $1.2 billion Freedom project, a separation and metallization platform designed to close the gap in US midstream rare earth processing capacity. 

The broader initiative is slated to generate more than 500 jobs across New York, Massachusetts and New Hampshire. 

The Freedom Project has secured a $500-million conditional loan commitment from the Department of War’s Office of Strategic Capital. Phoenix’s new facility is also backed by democratic NY state governor and US Senator Chuck Schumer. 

Rare earth refiner gets $500M loan from Pentagon to build ‘Freedom Facility’  

“This is critical for reducing our reliance on foreign processors and protecting our national security,” Schumer said. “I’ve long championed Eastman Business Park as a hub for manufacturing and am glad that new companies are recognizing what I have long known: Upstate New York is a prime destination for new manufacturing investments.” 

(With files from Reuters)

items.body:
Phillips 66 (PSX.N) has barred nearly 400 union workers from its Bayway refinery in Linden, New Jersey, after the collective bargaining agreement and an extension of the contract expired.
The labor dispute at Bayway, the largest refinery on the U.S. East Coast, comes as gasoline and diesel prices remain elevated amid disruptions to global energy supplies from conflicts in the Middle East and Russia. Any operational disruptions could further tighten fuel markets and drive prices higher.
"In the absence of a further extension and to meet our commitment to safe and reliable operations, Phillips 66 has now locked out union-represented employees at those facilities," Phillips 66 said in a statement on Tuesday, adding that it plans to maintain safe operations at the Bayway oil refinery and Linden terminal with trained personnel to continue to meet market demands.
The current collective bargaining agreement with union-represented employees at the Bayway refinery and Linden terminal expired on October 1. The contract extension expired on October 19.
About 385 workers were locked out after the union rejected the company's latest contract offer, Teamsters Local 877 said in a social media post on Monday. Phillips 66's proposal included concessions on wages, healthcare and safety protections, the union said.
Union representatives did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.
The Bayway refinery is capable of processing about 275,000 barrels per day of crude oil. The facility produces a high percentage of transportation fuels including gasoline and diesel for the region.
The labor dispute follows a [USN:L1N4051A8 TEXT:"7-month long lockout"] at BP's (BP.L) Whiting refinery, the largest in the Midwest.

items.title: Dow impulsa al alza a Wall Street; inversionistas se centran en acciones sector sanitario
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Dow impulsó al alza a Wall Street el martes, mientras los inversionistas se centraban en acciones de valor, como las del sector sanitario, mientras que el sector tecnológico se quedaba rezagado tras el repunte registrado en la rueda anterior.
items.body:
El Dow impulsó al alza a Wall Street el martes, mientras los inversionistas se centraban en acciones de valor, como las del sector sanitario, mientras que el sector tecnológico se quedaba rezagado tras el repunte registrado en la rueda anterior.
* El sector sanitario (.SPXHC) lideró las subidas entre los 11 principales índices sectoriales del S&P 500, alcanzando un máximo histórico.
* Eli Lilly (LLY.N) impulsó el índice de referencia junto con los componentes del Dow UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , Merck & Co (MRK.N) , Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) y Amgen (AMGN.O) . La empresa de vacunas Moderna (MRNA.O) alcanzó su nivel más alto desde 2022.
* Los sectores defensivos, como el inmobiliario (.SPLRCR) y el de servicios públicos (.SPLRCU) , también registraron un rendimiento superior, al igual que el índice Russell 2000 de pequeña capitalización (.RUT) .
* Las caídas de las acciones de gran capitalización lastraron al sector de los servicios de comunicación (.SPLRCL) , mientras que los papeles del sector energético (.SPNY) registraron un rendimiento inferior al del mercado, ya que los precios del petróleo bajaron tras alcanzar su máximo en cinco meses.
* Los operadores petroleros sopesaban una reunión entre el presidente iraní y el jefe del ejército de Pakistán —un mediador clave entre EEUU y Teherán— frente a los ataques hutíes contra la infraestructura saudí y las noticias sobre ataques a buques en el Golfo.
* La actividad bursátil fue moderada en el sector tecnológico, que el lunes se había recuperado de la ola de ventas de la semana pasada. A los inversionistas tecnológicos les preocupan los elevados gastos y los costos de financiación de los desarrollos en inteligencia artificial.
* Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 23,79 puntos, o un 0,31%, a 7.714,52 puntos; mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdió 9,05 puntos, o un 0,03%, a 26.421,84 unidades. El Dow Jones (.DJI) subió 547,95 puntos, o un 1,05%, a 52.513,98 unidades.

Oct 20 : Artificial intelligence startup ASI said on Tuesday it had raised $325 million in a funding round valuing the company at $3 billion, amid growing investor appetite for AI software used in real-world applications.
Here are more details:
• The Series C round was led by Spark Capital, with participation from affiliates of Citadel Securities, Meritech Capital and Craft Ventures, among others
• The Boston-based company develops simulation and monitoring software that helps operators forecast disruptions hours, days or weeks in advance across complex systems such as air traffic, power grids and military operations

• "While the broader tech ecosystem spent hundreds of billions teaching AI to manipulate words and generate text, ASI is deeply focused on AI systems that can manage and control physical assets," said Phillip Buckendorf, founder and CEO of ASI
• ASI said it would use the proceeds to expand deployments in energy, logistics and military environments and add to its research and engineering teams in Boston
• The company secured a five-year, $99 million US Army contract in October and a 12-year, $875 million Federal Aviation Administration contract in June, covering military command systems and air traffic management, respectively

items.title: 中国、米政府機関のディープシーク排除に反発　「首脳間の合意無視」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京　２０日　ロイター] - 中国商務省は２０日、米政府が中国の人工知能（ＡＩ）企業「ディープシーク」のモデルを連邦政府機関のＩＴシステムから排除するよう命じたことについて、中国企業の利益を損ない、両国首脳間で合意された事項を無視するものだと批判した。 

同省は声明で、米国に対し「直ちに誤った措置を是正し、関連する差別的な制限措置を撤回する」よう要求。中国政府は事態の推移を注視し、自国の利益を守るために「必要なあらゆる措置を講じる」と述べた。 

さらに、今回の命令に「強い不満を表明し、断固として反対する」とした上で、米国が米中首脳間の合意内容を履行し、中国と「同じ方向で」協力し、米中のＡＩ対話メカニズムを十分に活用することを期待していると述べた。

国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は１９日、米政府の民生部門のＩＴシステムから、ディープシークの製品および同社製モデルを使用した第三者サービスの排除を命じた。同省は、ディープシークのモデルは「複数の脅威の経路」をもたらすと指摘。米政府職員や取引業者が使用した場合、「機密データが中国に流出する可能性がある」との懸念を示した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Aditya Soni　Jaspreet Singh

[２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Aditya Soni　Jaspreet Singh

[２０日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手クアルコムは年次の人事評価を踏まえ、世界で「業績に焦点を当てた人員削減」を実施する。クリスティアーノ・アモン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）から従業員に宛てたメモをロイターが入手した。通知は１１月に始まる予定。

アモン氏は、今回の削減は「より強い業績重視の企業文化」を築く取り組みの一環であり、同社が「期待された成果を継続的に上げられなかった状況に対処するため」のものだと説明。人員削減に当たっては事業の優先事項、組織のニーズ、スキル、専門性を考慮するとした。

メモは影響を受ける人員規模には言及しておらず、ロイターも削減規模を直ちに特定できなかった。

クアルコムはコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。昨年９月時点の世界の従業員数は約５万２０００人で、大半がフルタイム従業員。

今年は主要市場でメモリー価格の高騰が需要を圧迫し、クアルコムは民生用電子機器の販売低迷に見舞われている。

同社株の年初来の上昇率は１．５％にとどまる。Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は１２％超、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（ＳＯＸ）は約６０％、それぞれ上昇している。

items.title: Trump administration loses bid to block NAACP lawsuit against Musk's xAI over data center
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: A federal judge in Mississippi has rejected a bid by President Donald Trump’s administration to dismiss a lawsuit by civil rights groups alleging Elon Musk's xAI violated environmental laws to power an AI data center.
items.body:
A federal judge in Mississippi has rejected a bid by President Donald Trump’s administration to dismiss a lawsuit by civil rights groups alleging Elon Musk's xAI violated environmental laws to power an AI data center.
US District Judge Debra Brown on Monday said the US Environmental Protection Agency could intervene in the case but lacked authority under the Clean Air Act to unilaterally terminate the lawsuit after joining it.
The lawsuit, [USN:L1N40X13Z TEXT:"filed"] in April by the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People and the Mississippi State Conference of the NAACP, alleges that xAI and a subsidiary violated federal law and state regulations by constructing and operating a gas-fired power plant in Southaven, Mississippi, without required permits.
The EPA declined to comment. xAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
In a statement, Abre' Conner, director of the Center for Environmental and Climate Justice at the NAACP, said "our case has always been about holding polluters accountable and making sure that entities follow the law. The court made clear today that the law applies to everyone, including the federal government."
The Trump administration in June [USN:L6N42O0B5 TEXT:"sought to intervene"] on behalf of the EPA and argued that the agency could dismiss the case because federal regulators have authority over Clean Air Act enforcement.
Brown ruled that although the EPA has a right to intervene in such private enforcement suits, there’s nothing in the statute allowing the agency to dismiss a case unless it is pursuing a related action.
"The EPA’s role as a primary enforcer of the Clean Air Act does not mean that the federal government retains complete control over all Clean Air Act litigation," Brown wrote.
Data centers fueling the rise of AI have become a [USN:L6N43G12P TEXT:"political flashpoint"] in communities across the country, with [USN:L1N43F0PK TEXT:"opposition"] uniting voters across ideological lines.
Musk’s xAI also faces [USN:L6N42H16S TEXT:"other lawsuits"] over data centers and power consumption. In one case, a group of Mississippi residents in June alleged that a power plant fueling data centers is blasting “omnipresent and inescapable” noise that has eroded their health and home values.
The case is NAACP et al v. X.AI et al, US District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, No. 3:26-cv-00074-DMB.
For plaintiff: Elias Quinn of EarthJustice and Benjamin Grillot of Southern Environmental Law Center
For defendants: Patrick D. Traylor of Vinson & Elkins, Michael Buschbacher of Boyden Gray and Daniel Van Horn of Butler Snow
Read more:
[USN:L6N42H16S TEXT:"Musk’s xAI, SpaceX hit with class action over data center ‘nuisance’"]
[USN:L6N42O0B5 TEXT:"Trump administration backs Musk’s xAI in NAACP data center lawsuit"]
[USN:L6N43G12P TEXT:"Americans are angry about data centers. Politicians are feeling the pressure"]
[USN:L1N40X13Z TEXT:"NAACP sues Musk's xAI, alleging illegal operation of gas turbines"]

items.title: Monedas cotizan dispares; plazas en Brasil ganan con atención a balotaje presidencial
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron dispares el martes, con algunas perdiendo fuerza incluso en medio de un descenso del dólar a nivel global, mientras los mercados de Brasil avanzaron en medio de posicionamientos previos al balotaje presidencial del domingo.
items.body:
Las principales monedas de América Latina cotizaron dispares el martes, con algunas perdiendo fuerza incluso en medio de un descenso del dólar a nivel global, mientras los mercados de Brasil avanzaron en medio de posicionamientos previos al balotaje presidencial del domingo.
* El dólar descendió en línea con una caída de los precios del petróleo y de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de más largo plazo, mientras los operadores evaluaban el impacto del aumento de la tensión en la guerra de Estados Unidos con Irán y la sostenibilidad de las fuertes entradas de capital hacia las empresas estadounidenses de IA.
* El real brasileño ganó un 0,58% a 5,0182 por dólar, con el mercado atento al balotaje presidencial. Mientras, el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) escaló preliminarmente un 1,43% a 208.017 puntos, con datos mostrando flujos de inversores extranjeros hacia las acciones locales antes de la segunda vuelta de la elección del fin de semana.
* Los sondeos muestran una estrecha carrera entre el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, aunque la mayoría de las pesquisas dan una leve ventaja para Bolsonaro, quien ganó la primera vuelta pese a que las encuestas daban ventaja al mandatario.
* El peso mexicano cotizaba estable camino al cierre, a 18,4194 unidades por dólar, después de moverse entre alzas y bajas aunque en un rango estrecho.
* A nivel local, los inversionistas asimilaban cifras preliminares que mostraron que la [USN:S0N45D031 TEXT:"actividad económica"] se expandió un 3,7% en septiembre a tasa interanual.
* En tanto, el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, cedió parte de sus fuertes alzas de más temprano y ganó un 0,38%, a 69.272,14, marcando su cuarta sesión seguida de avances en medio de los primeros resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* El peso chileno , cerró las operaciones con un alza del 0,68%, a 974,20/974,50 por dólar, y alcanzó su mayor nivel de cierre en dos semanas, impulsado por el retroceso del billete verde en los mercados globales.
* Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , revirtió un avance previo y retrocedió un 0,42%, a 10.926,50 puntos.
* El peso colombiano borró ganancias iniciales y finalizó con caída de un 0,51% a 3.174 unidades por dólar; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) subió un 0,47% a 2.533,22 puntos.
* El peso interbancario argentino cedió un 0,03% a 1.525 por dólar con intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA), que supera compras por 15.600 millones de dólares en el transcurso del 2026. La entidad adquirió 103 millones de dólares el martes.
* La Secretaría de Finanzas argentina realizaba durante la jornada una conversión de títulos para ofrecer a modo de canje anticipado y reducir la potencial volatilidad cambiaria antes de la fijación del precio el 27 de octubre.
* El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, cayó un 0,17% al cierre, tras una jornada de fuerte volatilidad luego escalar más de un 1% durante la sesión. En la rueda previa se hundió un 1,84%.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , cedió leves alzas iniciales y finalizó estable a 3,4250/3,4270 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió fuerza y cerró con una mínima alza del 0,03% a 1.579,07 puntos.

items.title: US coaxing refiners to produce more diesel as prices surge, energy officials say
items.author: Nathan Crooks, Arathy Somasekhar
items.creator: Nathan Crooks, Arathy Somasekhar
items.summary: Two top US Energy Department officials said on Tuesday they were working with refiners at home and abroad to boost fuel output as a diesel shortage has raised prices, driving dissatisfaction among voters with the White House ahead of the November midterm elections.
items.body:
Two top US Energy Department officials said on Tuesday they were working with refiners at home and abroad to boost fuel output as a diesel shortage has raised prices, driving dissatisfaction among voters with the White House ahead of the November [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"].
Diesel prices have jumped to record highs because of disruptions from the Iran war and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries . Retail diesel prices averaged about $6.32 a gallon on Tuesday, according to motorist group AAA.
The Trump administration has taken several steps to try to lower fuel prices that have surged since the start of the Iran war on February 28, including relaxing restrictions on Russian diesel exports, invoking the Defense Production Act to boost output and allowing commercial vehicles to run on red-dyed diesel normally limited to off-road equipment.
Diesel is critical to the global economy, powering much of the transport, agriculture and heavy industry that underpin global trade and economic activity. The high cost of fuel has soured voters on US President Donald Trump's stewardship of the economy, with 36% approving of Trump on that issue, according to the most recent Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll .
"We are talking about reopening every refinery we can," Energy Secretary Chris Wright said in Houston. "There are dialogues there, and that's a tough challenge. I'm not saying all these are going to happen."
DIFFICULT TO RAISE US OUTPUT US refineries are running near full capacity, and with several facilities shutting in recent years, there is little leeway to quickly boost domestic output, analysts say.
[USN:L6N3Q20MK TEXT:"Refinery expansions"] are capital intensive and take months, if not years, to complete depending on the complexity of the additions.
Wright said the US is also working with India to increase refining output there to bring products to global markets.
American Petroleum Institute CEO Mike Sommers told Reuters on the sidelines of an energy forum in Titusville, Pennsylvania that US refiners are running at 95% to 100% of capacity. He said they are putting off planned maintenance because of high prices.
“The American refiners are doing everything they can,” Sommers said. He said that using the Defense Production Act to restart idled plants, as the administration has floated, would require a lot of capital.
Last week, Vice President JD Vance said the administration would use the Defense Production Act to [USN:L6N45Z1BU TEXT:"expand capacity"] of a Texas refinery owned by Delek US Holdings (DK.N) .
Trump signed legislation last year that included $1 billion in Defense Production Act funding for energy-related projects deemed critical to national security.
Wright said there was "more to do" on refining and the Defense Production Act but did not provide additional details.
Sommers singled out China's spare refining capacity, saying their government is currently barring diesel exports. Beijing “is really going to be the key if we’re going to get long-term prices down,” he said.
A spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in Washington said the key to resolving the issue is to achieve a ceasefire in Iran. "China stands ready to maintain communication with all sides to jointly safeguard global energy security and keep industrial and supply chains stable," the spokesperson added.
PUSH FOR EUROPEAN DIESEL Trump [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"temporarily waived sanctions"] this month on Russian diesel in an attempt to lower prices. Russian diesel will likely move to New England, if it moves to the US at all, Wright said. Already, cargoes from Russia are returning to their[USN:L6N4660PS TEXT:" traditional destinations"] after the US suspended sanctions, with two tankers signaling trips to Turkey and Brazil in recent days, Reuters reported on Tuesday.
The Trump administration has also been pushing Europe to release more fuel to balance global markets.
"We are working with our friends ... to find new and innovative ways to get more throughput" through refineries, said Energy Department Under Secretary Kyle Haustveit at the Drake Forum in Titusville.
While the Trump administration has pushed Europe to release 50 million barrels of diesel, an agreement by industrialized nations fell short of that target. The Paris-based International Energy Agency said last week it would speed the release of crude and oil product volumes pledged in March, including more than 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible.
Fatih Birol, chief of the IEA, which coordinates industrialized nations' releases of oil from emergency stocks, said on Tuesday the [USN:L6N4660MV TEXT:"group is ready"] to coordinate more oil releases by member countries if needed.

items.title: 英、サウジ防空支援へ戦闘機派遣　フーシ派攻勢に対応
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 英国防省は２０日、空軍のタイフーン戦闘機をサウジアラビアに派遣し、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻勢に対応した防空任務に当たると明らかにした。サウジ政府からの要請に基づくもので、フーシ派への攻撃は行わないという。

フーシ派はここ数週間で、サウジの石油施設などに対する攻撃を強めている。英国は、攻撃が地域の安定を脅かし、エネルギー供給や貿易の混乱を招く恐れがあると警戒している。

ストリーティング国防相は声明で「サウジに対するフーシ派の攻撃継続は卑劣だ」と指摘。リヤドの空港が標的となったことなどに情勢の悪化具合が示されているとし、追加支援を承認したと述べた。「タイフーンはドローンやミサイルからサウジ空域を守る防衛任務に就く」と説明した。今年９月に発表した空中給油に加え、支援を拡大。輸送機や軍事顧問も派遣する。バーナム首相は今月、要請があれば追加支援を検討する用意があると述べていた。

イエメン当局によると、フーシ派は１９日、サウジが支援する暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設を攻撃し、５８人が死亡した。

items.summary: El índice del riesgo país de Argentina renovó el martes su máximo nivel desde finales de octubre del 2025 por una mayor diferencia en las paridades de los bonos soberanos ante los de Estados Unidos, producto de la prudencia inversora de las últimas semanas.
items.body:
El índice del riesgo país de Argentina renovó el martes su máximo nivel desde finales de octubre del 2025 por una mayor diferencia en las paridades de los bonos soberanos ante los de Estados Unidos, producto de la prudencia inversora de las últimas semanas.
Este referencial actualizado a diario por el banco J.P. Morgan llegó a trepar a los 710 puntos básicos de manera intradiaria.
Junto a una fuerte volatilidad, pasó a reacomodarse luego en torno a los 672 puntos (2000 GMT), contra unas 675 unidades el lunes, su máximo nivel en el último año, una tendencia genérica que preocupa al mercado argentino por el recorte de liquidez.
El Gobierno del libertario Javier Milei trata de bajar la efervescencia que esto provoca entre los ahorristas al señalar que la sumatoria de más reservas e intercambio de monedas activados servirían como sostén en caso de cualquier presión financiera extra.
"Hay instrumentos que el Gobierno puede activar en caso de una corrida cambiaria, por ejemplo, pero al mercado le incomoda por incremento del costo ver un riesgo país por arriba de los 700 puntos desde los 400 (puntos) logrados a comienzo de julio", dijo un analista de un banco chino que opera en Buenos Aires.
La deuda pública extrabursátil promedió una pérdida del 0,2%, con dolarización de carteras y tras el derrumbe del 1,3% el lunes, mientras que el índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa porteña cayó un ligero 0,17% al cierre, tras absorber un alza inicial y contra un debut negativo del 1,84%.
Este indicador bursátil renovó su nombre el lunes, otorgando la oportunidad ahora de poder ser comprado como un activo más, al estilo de los grandes índices del mundo y para tener una mayor competitividad frente a los fondos comunes de inversión.
Las próximas elecciones presidenciales de Argentina, a finales del 2027, comienzan a generar síntomas de cautela ya que Milei dijo que irá por su reelección, pero la tendencia de las encuestas no tranquiliza los negocios.
A esto se suma el riesgo geopolítico global latente, lo que aumenta la aversión al riesgo en general.
Al respecto, la consultora Quantum Finanzas dijo que "la suba del petróleo y nuevas dudas sobre la inversión en 'IA' presionan a los futuros de los índices bursátiles estadounidenses".
El peso interbancario cedió apenas un 0,03% a 1.525 por dólar con intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA), que supera compras por 15.600 millones de dólares en el transcurso del 2026. Estas adquisiciones sumaron 103 millones de dólares este martes.
Un reciente informe interno del BCRA indicó que restan cerca de 4.000 millones de dólares por liquidar de emisiones corporativas, con un neto de poco más de 2.000 millones tras descontar pagos de empresas.
En octubre, las colocaciones de deuda corporativa y subsoberana suman alrededor de 100 millones de dólares, según operadores.
Mientras tanto, la Secretaría de Finanzas llevaba a cabo durante la jornada una conversión de títulos para ofrecer a modo de canje anticipado y reducir la potencial volatilidad cambiaria antes de la fijación del precio el 27 de octubre.
Esta negociación permitirá a los tenedores del bono 'dollar-linked' con vencimiento a fin de octubre (D30O6) canjearlo por instrumentos con amortización a fines de noviembre próximo, o en enero y en junio de 2027.
El Gobierno viene de reportar superávit en la balanza comercial ([USN:L1N4650UP TEXT:"ICA"]) de septiembre por 2.976 millones de dólares, con exportaciones récord por arriba de los 10.000 millones, mientras el miércoles se conocerá la actividad económica de agosto ([USN:L1N4660KB TEXT:"EMAE"]), en momentos de temor por una potencial recesión en el tercer trimestre del año.

items.title: ＥＵ、北極圏の化石燃料開発阻止で新戦略　ロシア念頭に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュッセル ２０日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は２０日に発表した新たな北極戦略で、「北極圏を含め、石油・石炭・ガスを地中にとどめることを確保する」ことに引き続き取り組む方針を示した。欧州委員会とカラス外交安全保障上級代表（外相に相当）が発表した。

戦略文書は、「北極圏の特有の脆弱性を踏まえ、欧州委はパートナーと協力して北極の環境を保護し、北極の生態系に脅威をもたらす全ての炭化水素資源開発を防ぐ」としている。

欧州委員会のフォンデアライエン委員長は新戦略の発表に際し、ロシアが北極圏で軍事的プレゼンスを再構築しており、同地域の安全保障を支えてきた価値観はもはや当然のものと見なせないと指摘。「北極圏は地政学のプレート（岩板）がぶつかり合う場所の一つだ。他人の最前線ではない。欧州連合の一部だ」と言明した。

ただ、新戦略には、２０２１年に打ち出した前戦略に盛り込まれていた、北極圏などで今後の炭化水素資源開発を認めないための「多国間の法的義務」実現に向けて取り組むとの誓約や、そうした開発による生産物を購入しないとの誓約は含まれていない。

ＥＵ当局者は、変更について「現地の世界情勢は変わりつつあり、この取り組みを始めてから５年が経過した今、各国・各主体の立場を踏まえると、そうした多国間での意思決定に到達するのは一層難しくなっている」との認識を反映したものだと説明した。

ノルウェーはＥＵに対し、北極圏での新たな掘削への反対姿勢を取り下げるよう求めてきた。老朽化した油田・ガス田が多いノルウェーでは、エクイノールなどが新たな鉱床を発見しない限り、生産量は２０３０年代に減少に向かう見通し。

items.title: トランプ政策「ほとんど阻止できない」、民主が下院奪還でも＝財務長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官は２０日、野党民主党が下院の過半数を奪還したとしても、トランプ政権の政策を阻止するためにできることはほとんどないとの認識を示した。

中間選挙を２週間後に控え、ベセント氏はデジタルメディア「２Ｗａｙ」のインタビューで、（阻止するためにできることは）「非常に限られていると思う」と語った。その上で「われわれは非常に強固な関税発動権限がある」とし、トランプ大統領が各国からの輸入品に広範な関税を課していることに対する民主党の反対姿勢に言及した。

１１月３日に投票が行われる今回の中間選挙では、連邦議会の主導権争いが焦点となる。共和党は現在、上下両院で僅差の過半数を握っている。

ベセント氏はまた、イランを経済的に孤立させる財務省の取り組みは奏功していると指摘。「８月以降、イランのカーグ島にある石油施設からの積み出しは一切確認されていない。イランは現在、海上に石油を保有していない」とした上で、「パニックが広がり始めている。あと４週間かかるのか、８週間かかるのかは分からないが、ある時点でイラン経済は一気に崩壊局面に入るだろう」と語った。

ベセント氏はそのほか、ロシアのプーチン大統領が１２月にフロリダで開かれる主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）首脳会議への招待を受諾したかどうかについてはまだ聞いていないと述べた。

Musk is on a donation spree—SpaceX shares for US kids to $276 million for Republican groups

Musk’s political donations are far higher than those of most individual donors. His plan to give every child in America a SpaceX share could be worth an estimated $10.5 billion.

Sakshi Mehra

New Delhi: Elon Musk is in a giving mood. Over the past few days, he has announced a plan to give a SpaceX share to every child in America. Meanwhile, newly disclosed filings show he has donated more than $276 million to Republican political groups since July, making him the biggest known donor of the 2026 midterm election cycle.

Musk’s political donations are far higher than those of most individual donors. His plan to give every child in America a SpaceX share could be worth an estimated $10.5 billion. 

However, not all the money he has announced has been given. Some are pledges, some are prize money, while others have gone to organisations closely linked to his businesses.

Show Full Article

SpaceX share for every American child

Musk said on 19 October that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to every kid in America next year, calling it “the first of many.”  The plan would cover about 72 million children and is estimated to be worth $10.5 billion, based on SpaceX’s reported share price. 

$158 million to Senate Republicans

Musk donated $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, the main Republican super PAC focused on Senate elections. Much of the money was directed toward supporting Texas Republican Ken Paxton’s Senate campaign. 

More than $76 million to America PAC

Musk also gave more than $76 million to America PAC, the political committee he founded in 2024. The PAC is running voter-turnout operations in competitive Senate and House races. As its founder and biggest financial supporter, Musk plays a major role in funding its political activities.

$20 million to House Republicans

Musk donated $20 million to the Congressional Leadership Fund, the leading super PAC supporting Republican candidates for the House of Representatives. The money will support Republican efforts to defend their majority in the House during the midterm elections.

$10 million to Ken Paxton’s Texas campaign

Musk gave $10 million to the Lone Star Liberty PAC, which supports Paxton’s campaign for the US Senate in Texas. Musk lives near SpaceX’s Starbase facility in South Texas, adding a personal and business connection to his political spending in the state.

$10 million to Republican governors

Musk donated $10 million to the Republican Governors Association, which supports Republican candidates running for governor across the US. 

$2 million to Republican attorneys general

Musk gave $2 million to the Republican Attorneys General Association, which supports Republican candidates for state attorney general offices. These officials can play an important role in legal challenges to federal policies, making the association another part of Musk’s political giving.

$500,000 to Greg Abbott

Earlier in 2026, Musk donated $500,000 to Texans for Governor Greg Abbott, according to Texas campaign-finance filings. The contribution was made during the first six months of the year and adds to his financial support for Republican politicians in Texas.

(Edited by Aamaan Alam Khan)

items.title: ウクライナ向け迎撃弾未納の可能性、政治的意図はない＝米国務長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ムンバイ　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ムンバイ　２０日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２０日、ウクライナ向け優先調達要件リスト（ＰＵＲＬ）プログラムに基づき購入された迎撃用ミサイルの一部が未納になっている可能性を認めた。ただ、その理由については政治的な意図によるものではないと述べた。

ルビオ氏は記者団に対し「重要なのは、ウクライナに損害を与えようとする意図的な政治的指示があったわけではないということだ」とし、「ウクライナに対して意図的に供与が差し止められているものはない」と述べた。

ルビオ氏はまた、２０日にウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と４５分間にわたり電話会談を行ったと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、電話会談で弾道ミサイル迎撃システムやロシアの攻撃に関する早期警戒体制のほか、米スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」とその軍用版「スターシールド」を巡る問題について協議した。

ゼレンスキー氏は２０日、ノルウェーの首都オスロで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談する予定。トランプ米大統領がロシアへの接近を強める中、過去２週間で急激に悪化した対米関係の修復を試みる。

items.title: US FDA issues guidance on apps used with prescription drugs
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US FDA on Tuesday issued guidance aimed at clarifying how drug companies can develop, distribute and label apps used alongside their prescription medicines.
items.body:
The US FDA on Tuesday issued guidance aimed at clarifying how drug companies can develop, distribute and label apps used alongside their prescription medicines.
Here are some details:
The policy outlines when content in such apps must be submitted to the US Food and Drug Administration, when those apps should be referenced in a drug's prescribing information, and what information companies need to provide to the health regulator.
Apps linked to medical devices, such as software paired with an asthma inhaler, should generally be included in an associated drug's label, the FDA said
Standalone apps that track symptoms, provide reminders or offer coaching should be listed in the label only if these apps are essential for the medicine's safe and effective use or offer meaningful clinical benefit, it said
In most cases, information displayed to patients through a companion app will be treated as promotional material, in line with the regulator's approach to other forms of drug advertising
The FDA said the guidance intends to reduce regulatory uncertainty for drugmakers and technology developers while maintaining safety and effectiveness standards

items.title: ロシア、ウクライナ西部のエネ施設にも攻撃拡大　停電相次ぐ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [キーウ　２０日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[キーウ　２０日　ロイター] - ロシアは、ウクライナ東部および中部に加え、これまで標的にしていなかった西部地域のエネルギー施設にも攻撃を拡大しており、各地で停電が相次いでいる。ウクライナのエネルギー省当局者や地元当局が２０日、明らかにした

ウクライナのネクラソフ・エネルギー相代理はテレビ演説で「残念ながら、敵は引き続き意図的かつ組織的にわれわれのエネルギーインフラを攻撃している」とし、「攻撃の結果、一部の消費者が停電に見舞われた」と述べた。

同氏によると、ロシアは中部キロボフラード州、西部のジトーミル、リビウ、リブネ、テルノピリ、フメリニツキーの各州、南部オデーサのエネルギー施設を攻撃した。

ロシアは寒冷期入りを前にした１０月、ウクライナのエネルギー部門への攻撃を再開し、発電所や送電システムを標的にしている。ウクライナ最大の民間エネルギー会社ＤＴＥＫは２０日、ロシアによる夜間攻撃でオデーサにある同社のエネルギー施設３カ所が被弾し、３万２７００世帯が停電状態にあると明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー大統領は１８日、トランプ米大統領が１１日に、ロシアとウクライナがエネルギー施設への攻撃停止に合意したと突然発表して以降の１週間で、ロシアはウクライナのエネルギー、石油・ガス部門を数十回にわたり攻撃したと明らかにした。

items.title: ＧＭ株8％安、通期ＥＰＳ予想が市場予想下回る　第3四半期は増益
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kalea Hall

[２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kalea Hall

[２０日 ロイター] - 米自動車大手ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）の株価が２０日の市場で８％超急落している。２０日発表した第３・四半期決算は、ピックアップトラックの販売が好調で中核的な利益が大幅に増加した。ただ、通期の１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しがアナリスト予想を下回ったほか、今後数カ月はコモディティーコストの上昇とトラック販売の減少による圧迫を見込むと示唆した。

ＧＭは２０２６年通期の一時的な項目を除いた金利・税引き前利益（調整後ＥＢＩＴ）について、従来予想の１４０億─１６０億ドルから１４５億─１５５億ドルへとレンジを狭めた。この結果、通期の１株当たり調整後ＥＰＳ予想は１２．７５─１３．７５ドルとなった。ＧＭ予想の中央値はＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の中央値１３．４１ドルを下回っている。

ＧＭは、主力車種であるシボレー・シルバラードとＧＭＣシエラの刷新版の投入準備に伴い、第４・四半期はトラック納車台数の減少が業績の重しになると見込んでいる。

ポール・ジェイコブソン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は電話会見で「消費者は驚くほど底堅さを維持している。弱さを示す兆候は何も見られない」と述べた。

ただ、ジェイコブソン氏は、特に鉄鋼、アルミニウム、物流について、過去２カ月でコストが急上昇したとも指摘。コモディティー関連費用が足元の水準から緩和しなければ、来年のＧＭの最終利益を２０億ドル押し下げる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＪＰモルガンは、コスト上昇に加え、高価格帯トラックに偏重した販売構成を維持できるかどうかの不透明感を踏まえ、投資家は「現時点では見通しへの確信に疑問を抱く可能性が高い」との見方を示した。

第３・四半期の調整後ＥＢＩＴは前年同期比２２％増の４１億ドルとなった。１株当たりでは３．７０ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧのデータに基づくアナリスト予想の３．６３ドルを上回った。

第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比２．９％増の５００億ドル。北米事業の利益率は、四半期販売台数がわずかに減少したものの、前年同期の６．２％から８．７％に改善した。

大型ピックアップトラックの販売構成比が高まる一方、電気自動車（ＥＶ）の販売が減少し、収益を押し上げた。ＥＶは従来赤字が続いているうえ、トランプ米政権のＥＶ支援撤回を受け、ＧＭはＥＶ販売を縮小している。

ＣＦＲＡのアナリスト、ギャレット・ネルソン氏は、ＧＭが今年、米国でのシェアを落としている点を指摘し、ＧＭがほぼ手がけていないハイブリッド車との競争を背景に挙げた。ＧＭは過去１０年、ハイブリッド車を提供しないと決定しＥＶに全面的に注力してきたが、ハイブリッド車は現在、米国販売の１５％超を占めている。

ＧＭは「今後の道のりはより厳しくなる」としたものの、消費者の底堅い需要が続き、コモディティーや物流分野でのコスト圧力が和らぐことを前提に、来年の業績は改善するとの見通しを改めて示した。

ＧＭ取締役会は、複数年にわたる総額２００億ドルの自社株買いプログラムを承認した。ＧＭは２０２３年以降で約２９５億ドルの自社株を買い戻している。
