items.title: ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders
items.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, but the chipmaker may struggle to meet demand amid US export restrictions on China ...
items.body:
Home / World News / ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders

ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion in Nvidia chip orders ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards, but the chipmaker may struggle to meet demand amid US export restrictions on China

(Photo: Reuters)

Reuters 5 min read Last Updated : Oct 20 2026 | 9:38 PM IST

Listen to This Article

ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of Nvidia's new RTX PRO 5500 graphics cards with a collective sticker price of over $35 billion, two people familiar with the matter said, in a rush for a less powerful but export-compliant chip amid US restrictions on trade with China.
  US-based chipmaker Nvidia has told customers and partners it cannot guarantee that it can fill the orders because demand from Chinese technology companies far exceeds planned production, the two sources and a third person familiar with the matter said. They requested anonymity because they are not authorised to speak to the media.

 

  The RTX PRO 5500 is a workstation chip designed for powerful professional computers rather than the large data centre clusters that use Nvidia's most advanced AI processors. But it is among the most powerful Nvidia chips that are still available to Chinese buyers.
  Nvidia's Blackwell-based B300 data centre chip is not allowed to be sold to Chinese buyers under US export controls, while exports of its Hopper-based H200 are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and are subject to licensing conditions.
  One source said Nvidia told partners they might receive only 5 per cent to 10 per cent of the quantities requested. Another said the company had indicated it could produce no more than 3 million RTX PRO 5500 cards globally in 2027. Total orders from customers in China have exceeded 6 million, two of the sources said.

Also Read

Amazon launches TorchNeuron to challenge Nvidia's AI chip dominance

Samsung to tap TSMC technology for Nvidia's custom memory chips: Report

Would halt chip supply to buyers who develop unsafe AI, says Nvidia CEO

Alibaba unveils $450 Qwen AI glasses in expanding push into gadgets

Beyond Nvidia: Why tech firms are turning to custom chips for AI inference

  The three Chinese tech giants' orders are for cards priced at about $11,400 each, two of the sources said, giving them a potential combined value of more than $35 billion.
  The scale of the orders, which have not been previously reported, underscores the ongoing appetite among Chinese companies for Nvidia hardware despite the US curbs.
  Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has said the restrictions reduced Nvidia's share of China's AI data centre chip market from a near monopoly to effectively nothing. But demand for the RTX PRO 5500 suggests Nvidia retains a sizeable potential market in China through less powerful products that may still be available.

  The surge in demand also highlights how US restrictions have tightened computing power supplies in the world's second-largest economy as Chinese companies race to develop cutting-edge AI models and propel Beijing's effort to deploy the technology across its industries.
  Washington's curbs have pushed Chinese firms towards domestic suppliers, while Beijing has encouraged the use of homegrown chips.
  Huawei, in particular, has gained market share, though Chinese chipmakers have generally struggled to match leading American products, partly because separate restrictions have limited access to the foreign equipment that is used to make the most advanced semiconductors.
  An Nvidia spokesperson said Chinese producers of workstation chips and cards have experienced "unprecedented growth since 2022," when the curbs were first imposed.

  "US firms continue to be restricted by a combination of outdated US export controls, which cover gaming products released nearly a half decade ago, and China's own limit on US imports," the spokesperson said.
  ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent did not respond to requests for comment.
  The US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees the export controls, and China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology did not respond to requests for comment.
  An export-compliant alternative
  The RTX PRO 5500 is less powerful than Nvidia's H200 and B300 chips, which are designed to be linked in large numbers for the most demanding AI training and deployment workloads.

  Chinese companies are seeking to use the cards primarily for AI inference, or running trained models to generate chatbot responses, the three sources said. Inference generally requires less computing power than training models on massive datasets.
  The RTX PRO 5500 is similar to the RTX 6000D in performance, according to product specifications seen by Reuters.
  Nvidia launched the RTX 6000D in the middle of last year as a reduced-capability product designed to meet US export restrictions. Major Chinese tech firms initially showed little interest, with some declining to place orders, Reuters reported last year.
  At the time, buyers viewed the chips as overly expensive given their capabilities and hoped Washington would eventually allow sales of more powerful Nvidia processors.

  Those expectations have faded as restrictions have remained in place and AI computing capacity has remained scarce, making the RTX PRO 5500 a more attractive substitute, two of the sources said.
  Supply squeeze
  Nvidia's inability to promise full deliveries reflects both a surge in demand and its manufacturing priorities, two of the sources said.
  Starting in 2027, Nvidia is expected to devote much of its capacity at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co to Rubin, its next-generation platform for large-scale data centres, rather than products like the RTX PRO 5500, two of the sources said. TSMC declined to comment.
  Nvidia has told customers to expect early samples in December, with commercial deliveries beginning in the first quarter of 2027, they added.

  The RTX 6000D has since been discontinued and its market price in China has doubled, one of the sources said.
  In an October 13 filing, Shenzhen-listed fintech and AI computing services company Tansun Technology said it had agreed to buy 20,000 RTX PRO 5500 cards from an unidentified counterparty.
  It cautioned that supply shortages, industry demand and overseas technology controls could delay deliveries or reduce volumes.

items.title: Congreso de Colombia aprueba presupuesto de gastos para 2027 por 634,9 billones de pesos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El Congreso de Colombia aprobó el martes el presupuesto de gastos para 2027 por 634,9 billones de pesos (201.168 millones de dólares), que contempla una reasignación de recursos entre diferentes sectores, un recorte en rubros relacionados con el acuerdo de paz y un incremento de los recursos destinados al pago del servicio de la deuda.
items.body:
El Congreso de Colombia aprobó el martes el presupuesto de gastos para 2027 por 634,9 billones de pesos (201.168 millones de dólares), que contempla una reasignación de recursos entre diferentes sectores, un recorte en rubros relacionados con el acuerdo de paz y un incremento de los recursos destinados al pago del servicio de la deuda.
La cifra supera los 555,8 billones de pesos del presupuesto vigente para 2026.
El presupuesto del próximo año prevé un déficit fiscal de 9,4% del Producto Interno Bruto (PIB).
El Senado aprobó la ley de presupuesto el lunes en la noche con 57 votos a favor y uno en contra, mientras que la Cámara de Representantes lo hizo el martes en la madrugada con 112 votos a favor y uno en contra.
"Gracias a todos ustedes por habernos dado este voto de confianza, vamos a lograr sacar al país de esta situación económica tan compleja y para eso el presupuesto, sin lugar a dudas, es un primer paso muy importante", dijo el ministro de Hacienda, Miguel Gómez, después de la aprobación en el Senado.
El Gobierno planea presentar al Congreso la denominada "Ley de Rescate" para recortar el gasto público el próximo año, con lo que el déficit fiscal se ajustaría al 7,2% del PIB, según el Ministerio de Hacienda.
El presupuesto de gastos de 2027 asigna 141 billones de pesos (44.672 millones de dólares) para el pago de la deuda, 93 billones de pesos (29.464,7 millones de dólares) para educación, 84,6 billones de pesos (26.803 millones de dólares) para salud y 74,9 billones de pesos (23.730 millones de dólares) para defensa.
RECORTES DEL GASTO La reasignación de recursos realizada por el Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella provocó un recorte en el presupuesto de funcionamiento de la Jurisdicción Especial para la Paz (JEP) y la Unidad de Búsqueda de Personas dadas por Desaparecidas (UBPD), creadas en virtud del acuerdo de paz de 2016 firmado con la antigua guerrilla de las Fuerzas Armadas Revolucionarias de Colombia (FARC).
El recorte a la JEP fue de alrededor de 181.000 millones de pesos, recursos que se trasladaron al Ministerio de Defensa, según el Ministerio de Hacienda.
La reducción equivale al 23% del presupuesto del tribunal, un recorte mayor que el previsto.
El tribunal advirtió que la decisión limitará las investigaciones y los juicios por violaciones de los derechos humanos, dificultará la prestación de asistencia jurídica y apoyo psicológico a las víctimas, así como el pago de sus gastos de viaje, y pondrá en riesgo los planes de seguridad para proteger a las víctimas y a los excombatientes.
El presupuesto operativo de la UBPD se redujo en casi un 22%.
La unidad, que busca al menos a 137.000 personas desaparecidas durante el conflicto armado, que continúa y ha dejado más de 450.000 muertos, ha advertido que un recorte de esa magnitud pondrá en peligro la toma de muestras de ADN de las familias y unas 10.000 exhumaciones previstas.
La cuarta economía de América Latina enfrenta grandes desafíos para poner en orden sus cuentas fiscales, lo que elevará su endeudamiento público este año y el próximo, y la alejará cada vez más de la posibilidad de recuperar el grado de inversión que perdió en 2021.
Además, el país sudamericano busca un acuerdo con el Fondo Monetario Internacional para conseguir financiamiento más barato y enfrentar el complicado panorama económico.
(1 dólar = 3.156,32 pesos)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - ニデックは２０日、会計不正などを受けた役員責任調査委員会の調査報告書（概要版）を公表した。報告書は、創業者の永守重信氏について、グループ各社の会計不正の疑いについて取締役会・監査役会に報告して必要な調査を求めなかったことなどから任務を怠った監視義務違反が認められると指摘。同氏や岸田光哉前社長ら９人について、会社法などに基づく損害賠償責任を認定した。

ニデックは１６日に報告書を受領し、必要な非開示措置を施して２０日公表した。既に永守、岸田両氏らに対し、損害賠償請求など必要な法的措置を検討し、速やかに対応する方針を示している。９人には、過去に日本電産（現ニデック）社長を務め、現在は電子機器受託製造大手、台湾の鴻海（ホンハイ）精密工業で電気自動車（ＥＶ）事業の最高戦略責任者を務める関潤氏も含まれる。 

報告書は「公正かつ透明性の高い資本市場を構築する屋台骨である企業会計（会計基準）及び会計監査制度が蔑ろにされてきた」と非難。その上で、モーター製造分野で世界をリードしてきたニデックが「現在（いま）を最後の機会と、不退転の覚悟で第三者委員会報告書の提言を確実に実行し、資本市場の信用を回復することを願う」と結んだ。

items.title: EssilorLuxottica's smart glasses boom runs into tougher regulatory scrutiny
items.author: Elisa Anzolin, Gianluca Lo Nostro, Elizabeth Howcroft
items.creator: Elisa Anzolin, Gianluca Lo Nostro, Elizabeth Howcroft
items.summary: Smart glasses that resemble ordinary eyewear are under increased scrutiny from European regulators and advocacy groups, leaving investors questioning whether sales can keep booming as Ray-Ban maker EssilorLuxottica reports third-quarter results.
items.body:
Smart glasses that resemble ordinary eyewear are under increased scrutiny from European regulators and advocacy groups, leaving investors questioning whether sales can keep booming as Ray-Ban maker EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) reports third-quarter results.
EssilorLuxottica launched its Ray-Ban Meta (META.O) smart glasses, capable of filming and recording, in 2023 and the market has grown rapidly.
Global shipments of AI-enabled glasses jumped to 8.4 million units in 2025 from around 2.1 million in 2024, according to research group Omdia. EssilorLuxottica's Meta eyewear accounted for 81.3% of global shipments in the first half of this year.
When it releases its third-quarter results on Tuesday, EssilorLuxottica is not expected to give precise data on the value of smart glasses sales, but may provide an indication. In its second-quarter trading update, it said smart glasses sales [USN:L1N43U0WL TEXT:"nearly doubled"] compared to the same period a year earlier.
SOME GOVERNMENTS CONSIDER BANS The resemblance to ordinary eyewear has been a factor in the success of EssilorLuxottica's Meta smart glasses, and is in contrast to Google Glass (GOOGL.O) more than a decade ago, whose bulky, futuristic design limited mainstream consumer appeal.
But the design's discretion is troubling to regulators.
Last week, the European Data Protection Board, or EDPB, which brings together national privacy regulators, said the devices facilitated covert recording, including of bystanders' conversations.
Louis Larere, portfolio manager at French asset manager BDL, echoed that concern.
"The fact that smart glasses include a camera, allow users to livestream and instantly share content on social media could become a problem," he said.
So far [USN:L6N45R0AS TEXT:"Norway"] has taken the toughest stance among governments, saying earlier this month it planned a temporary ban on the use of AI glasses in selected locations.
[USN:L1N45908Z TEXT:"Australia"] said in September it was considering barring the use of camera-equipped smart glasses in government workplaces.
In a preliminary, non-binding statement, the EDPB urged manufacturers to combine measures such as visible recording lights, sound alerts and notifications to nearby devices while recording.
The authority also suggested limiting live streaming, automatically blurring bystanders' faces and using location-based technical restrictions in sensitive settings like hospitals or schools.
PRIVACY CONCERNS MAY LIMIT ADOPTION Ross Gerber, CEO of California-based wealth management firm Gerber Kawasaki, which holds Meta shares, said privacy concerns and social stigma could limit wider adoption even though smart glasses still hold long-term potential.
"People will make you feel uncomfortable if you wear them, and people feel uncomfortable wearing them because of this," he said, adding that his pair of Meta glasses was sitting unused in his garage.
A Meta spokesperson said the glasses remain popular for music, calls and live translations. "They were built to be noticed which is why every pair with a camera has a bright light on the front that flashes when you take a photo or video you can share with others," they added.
"It's important that rules protect people's rights while supporting innovation and consistency across technologies," an EssilorLuxottica spokesperson told Reuters, adding that the company is working to help consumers understand how to use the glasses responsibly and respectfully.
Data regulators in Italy and Austria both told Reuters that they were investigating incidents involving smart glasses being used by pupils in schools, and [USN:L1N4590OL TEXT:"France's data watchdog"] previously said it had received a small number of complaints.
"Authorities should think about banning these devices in public spaces in a more coordinated manner," Kleanthi Sardeli, a lawyer at European digital rights advocacy group NOYB, told Reuters.
Growing privacy concerns could pose a challenge for EssilorLuxottica and Meta as they seek to position AI glasses, which can be used for making calls and listening to music, as a potential future alternative to smartphones.
"(Privacy concerns) are a risk to this category. We already saw something similar more than a decade ago with Google Glasses," Cedric Rossi, luxury and consumer goods equity research analyst at Stifel, said.
Rossi said Meta's unveiling in September of camera-free [USN:L1N45F121 TEXT:"audio glasses"] was a first step toward addressing regulatory and privacy concerns. However, he added that, without a camera, users cannot fully benefit from the AI capabilities the devices are designed to offer.
Other companies, meanwhile, are still drawn to [USN:L4N42O1PB TEXT:"the category"] and Google, in partnership with Samsung (005930.KS) , plans to release its Gemini AI glasses before the end of this year. Apple (AAPL.O) is also expected to release its own smart glasses.
BofA analysts in a report this month assessed the regulatory risk as limited and that an outright ban was unlikely even if additional restrictions emerge, particularly in Europe.

items.title: 仏、週末の暴動対応の不備認める　24日のデモに軍投入へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jean-Stéphane Brosse　Charlotte Van Campenhout

[パリ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jean-Stéphane Brosse　Charlotte Van Campenhout

[パリ ２０日 ロイター] - フランス政府は２０日、２４日に予定される新たな抗議デモに備え、警察に軍部隊を加えて大規模な治安維持態勢を敷くと発表した。先週末の暴動への対応に失敗があったことも認めた。

ルコルニュ首相は「２４日に向けた配備は大規模なものになる」とした上で、当面の最優先課題は、１７日にパリ、マルセイユ、リヨンなどの都市で発生した暴動や略奪を受けた秩序回復だと強調した。

またヌニェス内相は、警察とともに軍を展開させると明らかにしたほか、都市中心部の警備が手薄だったとの広範な批判を受け、政府は戦術を全面的に見直すと約束。その上で、「起きたことを深く遺憾に思う。自分の責任の一端を負う」と述べた。

＜対象を絞った外出禁止令で平穏回復へ＞

フランス各都市では、先週末の混乱を受けて夜間外出禁止令が出され、１９日夜から２０日朝にかけて平穏が保たれた。一方、抗議団体は２４日に再びデモを行うと発表した。警察によると、１８歳未満の子どもや若者を対象とする地域限定の外出禁止令は、２０日夜まで延長された。

ルコルニュ首相はＸへの投稿で「対象を絞った夜間外出禁止令が昨夜の平穏につながった」と述べ、「状況に応じて」延長する可能性も示した。

ダルマナン法相はテレビ局Ｃニュースに対し、先週末に拘束された人のうち１２３人が勾留され、裁判を待っていると述べた。１９日夜に出演した別のテレビ番組では、約２５００人が取り調べのため引き続き拘束されていると説明した。

フランスの主要な学生団体である全国学生連盟（ＵＮＥＦ）は、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に掲載したビラで「われわれは続ける」と表明。教育制度の立て直しを求め、マクロン大統領と政府に圧力をかけ続けるとした。

これとは別に、「黄色いベスト」を名乗る団体が、燃料費の高騰に抗議する行動を各地で起こすよう呼びかけた。

items.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝下落、追加景気対策への期待後退
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [香港 ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[香港 ２０日 ロイター] - 中国・香港株式市場は下落して引けた。中国政府が主要政策金利を据え置き、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）指標は堅調だったことから、追加景気刺激策への期待が後退した。

中国本土のＣＳＩ３００指数は０．５％安で終了。上海総合指数は０．１％高となった。

ＣＳＩ銀行株指数は０．９％下落し、金融セクターは１．２％下げた。、金価格の下落が続いたことで金関連セクターは１．８％軟化した。

深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は０．３％下落、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１％上昇した。

香港市場ではハンセン指数が１．３％下落、ハンセンテック指数は１．５％下げ、約２年ぶりの安値を付けた。

堅調なＧＤＰ（国内総生産）統計を受け、政策当局がさらなる金融緩和を急ぐ様子はないことを示す兆候として、中国は２０日、銀行貸出金利の指標となる最優遇貸出金利（ローンプライムレート、ＬＰＲ）を市場の予想通り１７カ月連続で据え置いた。

中国経済は前四半期に３年ぶりの低水準から持ち直し、４．５％成長と市場予想を上回った。堅調な輸出が低調な内需を補った。

メイバンクのアナリストはリポートで、全体として安定した成長が「新たな財政・金融刺激策を打ち出す緊急性を低下させている」と指摘。追加の刺激策がなければ、低調な国内投資と消費により成長はやや鈍化するとの見方を示した。

中小型株中心の北証５０成分指数は３．９％急伸して引けた。中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）が北京証券取引所の発展を支援するため、連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を立ち上げると表明したことが好感された。

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米特使とノルウェーで会談へ　関係修復目指す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [オスロ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[オスロ ２０日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２０日、オスロへ飛び、米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談する。トランプ米大統領がロシアへの接近を強める中、過去２週間で急激に悪化した対米関係の修復を試みる。

ゼレンスキー氏は、弾道ミサイル迎撃システム、ロシアのミサイル攻撃に対する早期警戒、「復旧が必要な（スペースＸの衛星システムである）『スターリンク／スターシールド』の状況」といった問題についてルビオ米国務長官と話し合ったと明かし、Ｘに「もちろん、これら全てはこの恐ろしい戦争と絶え間ない人命の損失に終止符を打つためのわれわれの外交的努力を背景に行われている」と投稿した。

ノルウェーのストーレ首相は、２０日の会合を主催する目的は「外交的取り組みをより建設的な方向へと導くこと」だと述べた。

フィンランドのストゥブ大統領は、ゼレンスキー氏やストーレ氏との会合に出席し、「ロシアによるウクライナへの違法な侵略戦争および欧州全体の安全保障情勢」について協議すると述べた。

ノルウェーによると、トランプ氏の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏はオンラインで会合に参加。ゼレンスキー氏、ストゥブ氏、ストーレ氏は２０日中に記者会見を行うという。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Federico Maccioni

[ドバイ ２０日 ロイター] - 英大手銀行ＨＳＢＣのジョルジュ・エルヘデリー・グループ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２０日、イラン戦争の影響を和らげるために湾岸地域で代替物流ルートへの投資が進めば、ホルムズ海峡は５年以内に不要になる可能性があるとの見解を示した。

湾岸諸国は紛争を受け、港湾につながるエネルギーパイプラインの整備に資金を振り向けざるを得なくなっている。エルヘデリー氏は、こうした投資によって湾岸地域は紛争の影響を乗り切れるとの見方を示した。

同氏はドバイで開かれたＨＳＢＣフューチャー・フォーラムで「この地域は回復し、その後も成長を続けられるとみている。そのためには多額の投資が必要になる」と述べた。

さらに「もちろん紛争の解決を望み、期待している」とした上で「おそらく５年後には、ホルムズ海峡は不要になっているかもしれない」と語った。

items.title: 産学で医療画像処理システム開発、ラピダス先端半導体の活用念頭
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 国内の企業や大学、研究機関が参画する技術研究組合「最先端半導体技術センター（ＬＳＴＣ）」は２０日、回路線幅２ナノメートル（ナノは１０億分の１）の先端半導体を活用した医療用の画像処理システムの研究開発を、北海道大学や富士フイルム、ＧＥヘルスケア・ジャパン（東京都日野市）と共に開始すると発表した。

来年後半の２ナノ半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区）が、米ＩＢＭから受託生産する製品の活用を念頭に置く。ＬＳＴＣ理事長を務めるラピダスの東哲郎会長は記者会見で「われわれが開発する半導体やＡＩ（人工知能）が人間の生活を豊かに、幸せにしていくことは最重要なことだ」とし、特に「医療分野における開発は非常に意義深い」と述べた。

研究開発は、独立行政法人の新エネルギー・産業技術総合開発機構（ＮＥＤＯ）の委託事業として採択された。ベルギーの半導体国際研究機関「ｉｍｅｃ（アイメック）」も加わる。医療分野でのＡＩ活用の障壁となっている消費電力と処理遅延の課題解決のため、医療機器内でリアルタイムに動作する高速・低消費電力の画像処理システム開発を目指す。

来年後半の２ナノ半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区）が、米ＩＢＭから受託生産する製品の活用を念頭に置く。ＬＳＴＣ理事長を務めるラピダスの東哲郎会長は記者会見で「われわれが開発する半導体やＡＩ（人工知能）が人間の生活を豊かに、幸せにしていくことは最重要なことだ」とし、特に「医療分野における開発は非常に意義深い」と述べた。

研究開発は、独立行政法人の新エネルギー・産業技術総合開発機構（ＮＥＤＯ）の委託事業として採択された。ベルギーの半導体国際研究機関「ｉｍｅｃ（アイメック）」も加わる。医療分野でのＡＩ活用の障壁となっている消費電力と処理遅延の課題解決のため、医療機器内でリアルタイムに動作する高速・低消費電力の画像処理システム開発を目指す。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Liz Lee　Ben Blanchard

[北京／台北 ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Liz Lee　Ben Blanchard

[北京／台北 ２０日 ロイター] - 中国軍は２０日、南シナ海・南沙（英語名スプラトリー）諸島の仙賓礁（サビナ礁）周辺海域に米海軍艦「チャールストン」が未明に「違法に」侵入したとし、監視するため部隊を派遣したと発表した。一方、同海域のさらに北方では、台湾が中国船と対峙（たいじ）していると明らかにした。

人民解放軍南部戦区司令部は声明で、「米国の行動は中国の主権と利益を侵害し、海上安全保障を脅かし、地域の平和と安定を損なうものだ」と指摘。「米国側は直ちにこうした活動を中止すべきだ」と述べた。

米海軍はコメント要請に応じていない。

また、台湾海巡署（沿岸警備隊）は、中国海警局の船舶が、台湾が実効支配する南シナ海・東沙（プラタス）諸島付近の海域に侵入したと発表。同署の船舶「台中」が中国船を退去させるために派遣され、双方が互いにメッセージを放送し合ったという。

海巡署によると、中国船は「いわゆる『中華民国』は存在しない」と放送したのに対し、台湾船は「中華民国・台湾は主権を有する独立国だ」と応答し、現在もにらみ合いが続いている。

中国政府で台湾政策を担う国務院台湾事務弁公室はコメント要請に応じていない。

ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は６．２％上昇だった。前月比では１．９％上昇した。

ベートマンＨＡＬのチーフエコノミスト、アレクサンダー・クリューガー氏は「生産の川上段階では引き続き強い価格上昇圧力がかかっている」と指摘。前年比の上昇率が１０％に近づく可能性が高いとし、「遅かれ早かれ、消費者物価も押し上げることになる」と語った。

上昇の主因はエネルギー価格で、前年比１４．９％上昇。中間財は６．４％上昇した。

items.creator: ロイター

items.body:
[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は２０日午後の記者会見で、日本企業を標的としたサイバー攻撃の一部に中国系の人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント「ＡＲＴＥＸ（アルテックス）」が使われたとの民間サイバーセキュリティ機関の調査結果について、承知しているとした上で、政府として調査分析を進めているところで「現時点で確たることを申し上げる段階にはない」と述べた。

政府は国家サイバー統括室が司令塔となり、関係省庁が集めた情報や被害企業のヒアリング、専門機関の調査を踏まえてＡＩが悪用された可能性を含めて各事案の詳細な分析を進めていると説明。「外国主体の関与の可能性も含めてあらゆる可能性を考慮しながら、攻撃主体や攻撃元の実態解明に努める」考えを示した。調査結果を公表するかどうかは、今後判断するとして明言を避けた。

items.title: Ataque con drones en zona en disputa entre Sudán y Sudán del Sur deja 150 muertos: funcionario
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El ejército de Sudán llevó a cabo ataques con drones en un mercado en la disputada región de Abyei, causando la muerte de más de 150 personas, afirmaron las autoridades de Sudán del Sur, en otro episodio en una de las semanas más sangrientas de una guerra que se ha extendido más allá de las fronteras de Sudán.
items.body:
El ejército de Sudán llevó a cabo ataques con drones en un mercado en la disputada región de Abyei, causando la muerte de más de 150 personas, afirmaron las autoridades de Sudán del Sur, en otro episodio en una de las semanas más sangrientas de una guerra que se ha extendido más allá de las fronteras de Sudán.
El ataque elevó el número de víctimas mortales de los últimos días a más de 250, lo que pone de relieve la letalidad de los ataques aéreos en la guerra de Sudán, que estalló en abril de 2023 entre las Fuerzas Armadas sudanesas y las Fuerzas de Apoyo Rápido (RSF), de carácter paramilitar.
Esto desencadenó una grave crisis humanitaria y atrajo la participación de milicias locales y potencias extranjeras.
Yohana Akol Ngor, ministro interino de Información de Abyei, declaró el martes a Reuters que el número de muertos por el ataque al mercado de Abyei del lunes había pasado de 73 a 153, pero que probablemente seguiría aumentando.
"El fuego sigue ardiendo. Por lo tanto, el proceso de recuperación de los fallecidos aún continúa. La situación es terrible", afirmó Ngor, añadiendo que algunos cadáveres habían quedado reducidos a cenizas.
Un video grabado el martes en el lugar de los hechos y verificado por Reuters mostraba restos carbonizados y retorcidos de vehículos y edificios. Las llamas seguían saliendo de uno de los edificios mientras los residentes inspeccionaban los daños.
El funcionario afirmó que el ejército de Sudán era responsable del ataque, sin aportar pruebas. Un portavoz de las fuerzas armadas de Sudán no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.
Tres fuentes diplomáticas, un trabajador humanitario y un experto en el conflicto declararon a Reuters que el ataque había alcanzado un depósito de combustible situado en el mercado.
Las fuentes diplomáticas indicaron que el depósito había sido utilizado en el pasado por las RSF para abastecer a sus fuerzas. Un portavoz de las RSF no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
Abyei es una zona rica en petróleo que está bajo administración conjunta de Sudán del Sur y Sudán, países que reclaman su soberanía. La región sufre frecuentes episodios de violencia, con enfrentamientos en los que suelen participar grupos étnicos rivales o milicias armadas.
Funcionarios del Gobierno sudanés, liderado por militares, declararon a Reuters que la RSF opera en algunas zonas de Abyei. Ngor negó la presencia de la RSF en Abyei. Reuters no pudo verificar de inmediato estas afirmaciones.
El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Sudán del Sur dijo en un comunicado emitido a última hora del lunes que los drones atacaron un mercado situado al norte de la localidad de Abyei, pero no especificó el número de víctimas civiles causadas por el ataque.
El ministerio dijo que había convocado al embajador sudanés para transmitirle la "enérgica protesta y profunda preocupación del Gobierno respecto al ataque y sus implicaciones para la seguridad de la población civil y la estabilidad de la zona de Abyei".

items.title: 韓国、在ウクライナ大使館職員を追加撤収　北朝鮮兵捕虜巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２０日 ロイター] - 韓国外務省は２０日、北朝鮮兵捕虜を巡る問題でウクライナ側から「建設的な反応」が得られていないとして、在ウクライナ大使館の職員を追加で撤収させると発表した。 

捕虜となった北朝鮮兵２人を韓国に移送したとウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が国連総会で明らかにしたことを受け、韓国は今月、駐ウクライナ大使を召還した。韓国側は兵士と北朝鮮にいる家族を守るため、移送を秘密にするとの合意があったとし、公表はこの合意に反すると批判した。

韓国外務省のパク報道官は２０日の定例記者会見で、韓国の立場を複数の経路でウクライナに伝えたが、十分な回答が得られなかったと述べた。「問題の円満な解決を促し、両国間の信頼を回復するために必要だと判断し、今回の措置を取った」と説明した。引き揚げる職員数は明らかにしなかった。

パク氏によると、外交上の意思疎通を維持するため、臨時代理大使はキーウにとどまる。韓国人保護のため、領事業務に当たる職員も全員残る。

同氏はまた、ウクライナ全土で空爆の脅威が続き、職員の安全確保が難しくなっていたと述べた。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は先週、ニュースメディアのＲＢＣウクライナに対し、この問題は決着済みと考えていると語った。秘密保持に関する取り決めの解釈の違いが対立の原因だとし、ウクライナは全ての義務を果たしたと述べた。

William Schomberg　Suban Abdulla

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - 英国立統計局（ＯＮＳ）が発表した労働市場統計によると、 賃金上昇ペースは再び小幅に加速し、雇用にもわずかな回復の兆しが見られた。来月の利上げの根拠を強める可能性がある。

６─８月の平均週給（ボーナスを除く）は前年同期比３．７％増加。今年に入ってから３．４％という最低水準を記録して以来、緩やかな上昇基調が続いている。

ロイターがエコノミストを対象に実施した調査では、３．６％増が予想されていた。５─７月の数値は３．６％増に上方修正された。

民間部門の賃金上昇率も２．９％から３．０％にややペースを速めた。２０２４年末以来の加速となった。

税務当局による給与所得者数の速報値は、９月に１万３０００人増加。８月の数値は、速報値の２万６０００人減から１０００人増に上方修正された。

求人サイト「インディード」のシニアエコノミスト、ジャック・ケネディ氏は「労働市場は一定の強靭性を示しており、経済全体が予想を上回るパフォーマンスを示している状況と一致している」と指摘。より力強く回復するかどうかは来週発表される予算案次第だと語った。

ＯＮＳが見直しを進めている調査に基づく６─８月の失業率は４．７％に低下し、２０２５年半ば以来の低水準となった。

データ公表後にポンドはドルに対して上昇した。

一方、７─９月の求人数は、６─８月の７０万４０００件から６９万１０００件に減少。２１年４月までの３カ月間以来初めて７０万件を下回り、新型コロナウイルスによるパンデミック期を除くと２０１４年以来の低水準となった。

会計士団体ＩＣＡＥＷのチーフエコノミスト、スレン・ティル氏は「求人数の継続的な減少は労働市場にとって警告であり、今年のＡＩ（人工知能）にけん引された経済成長の有害な副作用として、雇用需要の低迷が生じており、さらに人件費の高騰がそれを悪化させていることを示唆している」と述べた。

ＯＮＳによると、求人の減少は、人件費上昇の打撃を受けている小規模企業に集中した。

items.body:
日経平均は続落、ＡＩ株含め全体的に低調　安値もみ合いに終始
10/20 16:25 配信

写真は4月27日、都内の株価ボードで撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は続落し、前営業日比１．３０％（８４１円２８銭）安の６万４０７５円４２銭で取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がける米コアウィーブを巡る懸念を背景に、ＡＩ・半導体関連株を中心に売り優勢となった。原油高から景気敏感株も含め全体的に物色面は低調でＴＯＰＩＸも軟調。買い材料が見当たらず、売りが一巡した後も安値もみ合いに終始した。

前日の米国株式市場ではハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が堅調だったが、引き続き米コアウィーブに対する懸念が残り、ＡＩ・半導体関連株が売り先行で始まった。

その後、これらの銘柄は値ごろ感から買い直される場面があったものの、原油価格の高止まりが嫌気される格好で、景気敏感株にも軟調な銘柄が目立った。

ＡＩ関連、景気敏感のバリュー株がそろって軟調となり、地合いが悪化したとの指摘がある。「日経平均、ＴＯＰＩＸがパラレルに推移したことで、ある意味分かりやすい相場だった」（国内証券ストラテジスト）という。

市場では「米コアウィーブを巡る懸念がくすぶる中、引き続きＡＩ関連株が厳しいが、この７月がそうだったように、ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）や日本の半導体関連企業の決算発表で流れが変わる可能性もある」（ＳＢＩ証券・投資情報部長の鈴木英之氏）との声もあった。

ＴＯＰＩＸは１．４３％安の４００９．２１ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比１．４４％安の２０６６．１ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は６兆７９９２億３４００万円だった。

東証３３業種では、値上がりはその他製造、小売業など９業種、値下がりは非鉄金属、銀行業、ガラス・土石製品など２４業種。

個別では、キオクシアＨＬＤＧ、ソフトバンクグループ、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、東京電力ホールディングスは軟調に推移したものの、ファーストリテイリングは高い。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が下落し、２．７４％安（２１．００ポイント安）の７４５．９１ポイントだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが３３５銘柄（２１％）、値下がりは１１８１銘柄（７６％）、変わらずは３７銘柄（２％）だった。

items.body:
9月コンビニ売上高は0.5％増、加熱式たばこ増税前の駆け込み需要などで
10/20 16:21 配信

写真は2020年4月、都内のコンビニエンスストアの店舗内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 日本フランチャイズチェーン協会（ＪＦＣ）が２０日に発表した９月の主要コンビニ７社の既存店売上高は前年比０．５％増、全店ベースで０．４％増だった。１０月の加熱式たばこ増税前の駆け込み需要に加え、揚げ物やデザートなどが好調に推移した。

東日本を中心に台風や長雨などで客数が落ちて、米飯やドリンク、アイスクリーム、冷麺などの売り上げは減少したが、非食品を中心にその他の消費は底堅く推移した。

既存店ベースの売上高は３カ月連続で増え、９６１１億１７００万円となった。全店ベースの売上高は１９カ月連続増の９９９５億０８００万円。平均客単価は全店・既存店ともに伸びて、来店客数の落ち込みを相殺した。

items.summary: インドネシア株式市場は反発して引けた。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが同国をグローバル指数から除外する可能性を警告し、１６日と１９...
items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（20日）
10/20 16:15 配信

インドネシア株式市場は反発して引けた。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが同国をグローバル指数から除外する可能性を警告し、１６日と１９日の２営業日で１４．８％下落、時価総額８２０億ドルが失われる記録的な急落となったことを受け、当局が売りを制限する措置を導入した。

中国・香港株式市場は下落して引けた。中国政府が主要政策金利を据え置き、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）指標は堅調だったことから、追加景気刺激策への期待が後退した。

中国本土のＣＳＩ３００指数は０．５％安で終了。上海総合指数は０．１％高となった。

ＣＳＩ銀行株指数は０．９％下落し、金融セクターは１．２％下げた。、金価格の下落が続いたことで金関連セクターは１．８％軟化した。

深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は０．３％下落、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は１％上昇した。

香港市場ではハンセン指数が１．３％下落、ハンセンテック指数は１．５％下げ、約２年ぶりの安値を付けた。

堅調なＧＤＰ（国内総生産）統計を受け、政策当局がさらなる金融緩和を急ぐ様子はないことを示す兆候として、中国は２０日、銀行貸出金利の指標となる最優遇貸出金利（ローンプライムレート、ＬＰＲ）を市場の予想通り１７カ月連続で据え置いた。

中国経済は前四半期に３年ぶりの低水準から持ち直し、４．５％成長と市場予想を上回った。堅調な輸出が低調な内需を補った。

メイバンクのアナリストはリポートで、全体として安定した成長が「新たな財政・金融刺激策を打ち出す緊急性を低下させている」と指摘。追加の刺激策がなければ、低調な国内投資と消費により成長はやや鈍化するとの見方を示した。

中小型株中心の北証５０成分指数は３．９％急伸して引けた。中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）が北京証券取引所の発展を支援するため、連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を立ち上げると表明したことが好感された。

ソウル株式市場は反落し、３％以上の下げとなり４月７日以来の安値で引けた。世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームを巡る懸念から半導体株が売られた。

大信証券のアナリストは「ＡＩ投資を巡る信用面と収益性の懸念は完全に払しょくされておらず、足元の反発の持続性は限定的だった」と指摘した。

ロイターがエコノミストを対象に実施した調査によると、韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２２日の政策決定会合で、２会合連続の利上げを経て政策金利を据え置くが、インフレが目標を上回り成長も底堅く推移していることから、来月に再度利上げを実施すると見込まれている。

半導体大手サムスン電子は２．９８％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは４．２３％下落した。

ＡＩインフラ企業のエリスグループは上場初日に３０％超急落した。

売買された全９１５銘柄のうち、値上がりは１１８、値下がりは７７３だった。

海外投資家は５３００億ウォン（３億９９５８万ドル）の売り越しだった。

シドニー株式市場は小幅下落して引けた。ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行のリストラ費用が金融株の重しとなり、鉱業大手ＢＨＰは四半期の銅生産量減少を受けて下落した。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は０．３％安の８８１６．９０で終了した。取引時間中には一時１．１％下落し、約３週間ぶりの大幅な日中下落を記録したが、その後持ち直した。

ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行株は一時４％近く下落、１．８％安で引けた。２０２７年のリストラ関連の税引き前費用が約３億豪ドル（約２億０９５０万米ドル）に上る見通しで、最大２５００人の人員削減を実施すると発表した。これを受け金融株は０．５％下落。四大銀行で上昇したのはコモンウェルス銀行のみで、０．１％高だった。

銅生産世界最大手のＢＨＰ株は一時２．６％下落。チリのエスコンディダ鉱山で悪天候と事故により一時操業停止を余儀なくされたことから、第１・四半期の銅生産量が大幅に減少したと発表した。

同業のリオティントは１％安、鉱業株は一時２．２％下落した。

市場は２１日のハウザー豪中銀副総裁の発言に注目している。今年５回目となる利上げの可能性について質問を受ける公算が大きい。

ウエストパックは、コア・インフレ率が今四半期に０．９％上昇し、年間インフレ率は中銀予想の３．３％に対し３．５％に上昇すると予想。ただトレンドを下回る成長と労働市場の緩やかな軟化によりインフレは目標水準に戻るとして、中銀は据え置くとみている。

エネルギー株は１．３％下落し、１０月初め以来の大幅安となった。

ヘルスケア株は０．９％近く上昇し、１月３０日以来の高値で引けた。バイオテクノロジー大手ＣＳＬが１．２％高、コクレアが５％超上昇した。

items.title: Gulf Keystone, ShaMaran agree $601 million oil merger
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Gulf Keystone Petroleum said on Tuesday it would merge with Norway's ShaMaran Petroleum in a $601 million all-share 50-50 deal, creating one of the largest producers in Iraq's oil-rich Kurdistan region.
items.body:
Gulf Keystone Petroleum (GKP.L) said on Tuesday it would merge with Norway's ShaMaran Petroleum (SNMS.OL) in a $601 million all-share 50-50 deal, creating one of the largest producers in Iraq's oil-rich Kurdistan region.
Here are some details from the statement:
ShaMaran shareholders to receive 0.07533958 Gulf Keystone share for each ShaMaran share held, with Gulf Keystone shareholders to receive a $50 million special dividend
Merger combines operations across four Iraqi fields: Shaikan, Atrush, Sarsang and Hamrin
Combined company expected to hold 323 million barrels of proved and probable reserves
With pro-forma working interest production of 53,000 bpd, combined company ranks among the top 10 European listed independent oil producers
Combined group has potential to reach 100,000 barrels of oil per day through development of Shaikan and Hamrin fields, a Gulf Keystone spokesperson said
Dealmaking among Middle East-focused oil companies is supported by higher oil prices, with Genel Energy (GENL.L) competing with Norway's DNO (DNO.OL) to buy [USN:L6N45H0B2 TEXT:"Capricorn Energy"] (CNE.L)

items.title: 午後3時のドルは158円前半でレンジ継続、上昇後に米金利低下で軟化
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] -

  ド...
items.body:
午後3時のドルは158円前半でレンジ継続、上昇後に米金利低下で軟化
10/20 15:24 配信

写真は米ドル紙幣。2022年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] -

  ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.15／158.19 1.1227／1.1229 177.59／177.60

午前９時現在 158.52／158.54 1.1213／1.1215 177.76／177.77

ＮＹ午後５時 158.48／158.52 1.1211／1.1214 177.71／177.75

午後３時のドルは、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてドル安／円高の１５８円前半で推移している。来週以降の重要イベント待ちで材料に乏しく、レンジ相場が続く。午前中は直近のレンジの上限でもみ合っていたドル／円は、レンジを上抜けできず押し戻され、午後に入ると米長期金利の低下などを背景にさらに軟化した。好調な２０年債入札も円相場の支えになったとの声もある。

ドルは朝方に前日の高値を上抜けると１５８．６０円まで上伸。その水準でもみ合った後は押し戻され、午後に入るとじりじりと水準を切り下げた。米金利の低下に加え、円債市場での２０年債入札で「ある程度需要がみえたことが円相場をサポートしたのではないか」（国内銀行のストラテジスト）との声がある。

２０年債入札について、市場では非常に強い結果との受け止めが聞かれた。

日米中銀の金融政策決定会合や米中間選挙を控え、ドル／円相場は手控えムードも強く、レンジ相場が継続している。１６０円に接近すれば為替介入への警戒感が上値を抑える一方、構造的な円売り圧力は変わらず「円高になる環境でもない」（三菱ＵＦＪモルガン・スタンレー証券の植野大作チーフ為替ストラテジスト）との見方は根強く、下値も堅い。

中間選挙では選挙予測サイトで民主党が優勢とも伝わる中、ＡＩ（人工知能）を振興する現在の米政権の政策を後退させる可能性があるとして、株価影響への懸念からドル買いに慎重姿勢がみられる。一方、為替市場への影響を巡っては、金融政策面での影響などでトランプ現政権に一定の歯止めがかかるのであれば「かえってドルが安定する可能性もある」（植野氏）との指摘も聞かれる。

items.title: 日銀、27年度物価見通し引き上げの可能性　政策金利は据え置く公算＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 日銀は２９―３０日の金融政策決定...
items.body:
日銀、27年度物価見通し引き上げの可能性　政策金利は据え置く公算＝関係筋
10/20 14:54 配信

写真は日本銀行本店。2026年6月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 日銀は２９―３０日の金融政策決定会合で議論する「経済・物価情勢の展望」（展望リポート）で、２０２７年度の物価見通しを引き上げる可能性が高い。原油市況が再び上昇していることで、来年にかけて価格転嫁がさらに進む展開を織り込む。９月利上げの影響を見極める観点から追加利上げは見送る公算が大きいが、物価上振れ圧力はなお強く、早ければ１２月に追加利上げが必要との声もある。複数の関係筋が明らかにした。

前回７月の展望リポートでは、２７年度の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、除く生鮮食品（コアＣＰＩ）が前年度比２．４％上昇、除く生鮮食品・エネルギー（コアコアＣＰＩ）が２．６％上昇だった。７月時点で、ドバイ原油は「１バレル＝８０ドル程度を出発点に、見通し期間終盤にかけて７０ドル程度まで下落していく」と想定していたが、中東情勢は緊迫状態が長期化し、足元では１１０ドル付近と想定より高い水準で推移している。

もっとも、物価見通しの引き上げは小幅にとどまる可能性が高い。関係筋によると、原油価格の再上昇で価格転嫁が再び進み、それが賃金の上振れを通じてさらなる物価高につながる「二次的波及」のリスクは大きくないとの見方が多い。

    政府の物価高対策で２６年暦年の物価上昇率は前年より大幅に低くなると見込まれるほか、今年度の最低賃金の引き上げ率が高水準ながら前年度よりは鈍化したことで、来年も賃上げは継続するものの、今年を大幅に上回るような賃上げは想定しづらいとの見方が出ている。２６年度の物価見通しや実質国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は７月対比大きな変化はないとみられる。

今回の展望リポートでは、飲食料品の消費税率引き下げの影響は予測数値に織り込まない可能性が高い。法案が成立しておらず、影響を織り込むことは難しいとの声が多い。

    ＜基調物価＞

    関係筋によると、日銀は今回の決定会合で、基調的な物価上昇率が２％程度におおむね到達したとの判断を示す可能性がある。賃金上昇率が２％物価目標と整合的な３％程度で安定する中、日銀では、１０月入り後に公表された日銀短観や生活意識アンケート調査で企業や家計の中長期の予想物価上昇率が引き続き緩やかに上昇している姿が示されたとの見方が出ている。

    基調物価が２％におおむね到達したとの判断を示した場合も、金融環境は依然として緩和的な状況だとし、基調物価２％への定着に向けて利上げを継続する方針を改めて示すとみられる。

９月利上げの影響を見極めるため、今回会合は政策金利を据え置く公算が大きい。市場動向を見極めた上で最終判断する。もっとも、日銀ではコアＣＰＩについて、２％をはっきり上回る水準で高止まりする期間が長期化することへの警戒感が出ている。物価上振れ圧力が引き続き高い中で、早ければ１２月に追加利上げする必要があるとの声もある。

items.summary:

items.body:
給付対象、国際比較当てはめると2000万人程度＝高市首相
10/20 14:51 配信

写真は 高市早苗首相。2026年10月14日、都内にある国会で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　２０日　ロイター］ - 高市早苗首相は２０日の衆院本会議で、飲食料品の消費税減税と同時に導入する方針の所得に連動した新たな給付を巡り、国際比較で世帯収入５１０万円以下の場合、税や社会保険料の負担が高くなっているとの認識を示した。諸外国の類似制度を踏まえ、支援対象となる勤労者の割合を日本に当てはめると２０００万人程度と述べた。

対象となる所得の下限については社会保障国民会議で５３万円、７４万円、１０６万円の案が出たとしてうえで、上限については、国際比較、勤労者の割合などを考慮し恒久財源の確保とあわせ検討すると述べるにとどめた。

飲食料品の消費税率１％への引き下げを柱とする政府提出の減税関連法案はこの日、衆院本会議で審議入りした。物価高対策として、２０２７年４月から２年間に限り実施する。所得連動型の給付制度を２７年度に先行導入する。

ＶＷ、中国事業復活進まず　シャオペンとの共同開発車が販売不振

写真はフォルクスワーゲンのEV「ID. UNYX 08」。2026年2月、中国安徽省合肥市にある工場で撮影。REUTERS/Florence Lo

Ju-min Park　Christina Amann

[北京／ベルリン ２０日 ロイター] - 独自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）が低迷する中国事業の立て直しを目的に電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーの小鵬汽車（シャオペン）に協力を求めた２０２３年、ＶＷ幹部はこの提携について、中国市場向けに最適化された車を開発するための近道だと説明していた。

それから３年後、この提携による最初の製品は世界最大の自動車市場におけるＶＷの失速を如実に物語っている。自動車コンサルティング会社ThinkerCarのデータによると、電動ＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「ID. UNYX ０８」は、４月の発売から８月までの間、月平均２６７台を販売したに過ぎない。これはＶＷが今年の達成を当初目指していた月間販売台数３６２２台（社内文書に基づくデータ）には程遠い。

２２年まで数十年にわたりトップメーカーとして君臨していた中国市場は、ＶＷの世界的な危機の核心にある課題だ。かつてグループ利益の５０％近くを占めていた同市場は、現在では約１０％に過ぎない。この劇的な悪化により、同社は８９年の歴史の中で最大規模の事業再編を余儀なくされている。

ＶＷは、文書に記載された販売予測についてコメントを控えた。

シャオペンもコメントを控えた。

UNYX ０８の問題は、車両そのものに端を発していた。

同車は発売当初、約３万４２６０ドルの価格設定だった。しかし、同価格帯の中国競合車種はより洗練された機能を備えていた。

シャオミの「YU７」は高度なセンサーパッケージを搭載し、Ｚｅｅｋｒ（ジーカー） の「７X」は急速充電機能を備えていた。ThinkerCarによると、４月から８月の間にYU７は約５万７０００台、７Xは２万１０００台以上売れたのに対し、UNYX ０８の販売台数は約１３００台にとどまった。

ガートナーのリサーチ担当バイスプレジデント、ペドロ・パチェコ氏は「『はるかに安く同じ技術が手に入るなら、なぜ高価なドイツ車を買う必要があるのか』と中国の顧客は問うている」と述べた。

items.title: 独メルク、英サイレンス・セラピューティクスを13億ドルで買収
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Christy Santhosh

[１９日 ロイター] - ドイツ製薬大手メルクは１９日、英国を本拠とするバイオ医薬...
items.body:
独メルク、英サイレンス・セラピューティクスを13億ドルで買収
10/20 14:35 配信

写真はメルクのロゴ。2016年5月、ドイツ・ダルムシュタットで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

Christy Santhosh

[１９日 ロイター] - ドイツ製薬大手メルクは１９日、英国を本拠とするバイオ医薬品会社サイレンス・セラピューティクスを約１３億ドルの全額現金で買収すると発表した。精密医療の開発候補薬を強化し、リボ核酸（ＲＮＡ）を標的とする医薬品技術を追加する。

メルクはサイレンスの米国預託証券（ＡＤＲ）１株当たり２０ドルを支払う。これは同株の前営業日終値に１３０％上乗せした水準。

この買収により、サイレンスの「ｓｉＲＮＡ」医薬品が加わり、メルクの遺伝子サイレンシング技術が拡大する。ｓｉＲＮＡ医薬品は、疾患に関連する遺伝子のメッセージが有害なタンパク質を生成する前にその働きを遮断することで効果を発揮する。

今回の取引は、２０２５年の米バイオ企業スプリングワークス・セラピューティクスの３９億ドルでの買収、および米ライフサイエンス機器メーカー、バイオテクネの１１３億ドルでの買収（現在手続き中）に続き、２年足らずでメルクが行う３件目の大型買収となる。

サイレンスの主力治療候補薬である希少な血液がんの治療薬「ディベシラン」は後期臨床試験段階に入る見通しだ。承認されれば、武田薬品とプロタゴニストが手がける「ミムリロ」と競合することになる。

items.body:
首都圏マンション、9月発売戸数は40％減　平均価格2カ月連続下落＝不動産経済研
10/20 14:33 配信

写真は2019年6月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato

[東京 ２０日 ロイター] - 不動産経済研究所が２０日発表した９月の首都圏（１都３県）新築分譲マンション市場動向によると、発売戸数は前年比４０．１％減の１１４２戸となった。千葉県以外でいずれも大幅に減少した。

平均価格は、前年比４．１％下落し９５５２万円。２カ月連続で下落した。東京２３区では１．３％上昇の１億３９４０万円だったが神奈川県で６８１９万円と３０．８％下落した。

首都圏の初月契約率は５０．４％で、好不調の目安となる７０％を下回った。１０月の発売戸数は１５００戸程度を見込んでいる。

同時に発表した４ー９月期の首都圏新築分譲マンション発売戸数は前年同期比６．０％減の８６０１戸だった。年度上半期としては２年ぶりの減少となった。平均価格は１億１４９４万円と最高値を更新し初めて１億円を上回った。

items.title: ドイツ産業部門の就業者数、19年以降に約50万人減＝ＩＦＯ調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ベルリン １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が１９日公表した調査によると、同国の産業部門では２０１９年...
items.body:
ドイツ産業部門の就業者数、19年以降に約50万人減＝ＩＦＯ調査
10/20 14:27 配信

写真はドイツ・ベルリンにある職業安定所。2025年10月撮影。REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

[ベルリン １９日 ロイター] - ドイツのＩＦＯ経済研究所が１９日公表した調査によると、同国の産業部門では２０１９年以降、雇用が５０万人近く減少した。主な調査内容は以下の通り。

２５年末の産業部門就業者数は１９年初めに比べ４９万６０００人（７．１％）減少。ただ、サービス部門では、医療・福祉や行政を中心に２２０万人超の雇用が創出された。

ＩＦＯドレスデン支所のマネジングディレクター、ヨアヒム・ラグニッツ氏は「ドイツでは構造転換が加速している。皮肉にも、今までわれわれの繁栄を支えてきた産業が縮小している」と述べた。

また「新たな雇用の大半は、ドイツが特に高い生産性や革新性を持つ部門では生まれていない。このため将来の潜在成長力が弱まる可能性がある」と述べた。

調査によると、ほぼ全ての産業部門で雇用が減少しており、中国をはじめとする相手との競争力低下が背景にあるとみられる。

自動車産業とその部品供給業者では１２万３５００人（１３％）、金属製品製造業では１１万５６００人、機械製造業では６万４５００人の雇用が削減された。

ラグニッツ氏の試算では、この３部門で削減全体の約６０％を占める。

items.title: ‘It was crazy’: Australian barber hailed as hero after rushing to lawmaker’s rescue
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies said he ran to assist lawmaker Helen Haines, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.
items.body:

‘It was crazy’: Australian barber hailed as hero after rushing to lawmaker’s rescue

Australian barber Ricky Jefferies said he ran to assist lawmaker Helen Haines, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.

Barber Ricky Jefferies speaks to the media a day after tackling a man who attacked Australian politician Helen Haines in the northern regional city of Wangaratta on Oct 20, 2026. (Photo: AFP/William West)

FAST

SYDNEY: Australian barber Ricky Jefferies has been hailed as a hero for running out of his store to detain a man who authorities allege deliberately drove a car into lawmaker Helen Haines in the small town of Wangaratta, an incident that has shocked the country.   
Jefferies had just finished haircuts for a young family on Monday (Oct 19) when he said he heard a "loud bang" outside his shop and realised the driver of a Toyota LandCruiser had struck Haines, leaving her badly injured.
"It was crazy, I just ran out the front to see what was happening," he told reporters on Tuesday.
He said he ran to assist the well-respected local MP, grabbing a knife from the alleged attacker's pocket and pulling him out of the car.

"He did have a knife. He didn't pull it out. I just wasn't comfortable with his movements, and so I basically just took it out of his pocket and threw it away," he said.
Jefferies said he then held the man down until police arrived.
"I just leant over him and once he was on the ground and he was no longer a threat, I just stood with him and I told him that he can't leave," he said.
 

Members of the police stand guard at the crime scene of a vehicle attack on Australian lawmaker Helen Haines in Wangaratta, Australia on Oct 19, 2026 in this screen grab obtained from a video. (Photo: Australian Broadcasting Corporation via Reuters)

Haines, 65, was airlifted to hospital where she underwent surgery overnight. She remains in a critical condition. 
Early investigations suggested the driver, identified as a 43-year-old man, performed a U-turn before hitting Haines as she was loading or unloading things from the trunk of her car, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said . Counterterrorism authorities are among the multiple agencies involved in the investigation.
While police have given no motive for the alleged attack, the involvement of counterterrorism investigators has raised alarm that it could have been an act of political violence, which is rare in Australia.
Jefferies, whose shop is next door to Haines' electorate office around three hours' drive northeast of Melbourne, described the former midwife as a "genuine, kind person".
Albanese praised Jefferies' intervention, calling him a hero.
"At this dark and terrible time, an element of light is the fact that a Good Samaritan, someone rushed to Helen's defence in Wangaratta, put themselves potentially at risk by doing so. And that person is a hero today," Albanese said in an interview with the Nine network's "Today" show. 
Jefferies downplayed the praise.
"I don't think I'm a hero. I think that I just was a person who had an opportunity to intervene in a safe-ish sort of way," he said.

items.title: Ex-Google CEO Eric Schmidt's 1% Anthropic stake set to pay huge windfall
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Former Google Chief Executive Officer Eric Schmidt owns around 1% of Anthropic PBC thanks to his early investment in the startup, according to people familiar with the matter, setting him up for one ...
items.body: By Natasha Mascarenhas and Tom Maloney Former Google Chief Executive Officer Eric Schmidt owns around 1% of Anthropic PBC thanks to his early investment in the startup, according to people familiar with the matter, setting him up for one of the largest individual windfalls from the company’s imminent public market debut. Schmidt invested tens of millions of dollars in Anthropic’s Series A fundraising round, according to the people, who asked not to be identified because they weren’t authorized to discuss private matters. It’s unclear if he has sold any part of his stake since the initial investment. Schmidt and Anthropic declined to comment.  Anthropic’s highly anticipated IPO is set to generate massive windfalls for its employees and investors. The startup’s seven co-founders are already worth $8 billion each based on its last funding round, fortunes that propelled them onto the Bloomberg Billionaires Index of the world’s 500 richest people. When Schmidt, 71, made his first bet on Anthropic in 2021, it was valued at $461 million, according to data company Pitchbook. Investors indicated last week that a fair valuation for the company is in the $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion ballpark; the high end of that range would value Anthropic at more than 4,300 times its Series A funding round.  At that value, the Anthropic stake would boost Schmidt’s net worth by about one-third to nearly $80 billion, according to Bloomberg’s wealth index. Even using Anthropic’s most recent valuation of $965 billion, Schmidt adds nearly $10 billion to his existing fortune of $57.5 billion. Schmidt has become a prolific technology investor over the past decade and a half, across several investment platforms including TomorrowVentures, Innovation Endeavors and his Hillspire family office, which Pitchbook associates with hundreds of different venture capital bets.  His early portfolio focused on consumer internet, software and financial technology, but more recently artificial intelligence has been a major focus, with investments in Mistral AI, Reflection AI and World Labs, as well as Anthropic. If Anthropic’s public stock debuts at a $2 trillion value, his bet on the company would beat Innovation Endeavors’ own early bet on Uber Technologies Inc. in 2011. By the time that company went public in 2019, its value had increased about 1,400-fold to $82 billion. Anthropic is set to begin formally marketing its initial public offering as soon as the week of Nov. 9, putting it in line to begin trading before the US Thanksgiving holiday, people familiar with the matter said earlier this month. It’s expected to make its debut no later than the end of the year. The startup’s major backers include Alphabet Inc., Amazon.com Inc., Nvidia Corp. and Microsoft Corp., which have all poured billions into the Claude chatbot maker. Venture firms Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital also each put more than $2 billion into the company when they led a $65 billion funding round in May that tipped Anthropic’s valuation higher than its rival OpenAI for the first time. The company — whose other backers include Menlo Ventures and Spark Capital — expects to match or beat the size of SpaceX’s record-setting $1.77 trillion June IPO, people familiar have said.

items.title: Stocks mostly rise as oil, US yields ease; French stocks fall
items.author: Caroline Valetkevitch, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Caroline Valetkevitch, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: US stock indexes ended mostly higher as oil prices and Treasury yields eased on Tuesday, while French stocks fell as worries about unrest in the country remained.
items.body:
US stock indexes ended mostly higher as oil prices and Treasury yields eased on Tuesday, while French stocks fell as worries about unrest in the country remained.
Helping the blue-chip Dow, 3M (MMM.N) shares shot up 5.8% after it said it was expanding its data-center partnership with Amazon (AMZN.O) . Shares of the industrial conglomerate were also boosted by the company raising its full-year profit forecast.
After the closing bell, shares of [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"SpaceX"] (SPCX.O) rose after the company said its third-quarter revenue more than doubled, beating estimates as AI and Starlink grew. The stock fell 0.1% in the regular session. At the same time, [USN:L6N465197 TEXT:"Netflix "] (NFLX.O) fell in after-hours trading as it gave a disappointing quarterly forecast. The stock was down 1.7% in the regular session.
Quarterly results from AI heavyweight Meta (META.O) are scheduled for Wednesday.
Investors are looking to corporate earnings for evidence that consumers and the broader economy remain resilient, but also that massive AI spending is paying off.
"Investors really are waiting for the growth companies to report. Analysts have raised their estimates ... It's going to be by how much do they jump over that elevator bar," said Bruce Zaro, managing director at Granite Wealth Management in Plymouth, Massachusetts.
Reflecting some of this nervousness was a 32% drop in South Korean AI [USN:L1N46600F TEXT:"infrastructure company"] Elice Group (0158S0.KQ) , when the stock fell below its initial public offering price in its market debut.
Investors are also still assessing the risk that higher interest rates pose to AI stocks.
Longer-dated US Treasury yields dropped, with the yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note down 1.5 basis points at 5.121% after falling as low as 5.073% on the day. Yields have risen recently amid worries about inflation.
Expectations for a rate hike of at least 25 basis points from the Federal Reserve at its policy meeting next week stand at 17.2%, according to CME FedWatch, down from 22.1% a week ago and 57.6% a month earlier.
"This is a market relieved that rates have come down, relieved that there's less volatility in oil prices, even though they remain elevated," said Jake Dollarhide, CEO of Longbow Asset Management in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
"Earnings season can distract this market. Earnings season can give this market reason to go higher," he said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 529.85 points, or 1.02%, to 52,495.88, the S&P 500 (.SPX) rose 21.84 points, or 0.28%, to 7,712.57 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) fell 6.07 points, or 0.02%, to 26,424.82. MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) rose 0.42 points, or 0.04%, to 1,130.40.
FRENCH STOCKS FALL, OIL EASES France's cities were [USN:L6N4660DJ TEXT:"calm overnight"] under curfews imposed after last weekend's unrest, while protest groups announced a new round of demonstrations next Saturday.
French stocks (.FCHI) fell 0.38%, while the pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) index was down 0.14%. European semiconductor companies including ASML (ASML.AS) and ASMI (ASMI.AS) also were lower.
France's government [USN:L6N4660NP TEXT:"bond yields"] climbed further, with investors remaining cautious ahead of the plans for further protests. The unrest in France has underscored the difficulties the French government faces in reducing its large deficit.
France's 10-year OAT yield earlier was up 3 basis points at 4.96%; it reached 4.9937%, its highest since July 2002, in early October. The yield gap between OATs and Bunds widened by 5.5 bps to 152.50 bps.
The euro was up 0.22% at $1.1235, though traders remained cautious because of the unrest in France.
Meanwhile, the [USN:L1N4660RH TEXT:"US dollar weakened"]. The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.25% to 101.71.
Investors assessed the durability of strong capital inflows into US AI companies. Those inflows have supported the dollar. Higher interest rates, driven partly by growth and inflation expectations tied to the sector, have helped.
Oil prices [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"slipped"] after touching a five-month high. Investors [USN:L1N46601X TEXT:"assessed"] a meeting between the Iranian president and Pakistan's army chief, a key US-Iran mediator, against continued Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure that could disrupt supply.
Brent crude futures fell 76 cents, or 0.69%, to settle at $108.79. Earlier in the session, the front-month contract reached $111.99, a five-month high. The November contract for US West Texas Intermediate crude , which expired on Tuesday, settled down $1.87, or 1.8%, at $101.79.

items.title: Trump warns Kansans that US will 'burn' like France if Democrats win
items.author: Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
items.creator: Bo Erickson, Steve Holland
items.summary: Trump used violent unrest in France as an argument against Democrats.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump on Monday used [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"violent unrest in France"] as an argument against Democrats in his battle to defend a Kansas Senate seat long held by Republicans but in danger of falling to his political opponents.
Trump's rally on behalf of Republican incumbent Roger Marshall was his latest foray into conservative states where Republican candidates are on defense due to voter frustrations over the Iran war and rising prices.

"I love you Kansas, but I'm here for a guy named Roger Marshall," Trump said.
In a new addition to his stump speech, Trump pointed to widespread protests in France as a scenario that could erupt in the United States unless Republicans win. He provided no evidence.
France in recent days has seen some of the worst unrest in years as huge protests over the cost of living and underfunded public services descended into riots and looting.
Trump himself has struggled to make goods and services more affordable in the United States.
In his speech, Trump turned to anti-immigrant and anti-Muslim rhetoric, the type that he used to fuel his three presidential campaigns.
"We're not going to let that happen to this country," he said. "When you see burning steeples and raging fires in France, just remember that is what the radical Dumocrats want to do to America."
Trump has been mocking Democrats by calling them Dumocrats. Rights advocates have [USN:L1N4620ZA TEXT:"repeatedly criticized"] Trump for his rhetoric over the years in which he has targeted and mocked immigrants and ethnic minority groups. Civil rights groups say such rhetoric normalizes discriminatory attitudes towards those communities.
KANSAS COMPETITION Kansas, a conservative Midwestern state Trump won by 16 points in 2024, has not elected a Democrat to the US Senate in 94 years. First-term Senator Marshall is in a close fight with Democratic candidate Adam Hamilton, pastor of a Methodist megachurch, who is running against Trump’s tariff agenda and what he calls the president's “erratic leadership.”
“He wants you to repent for being born White,” Trump said of Hamilton.
Marshall, in remarks to the rally, led his campaign argument on cultural issues like stopping "radical Islam." He called Hamilton "too woke" for Kansas because he supports gay pride parades, which the crowd loudly booed.
"We need someone who can sort heifers and steers," he said.
In response, Hamilton's campaign spokesperson called Marshall's campaign "sinking."
"Nothing said at the rally can distract from the fact Kansans are being crushed by rising gas and diesel prices, struggling to access affordable healthcare, and are tired of Washington corruption," the spokesperson, Tyson Brody, said.
In a Monday video, Hamilton welcomed Trump to the state and said his supporters have “a place” in his campaign. Hamilton said he will work with Trump when it makes sense and stand up for Kansans when Washington policies hurt farmers and rural hospitals.
The tightness of the race is emblematic of the challenges looming for Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections as they try to defy political headwinds and retain control of the Senate and the House of Representatives.
Trump is deep into a 32-day campaign blitz, frequently going to friendly areas that he won handily in previous elections.
One Republican familiar with Trump's midterm strategy said the president’s attention on rural parts of the country is in response to internal polling showing soft support from men 55 years and younger in rural areas nationwide, a voting bloc crucial to Trump’s 2024 presidential win.
ECONOMIC CONCERNS The [USN:L6N46517O TEXT:"latest Reuters/Ipsos poll"], published on Monday, found that 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, a record low for the president.
Democrats need a net gain of four seats in both the US House of Representatives and US Senate to overturn Republicans' narrow 218-214 and 53-47 majorities.
In Park City, near Wichita, many rallygoers walked more than a mile across Interstate 135 to reach the rural arena, as a red-and-green truck stop sign flashed its latest prices above their heads: $3.98 for gas and $5.78 for diesel.
That is up about 45% compared to average gas prices in the state last year, according to motoring club AAA.
Economic concerns were palpable among Trump's most loyal supporters.
“Being on disability, I don’t have much, but it seems like the prices are still going up and they need to come down. It feels like you’re having to search or hunt for food," said Monique Mullen, 59, a Republican voter from Hutchinson, Kansas, who takes care of her father.
A small bloc of protesters gathered near the arena, including James Nightingale, a self-described independent from Halstead, Kansas.
“I’m a farmer from Kansas and the Trump administration has decimated the farm economy in my area. Not only have his tariffs decimated our markets for grain sales, now he is bringing in imported beef from outside the country. What happened to ‘America First’?” he said.
Kansans have proven a willingness to cross parties, as voters have elected a Democratic governor, Laura Kelly, for the last two terms. "I don't think it's ever easy to get elected here," said Gina Seman, a Trump voter from Towanda, Kansas, noting that Republican candidates in the past have taken their popularity for granted.

Trump open to idea of joint meeting with Xi, Putin next month

Nuclear talks between the US, China and Russia could happen as soon as next month after Donald Trump says he is open to a three-way summit.

Traditional Russian wooden dolls depicting China's President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin are displayed for sale at a souvenir shop in St Petersburg, Russia on Nov 21, 2024. (File photo: AP/Dmitri Lovetsky)

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump said on Monday (Oct 19) he is open to three-way arms-control talks with the leaders of China and Russia as soon as next month, raising the prospect of an unprecedented meeting and a major diplomatic gambit for the US president.
"We would have it to talk about nuclear weapons and denuclearisation," Trump told reporters outside the White House. "If President Xi wants to have it, I'd have it. I'm sure we'd talk about other things like trade too."
Trump has tried to thaw frosty relations with Beijing and Moscow as those non-Western powers grow closer. A three-way meeting would also raise alarm from Europe to Asia over private deals that weaken Washington's transatlantic and Indo-Pacific alliances.
But a deal struck between the three countries could also lower global tensions. An end to Russia's war in Ukraine could resolve the biggest threat in decades to European security, and a deal on arms would bind the three nations with the biggest stockpiles of nuclear weapons.

In recent days, Trump has moved to warm ties with Russian President Vladimir Putin, announcing a diesel-fuel deal and signing an order on Friday waiving key sanctions on Moscow . Trump has also sought stable relations with Chinese President Xi Jinping, who in turn has nurtured close ties with Putin.
So far, Trump has not delivered on a campaign promise to quickly end the war in Ukraine.
The White House has been discussing for weeks a possible meeting between the leaders focused on denuclearisation on the sidelines of the Nov 18-19 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China, according to a person familiar with the matter.
Putin later pitched using such a meeting to negotiate an end to the four-year-old Ukraine conflict in a manner that would favour Moscow, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the discussions. Putin's suggestion came during an Oct 9 phone call with Trump that yielded the deal on Russian diesel.
Earlier on Monday, the Kremlin said that the potential meeting had come up in talks.
The three leaders have met separately but never held formal talks together.
The White House did not respond to a Reuters request for comment. The Russian and Chinese embassies in Washington also did not reply to requests for comment.
Trump's diesel deal with Putin and the executive order waiving sanctions on Moscow have drawn criticism from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy , who has warned they would embolden Putin and prolong the war.
Speaking about the possible meeting on Monday, Trump said, "I would do it, not so much for Ukraine because Russia, frankly, has been fine on Ukraine." He added that "Zelenskiy is not helping matters much," and that "it's time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine."
Moscow launched one of its broadest air assaults in months overnight, cutting power to more than half a million households and damaging energy infrastructure across Ukraine. Ten people were reported killed.

Related:

Commentary: Why do Trump and Xi keep meeting if the hard issues remain unresolved?

US and China discuss reciprocal visits to nuclear sites: Reports

TRUMP SEEKS NUCLEAR TALKS Last week, Trump told reporters he thought a denuclearisation deal with Russia and China was possible, but that it "doesn't have to be this year." It's not clear how advanced any talks between the countries are.
Russia has the most stored nuclear warheads, followed by the United States and China, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.
The Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty expired earlier this year. The New START treaty, signed in 2010, allowed a single extension, which Putin and former US President Joe Biden agreed to for five years. Any new extension would require an executive decision to voluntarily extend the limits of the treaty.
China's foreign ministry said last week that its "nuclear strength is by no means at the same level with that of the US and Russia" and that it would be "neither fair, reasonable nor realistic to ask China to join the so-called trilateral nuclear disarmament negotiations at this stage."
Trump has already agreed to attend the APEC summit in Shenzhen next month, marking his second trip to China this year and his third visit with Xi over the same period. China, Russia and the United States are all members of APEC.
On Monday, Trump downplayed the idea of another high-profile meeting in China, with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
"I get along with him very well, and I'm not sure that anybody's asking for a meeting," he said.
Trump previously said he planned to meet with Kim this year. North Korea has publicly indicated that it is not open to talks aimed at convincing Pyongyang to give up its nuclear weapons.

items.summary: Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms ...
items.body:
Home / World News / Trump approval hits record low of 31% ahead of US midterm elections: Poll

Trump approval hits record low of 31% ahead of US midterm elections: Poll Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms

For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his term. (Photo:PTI)

Reuters WASHINGTON 2 min read Last Updated : Oct 20 2026 | 11:22 AM IST

Listen to This Article

President Donald Trump's approval rating fell to a record low as Americans worried about high gasoline prices and appeared ready to punish his Republican Party in the November 3 congressional elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll that closed on Monday.
  Some 31% of Americans approve of Trump's performance in office, down a percentage point from two weeks earlier and the lowest level in either of his presidential terms, the four-day poll showed.
  Asked which party they would vote for if the congressional elections were held today in what is known as a "generic ballot" question, some 47% of registered voters in the nationwide poll picked Democrats and 35% chose Republicans. The 12-point Democratic advantage was the widest over the current election cycle and could bolster Democratic hopes of seizing control of the US House of Representatives and the US Senate.
 

  For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his term.
  Generic ballot polls are national polls that provide an overall view of which party poll respondents want to see in charge in Congress. 
Also Read

Trump open to idea of joint meeting with Xi Jinping, Putin next month

Trump warns Europe faces collapse without border closures, deportations

Ukraine suspects US restricting intelligence sharing on Russian Attacks

US is 'very close' to finalising a trade deal with India: Marco Rubio

Putin proposes summit with Trump, Xi Jinping to discuss Ukraine deal

  While these polls provide a view of national public sentiment, they do not capture all the nuances of the state-by-state and district-by-district contests that determine control of the Senate and House, contests in which Republicans hold some structural advantages.  
A Reuters/Ipsos poll two weeks earlier showed Democrats leading Republicans by 7 points, 44% to 37%.
  Much of the drop in support for Republican congressional candidates was due to a larger share of women saying they would pick Democrats. Some 50% of female voters said they would vote Democratic, compared to 32% eyeing Republican candidates. Men also favored Democrats, but by a smaller margin.

  Trump's popularity has suffered since he ordered military strikes on Iran in February alongside US ally Israel. The war triggered a surge in gasoline prices, hitting household finances. Some 68% of Americans disapprove of Trump's handling of the economy, including 37% of self-identified Republicans.
  Voters in the poll picked Democrats over Republicans as the better stewards of the economy, by 40% to 33%.
  The survey, which was conducted online, gathered responses from 1,679 US adults, including 1,279 registered voters. The poll's results had a margin of error of 2 percentage points for all respondents and 3 points for registered voters.

items.title: CoreWeave Has ‘Darwin Moment’ As Credit Markets Price In 60% Default Odds
items.summary: For the AI infrastructure boom, the winning formula was to borrow heavily to build quickly. That strategy backfired on CoreWeave Inc. NASDAQ:CRWV. Shares fell 6.4% to $65.25 by 9:40 a.m. ET on Friday, ...
items.body:
News
/ Benzinga
/ CoreWeave Has ‘Darwin Moment’ As Credit Markets Price In 60% Default Odds

CoreWeave Has ‘Darwin Moment’ As Credit Markets Price In 60% Default Odds 2 min read

CRWV NBIS
For the AI infrastructure boom , the winning formula was to borrow heavily to build quickly. That strategy backfired on CoreWeave Inc. CRWV . Shares fell 6.4% to $65.25 by 9:40 a.m. ET on Friday, putting the stock on track for a weekly loss of about 22%. A close at that level would be its lowest since May 2025.
CoreWeave’s five-year credit default swaps — contracts that insure investors against a missed debt payment — hit a record 1,194.5 basis points on Thursday, according to ICE Data Services data reported by Bloomberg.
That price implies a more than 60% chance of default within five years, by standard market calculations.
Its 9.75% notes due October 2031 slipped to 81.80 cents on the dollar on Friday, yielding 15.08%. Two months ago, the same bonds yielded about 12%.

Read Also: EXCLUSIVE: Is AI Growth Slowing Down? Memory Industry Expert Says It's 'Too Early' To Tell
Why Higher Rates Hit CoreWeave First
CoreWeave rents out Nvidia-powered computing capacity to AI developers. It buys the chips and builds the data centers before the rent arrives, and it borrows to fill the gap.
In the second quarter, it generated $679 million in operating cash flow while spending about $6.4 billion on equipment. Net interest expense more than doubled to $640 million.
That model worked when money was cheap.
On Friday, the 10-year Treasury yield rose 4 basis points to 5.12%. The 30-year rose 3 basis points to 5.45%, and the 2-year held at 4.76%.
Wednesday’s hotter-than-expected inflation report raised the odds of another Federal Reserve rate hike on Oct. 28. CoreWeave fell 15.5% that day.
‘Darwin Moment’
"Data centre bonds are having their Darwin moment, where the weakest credits struggle to survive," Ludovic Subran , chief investment officer at German insurer Allianz, told the Financial Times this week.
Rival neocloud Nebius Group N.V. NBIS is down about 20% this week.
Bank of America’s Michael Hartnett sees the pressure moving up the food chain.
"We continue to lean risk-off next 3-4 weeks," the chief investment strategist said in his weekly Flow Show note.
He cited 3% inflation-adjusted yields, the Nov. 3 midterms and weak trading in AI "spenders and lenders."
The spenders are CoreWeave’s customers: Amazon , Alphabet , Meta , Microsoft and Oracle . The lenders include private credit firms, banks and bondholders.
Their AI spending is expected to reach $807 billion this year. As a result, their combined free cash flow is forecast to swing from $191 billion in 2025 to minus $63 billion this year, according to consensus estimates compiled by Bank of America.
Signal to Watch
"A rollover in semi prices signals further tightening of AI credit," Hartnett said, expecting an October Fed hike to restore credibility. Consumer prices have run above the Fed’s 2% target for 66 consecutive months.
In his view, a hike could pull long-term Treasury yields down another 20 basis points and limit losses in risky assets.
The question now is which companies can afford to finance the AI race at elevated interest rates.

items.title: US Project Vault readies $1B loan blitz for industry
items.author: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
items.summary: Federal-backed financing aims to help US manufacturers secure essential metals and materials amid supply risks.
items.body:
US Project Vault readies $1B loan blitz for industry

Staff Writer | October 16, 2026 | 5:39 am
Battery Metals   Critical Minerals   Suppliers & Equipment   Africa   USA   Cobalt   Copper   Lithium   Nickel   Rare Earth   Specialty Minerals  

Trump addressing coal industry representatives. ( Image courtesy of The White House. )

The US government-backed Project Vault is preparing to issue up to $1 billion in loans to American manufacturers seeking critical minerals, advancing Washington’s efforts to shield domestic industry from supply disruptions.

VaultCo, the entity managing the stockpiling initiative, is in discussions with more than 70 companies across the critical minerals supply chain, Bloomberg reported . The first round of financing is expected to cover more than a dozen original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), with another group to follow.

“What’s likely to happen is we’ll announce several hundred million dollars, maybe a billion dollars, of loans to OEMs who have requested use of the Vault facility,” VaultCo Executive Chairman Brett Lambert told the news outlet. “In the first tranche, we’ll have more than a dozen firms, followed by more than a dozen shortly after.”

The financing would mark a significant step towards making Project Vault operational as the US seeks to reduce its exposure to volatile critical minerals markets and strengthen manufacturers’ access to materials essential for industrial production.

Trump launches $12B ‘Project Vault’ to cut China reliance

Lambert said the recipients would not be publicly identified at this stage, although the announcement is expected to disclose the types of minerals they have requested.

Stockpile takes shape

Launched in February , Project Vault is structured as an independently governed public-private partnership backed by a $10 billion loan from the US Export-Import Bank (EXIM) and nearly $2 billion in private investment.

Commodity trading giants Glencore (LON: GLEN) and Mercuria recently committed $500 million each , becoming the first commodity traders to join the initiative.

Mercuria has already delivered 12,000 tonnes of copper from the Democratic Republic of Congo , establishing a new destination for the African country’s metal within Washington’s supply security strategy.

Glencore, Mercuria to help build US minerals stockpile with $1B EXIM financing

The shipment comes amid growing US demand for Congolese copper. Imports reached a record 53,290 tonnes in July, driven by competitive prices, improved product quality and concerns over potential tariffs that prompted buyers to accelerate shipments.

Commercial imports and Project Vault serve different purposes. While conventional purchases meet immediate industrial demand, the reserve is intended to provide manufacturers with access to materials when normal supply channels become disrupted.

Tailored mineral demand

Unlike conventional government stockpiles, Project Vault is designed around manufacturers’ specific requirements rather than predetermined inventories of strategic commodities.

Participating companies have requested not only raw metals and minerals but also specialized magnets, powders, alloys and other processed materials tailored to their production needs.

“There isn’t any one mineral that stands out, but the specificity of the requests have surprised me,” Lambert told Bloomberg .

The demand-driven approach allows manufacturers to determine which materials are purchased and stored, potentially giving smaller buyers greater purchasing power in fragmented and often opaque markets.

Op-Ed: US has built a strategic copper reserve. Now can it keep it?

It also distinguishes Project Vault from the US National Defense Stockpile , which the Defense Logistics Agency administers to secure materials required for national defence.

The next test will be whether the initial loans can translate manufacturers’ highly specific requests into reliable inventories, particularly for processed materials that may be harder to source than raw commodities.

items.title: Tech giants come knocking for a piece of Anglo American as copper scarcity bites, Wanblad tells FT
items.author: Frik Els
items.creator: Frik Els
items.summary: Wanblad says "deep expressions of interest" from tech companies have yet to turn into a stake, while Beijing holds the key to the $54 billion Teck merger.
items.body:
Tech giants come knocking for a piece of Anglo American as copper scarcity bites, Wanblad tells FT

Frik Els | October 15, 2026 | 10:55 am
Markets   Top Companies   Africa   Australia   Canada   China   Latin America   Copper   Diamond   Nickel   Palladium   Platinum  

Los Bronces copper mine in Chile. ( Image courtesy of Anglo American | Flickr. )

Anglo American (LON: AAL) has held talks with technology companies interested in buying equity in the miner as a way of securing supplies of the metals that go into data centres, chief executive Duncan Wanblad told the Financial Times’ Metals and Mining Summit in London on Thursday.

Discussions were “absolutely being had”, Wanblad said, with the question from the tech side coming down to whether to lock in long-term offtake directly or take an equity position to secure a stake in future supply. No stakes have been taken, but there had been “deep expressions of interest” in doing so, he told the summit. “Given the scarcity issue that we’ve been speaking about, a lot of people are looking for ways to secure supply.”

Comex copper for December delivery traded near $6.52 a pound (about $14,370 a tonne) on Thursday, a third straight decline, after stronger than expected US inflation data put a Federal Reserve rate hike this month back on the table. Cash copper on the LME settled at a record $14,822 on Monday and the most-active Comex contract remains within 6% of its September 9 record settlement of $6.89.

A $90 billion copper company

Anglo’s New York-listed shares added 0.6% to $26.86 in early trade on Thursday for a market value of $58.0 billion, while Teck Resources (NYSE: TECK) edged up 0.3% to $64.96 and is worth $31.9 billion. At those prices Anglo-Teck would carry a combined nominal value of just under $90 billion, up from the $53 billion the two companies put on the merger of equals when it was announced in September last year .

Teck has been the better performer since, gaining 50% over the past 12 months against 36% for Anglo, and both are among the strongest diversified miners of 2026. The combination would rank alongside Glencore at $89 billion and Freeport-McMoRan at $99 billion.

Waiting on Beijing

The approaches come while Anglo waits on China for the final clearance on the merger with Teck, a combination that would rank among the five largest copper producers with annual output of about 1.2 million tonnes. Wanblad would not be drawn at the summit on what Chinese regulators want in return for approval, according to the FT.

China’s State Administration for Market Regulation has asked Anglo to commit to a steady flow of copper concentrate to Chinese smelters, including volumes sold through traders, as a condition for clearing the deal, Reuters reported on October 2. The remedies under discussion do not include asset sales. The combined group would control around 5% of global copper supply, well below the 10% to 15% thresholds that normally trigger competition concerns, but China refines up to 60% of the world’s copper cathode and is facing its worst feedstock shortage in decades. Canada , the EU , the US, Japan, Chile and South Korea have all signed off, and the parties still expect to close by March 2027.

Wanblad said in August that mining transactions now take “probably a little bit longer than they might have done five years ago”, with companies needing to allow 12 to 18 months for approvals , while rejecting the idea that regulation was making deals impossible to get done.

Nickel closure on the table

Anglo is also likely to shut its nickel business in Brazil if the European Union does not approve the planned $500 million sale of the assets to China’s MMG, Wanblad told the conference. The European Commission opened an in-depth probe of the deal late last year over fears MMG could divert ferronickel from Codemin and Barro Alto away from European stainless steel makers, and issued a formal warning last month. MMG has since proposed long-term European supply commitments .

Anglo’s Brazil chief operating officer Ruben Fernandes told a closed hearing in Brussels last week that MMG was the only credible buyer the company had identified and that a prohibition would leave it heading for care and maintenance as the pathway to closure.

The nickel sale and the Teck merger are the two remaining pieces of a portfolio simplification that also has Anglo seeking about $1 billion for De Beers .
